jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)
jobs.description:
Senior Talent Partner

📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000

Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire.

We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with.

Why this role exists now

Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace.

We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position.

The role

You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls.

Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer.

  • Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities.

  • Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process.

  • Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark.

  • Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down.

  • Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team.

     
 

Who we're looking for

  • An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business.

  • Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality.

  • Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship.

  • Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here.

  • An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over.

  • Someone who shares what they know and helps develop the people around them.

 

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone.

  • If you want to specialise in one area. You'll be hiring across the whole organisation, often for very different roles in the same week. If you'd rather go deep in one function, this isn't the role for you.

  • If you want to move into people management now. This is an individual contributor role and you'll be carrying your own reqs. You'll informally mentor and share knowledge, but there are no direct reports.

  • If you're looking to own TA strategy or set standards for the whole team. Good ideas come from everyone in our team, but leading on this won’t be yours to own.

  • If you prefer a steer on ambiguous searches. We need someone who works through unclear briefs independently, and only escalates the genuinely strategic calls.

  • If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role.

  • If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't share what works. Evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process.

If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£50,000 - £60,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = 60-minute video call with our Talent Lead > In-person interview with two members of the People team > Final interview with two members of our SLT.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

 

How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

Compensation: £50K – £60K

jobs.title: Editor, International
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.

About the role:
 We’re seeking an International Editor to tell Substack’s story across international markets on our owned channels. Together with Substack’s country leads, you will help build a bank of compelling editorial resources for our publishers, and you’ll shape and scale our brand storytelling around the world. This means crafting the strategy for how we tackle editorial needs market by market. You’ll work with translators and local agencies, all while protecting a cohesive Substack brand voice, identity, and quality bar.

The ideal candidate is passionate about writing, visual storytelling, and Substack’s mission. They are committed to profiling creators and publishers across the ideological spectrum, quick to grasp complex product storytelling, and excited to help build processes and strategy from scratch. They have demonstrable experience commissioning work that has captured the zeitgeist and enriched culture, and have worked with a range of creatives across disciplines. Ideally, they have also built or expanded an editorial function at a previous organisation.

This role is based in London, and reports to the Editorial Lead, with a dotted line to the Head of International.

Responsibilities:

  • Create an international storytelling strategy. Build our storytelling surfaces that hero our international creators, drive awareness to new global audiences, and enable our international partnerships team to recruit and retain publishers.

  • Manage translators and agencies. Drive forward briefs, and oversee translators and agencies as needed to support our key international markets at scale.

  • Collaborate across functions. Partner with Editorial, Comms, Partnerships, and country leads to make sure international editorial work is joined up with the rest of Substack’s communications and brand strategy.

  • Protect brand voice and quality. Ensure a cohesive brand voice, identity, and quality bar across every market and every translated or localized piece of content, however many hands it passes through.

Requirements:

  • Editorial judgment. You have a keen editorial eye and can judge, quickly and confidently, what’s worth translating and localizing for an international audience.

  • Exceptional project management. You can run multiple editorial workstreams across several markets at once, keeping translators, agencies, and internal stakeholders on schedule.

  • A writer at heart. You are an excellent writer and communicator, with an eye for what makes a compelling narrative.

  • Social media strategy. You have a strong eye for social media strategy and know what works on LinkedIn and how to repurpose for Instagram.

  • Cross-functional relationship-builder. You’ll cultivate strong working relationships with Editorial, Comms, and heads of markets, and you’re comfortable prioritising competing requests from several stakeholders at once across time zones.

  • Builder’s mindset. You’re comfortable building something (a hub, a process, a workflow) from scratch, and iterating on it as international needs evolve.

  • Cultural fluency. You’re familiar with Substack as a creator or subscriber and excited to help champion our mission internationally.

  • International experience. You’ve worked across international markets before, ideally in media, publishing, or communications, and understand the nuance of adapting content and brand voice for different cultural contexts.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market-competitive salary, equity for all full-time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is £70,000 - £100,000. Multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, determine final offer amounts and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.

Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.

Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.

You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.

The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built.

You’re AI pilled, you run agents, you tinker and are excited about technology in general

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

  • Partner with engineering and design. Work closely with our engineers and designers as the work gets done, from scoping through to shipping.

  • Build for our talent experts. Our internal talent experts are at the core of our business. Work alongside them to build a platform that makes them better at what they do.

  • Run delivery. Own our planning sessions and our roadmap in Linear. Make sure we have a plan, even if it might change, so we always know what’s next and roughly what’s after.

  • Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

  • Delivery focused. You care deeply about moving fast and shipping.

  • Great with stakeholders. You're comfortable with candidates, clients and our internal recruitment team, and you keep all three at the heart of what gets built.

  • Use data, but aren't beholden to it. You make data-driven decisions where you can, and you're not afraid to make the call when the data isn’t there.

  • Bring consistency and rhythm. You help give the team a rhythm for how we plan and ship, so everyone knows what’s happening and when.

  • Forward thinking with AI. You're all in on AI, you build with it and you tinker in your own time.

Nice to Have

  • ML systems experience, especially recommendation, search or matchmaking

  • Marketplace experience

  • RecTech or HRTech experience

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

Learn tax from scratch. Then help rebuild how it's done.

No prior tax knowledge needed. We'll teach you the tax and fund your professional qualification.

What you bring is the other half: SQL, code, and hands-on experience using AI workflows to turn large datasets into clear answers. Because tax, it turns out, is a data problem with deadlines.

And you'll join while the tax function is still being built, so the tools you make become part of how it runs.

 

The Job

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. Every new market and product line brings tax questions, and you'll help answer them.

  • Plan for what's next: work with our Director of Finance and tax specialists on tax planning for new markets and products, and build your own view of how tax works across the business.

  • Follow the data: map how tax data moves from our systems to our returns, and spot where it could be faster, more accurate or better controlled.

  • Fix what you find: turn those findings into a plan and take a leading role delivering it, using AI and better data so manual steps become the exception.

Why you'll want it

A qualification, paid for. Learn tax on the job from specialists across multiple disciplines, with your professional qualification funded.

The whole function, not one corner. Planning, launches, processes and returns: you'll see how tax works across a high-growth fintech, start to finish.

Real outcomes, early. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you own real work early and take on more as soon as you're ready.

A CV with both halves. You'll come out knowing tax, and knowing how to build the AI-enabled systems behind it in a regulated business.

 

Is this you?

You have, or are on track for, a first-class degree in a numerate subject (or equivalent experience). You're graduating in 2026 or 2027, or you're up to two years into your career.

You write strong SQL plus Python or similar, and you've used AI workflows on large datasets in practice.

You think in systems, and you can explain technical work to people who don't write code.

Warehouse Supervisor

Location: Brighton - St Josephs Business Park (BN3)

Working pattern: Onsite | Full-time | Shift-based (37.5 hours per week)

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Brighton team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

English version below

Über das Unternehmen:

Industrious ist der führende Premium-Anbieter von flexiblen Arbeitsplatzlösungen und bietet einige der am besten bewerteten Arbeitsorte der Branche. Unser Antrieb ist es, für Teams jeder Größe und in jeder Entwicklungsphase großartige Arbeitserlebnisse zu schaffen - und das gilt ebenso für unser eigenes Team.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass herausragende Arbeitsbedingungen durch die Menschen entstehen, mit denen man zusammenarbeitet, und durch die Herausforderungen, die man gemeinsam meistert. Deshalb suchen wir Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die gerne über den Tellerrand hinausdenken und in einem wirklich kollaborativen Umfeld aufblühen.

Bei Industrious fördern wir neue Ideen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge. Wir freuen uns darauf, die Arbeitsumgebungen von Menschen nachhaltig zu verbessern - und hoffen, dass du Teil dieser Mission werden.

Erfüllte Arbeitstage entstehen, wenn Menschen am Arbeitsplatz sie selbst sein können. Vielfalt in Herkunft, Perspektiven und Ideen ist für unseren Erfolg entscheidend – sowohl bei der Gestaltung herausragender Arbeitsplatz-Erlebnisse für unsere Mitglieder als auch im täglichen Miteinander. Industrious setzt sich für ein inklusives und respektvolles Umfeld ein, das Individualität wertschätzt und Raum für unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten bietet. Bei uns zählt, wer Du bist und was Du einbringst. Wir feiern unsere Mitarbeitenden als einzigartige Persönlichkeiten, die gemeinsam als Team Außergewöhnliches erreichen können.

Um mehr zu erfahren, besuchen Sie www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

 

Über die Rolle:

Unsere Member Experience Manager sind zentrale Ansprechpartner, Problemlöser, Impulsgeber und Gestalter eines herausragenden Member-Erlebnisses. Du bist die vertraute Verbindungsperson für unsere Mitglieder und die Persönlichkeit, die jeder kennt. In der Leitung deines Standortes setzt du deinen ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn ein, um Prozesse zu koordinieren, Kommunikation klar zu steuern und einen reibungslosen Betrieb sicherzustellen.

Du begegnest Entscheidungsträgern auf Augenhöhe und scheust dich nicht, Fragen zu stellen, wenn Informationen fehlen. Du verbindest dich aktiv mit dem lokalen Geschäftsumfeld. Du repräsentierst Industrious selbstbewusst in deinem Markt und identifizierst potenzielle Mitglieder, denen du ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitserlebnis ermöglichen möchtest. Durch deine echte Neugier und deinen beratenden Ansatz verstehst Du die Bedürfnisse von Menschen und findest passende Lösungen. Du planst inspirierende Events und schätzt die anspruchsvolle Arbeit hinter den Kulissen, die solche Momente möglich macht. Vor allem aber: Du unterstützt andere mit Freude und Überzeugung.

Industrious hilft Unternehmen jeder Größe dabei, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu finden, in dem du dein volles Potenzial entfalten können. Unser Team definiert Produktivität neu – durch ein modernes, menschenzentriertes Arbeitserlebnis.

Wir sind Industrious.

Exzellenz ist keine Selbstverständlichkeit. Wir erreichen sie nur mit einem Team von Menschen, die umsichtig handeln, unkonventionell denken und neue Wege nicht scheuen. Wenn du Teil dieser Mission werden möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Du weißt, dass du erfolgreich sein wirst, wenn:

  • Du erkennst die wichtigsten Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen treffsicher und begleitest sie souverän als zuverlässige Partnerin oder zuverlässiger Partner zu wirksamen Lösungen.

  • Du weißt, was deine Community liebt, und stellst Programme zusammen, die du genießen und auf die du stolz bist (du postest sogar auf Instagram darüber!)

Du passt hervorragend zu dieser Rolle, wenn:

  • Keine Mitgliederanfrage zu groß oder zu klein ist für dich

  • Du schöpfst Energie aus der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und agierst als starke Teamplayerin bzw. starker Teamplayer.

  • Deine ausgeprägte Liebe zum Detail wird von Ihrem Umfeld geschätzt und macht sich in der Qualität Ihrer Arbeit bemerkbar.

  • Du verfügst über eine hohe Resilienz und wissen, dass Weiterentwicklung durch das Meistern anspruchsvoller und unvorhersehbarer Situationen entsteht.

  • Du bist flexibel und pragmatisch: Du packst an, wenn es nötig ist, und behältst zugleich das große Ganze im Blick.

Als Member Experience Manager bist du verantwortlich für das Member-Erlebnis in deinem Gebäude. Du stellst außerdem sicher, dass wir die Bedürfnisse unserer Mitglieder erfüllen und die globalen Industrious-Standards und -Ziele in Bezug auf die Member-Zufriedenheit erreichen.

Mitgliederbindung & Engagement:

  • Pflege wichtiger Kundenbeziehungen- übernimm die Betreuung von Eskalationen und sorge für eine hohe Mitgliederzufriedenheit, einschließlich der Überwachung und Verbesserung des NPS.

Gebäudebetrieb und -management:

  • Sorge für operative Exzellenz, indem du Qualitätsstandards sicherstellst, SLAs einhältst, OPEX überwachst und Eskalationen mit dem Gebäude, Vermieter oder Dienstleistern löst.

  • Unterstütze übergreifende Anforderungen im Gebäude, indem du bei Bedarf Community-Aufgaben übernimmst und mit Sales, Account Management und anderen internen Teams koordinierst.

Teamführung:

  • Führe und unterstütze die Gebäudeteams, indem du ein starkes Onboarding sicherstellst, ihnen die benötigten Tools zur Verfügung stellst und eine ausgewogene Präsenz über mehrere Standorte hinweg sicherstellst.

  • Coache und entwickle Teammitglieder durch wöchentliche 1:1-Gespräche, persönliche Entwicklungspläne, Leistungsanerkennung und Wachstumschancen.

  • Verfolge die Leistung kontinuierlich und führe regelmäßige Reviews durch.

Budgetplanung & Kostenkontrolle:

  • Unterstütze die Erstellung monatlicher, vierteljährlicher und jährlicher Budgets und überprüfe regelmäßig die finanzielle Leistung des Gebäudes, um Bereiche für effizientere Ausgaben und operative Verbesserungen zu identifizieren.

About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

You know you will be successful when:

  • You accurately recognize the key needs of companies and confidently guide them to effective solutions as a reliable partner.

  • You know what your community loves and put together programs that you enjoy and are proud of (you even post about it on Instagram!)

You are a great fit for this role if:

  • No member request is too big or too small for you.

  • You draw energy from working with people and act as a strong team player.

  • Your pronounced love for detail is appreciated by those around you and is noticeable in the quality of your work.

  • You have high resilience and know that development comes from mastering demanding and unpredictable situations.

  • You are flexible and pragmatic: You lend a hand when necessary while keeping the big picture in mind.

As a Member Experience Manager, you are responsible for the member experience in your building. You also ensure that we meet the needs of our members and achieve the global Industrious standards and goals for member satisfaction.

Member Retention & Engagement:

  • Cultivate important client relationships - take on the management of escalations and ensure high member satisfaction, including monitoring and improving NPS.

Building Operations and Management:

  • Ensure operational excellence by securing quality standards, adhering to SLAs, monitoring OPEX, and resolving escalations with the building, landlord, or service providers.

  • Support overarching requirements in the building by taking on community tasks when needed and coordinating with Sales, Account Management, and other internal teams.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and support the building teams by ensuring strong onboarding, providing them with the necessary tools, and ensuring a balanced presence across multiple locations.

  • Coach and develop team members through weekly 1:1 meetings, personal development plans, performance recognition, and growth opportunities.

  • Continuously track performance and conduct regular reviews.

Budget Planning & Cost Control:

  • Support the creation of monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and regularly review the building's financial performance to identify areas for more efficient spending and operational improvements.

Über die Rolle:

 Aufgabenbereiche:

Diese Rolle wird an fünf Tagen pro Woche vor Ort ausgeübt. Kandidat:innen sollen in oder gut erreichbar in der Nähe von der Stadt, die für diese Rolle angegeben ist, wohnen.

Als Member Experience Associate bei Industrious bist du das Herzstück des Membererlebnisses. Du sorgst für erfüllte Arbeitstage für jeden/ jede, die/ der dein Büro betritt. Dein Alltag kann unterschiedlich aussehen - hier ist ein möglicher Tagesablauf:

  • Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unsere Rezeption - somit bist du der/ die erste/erster den/ die unsere Mitglieder sehen 

  • Du bereitest den Arbeitsalltag vor, indem du Kaffee und Frühstück vorbereitest und die Gemeinschaftsbereiche stets gut ausgestattet hältst.

  • Du handelst vorausschauend und übernimmst eigenständig die Bestandsführung sowie das Nachbestellen von Verbrauchsmaterialien.

  • Du planst und realisierst ansprechende Events und gestaltest hochwertige Beschilderungen - mit dem Bewusstsein, dass der Unterschied oft im Detail liegt.

  • Du legst neue Member in unseren Systemen an und sorgst dafür, dass Ihr erster Tag reibungslos, effizient und einladend verläuft.

  • Du unterstützt Member bei technischen Fragen, ob IT- oder WLAN-bezogen – für dich ist keine Herausforderung zu groß oder zu klein.

  • Du repräsentierst uns bei lokalen Marketingaktivitäten und trägst dazu bei, potenziellen Membern den Mehrwert unserer flexiblen Lösungen nahezubringen.

  • Du führst Interessent:innen kompetent durch unsere Räumlichkeiten.

Industrious unterstützt Unternehmen jeder Größe dabei, ihr ideales Arbeitsumfeld zu finden, damit sie ihr volles Potenzial entfalten können. Unser Team gestaltet die Zukunft produktiven Arbeitens neu, indem wir ein zeitgemäßes, inspirierendes Arbeitserlebnis schaffen. Gerade jetzt ist es wichtiger denn je, dass unsere Member Experience Associates engagiert Beziehungen aufbauen und eine starke Gemeinschaft fördern. Du knüpfst mühelos vertrauensvolle Kontakte zu unseren Mitgliedern und weißt, dass nachhaltige Interaktionen auf gegenseitigem Vertrauen und gemeinsamen Werten beruhen.

Wir sind Industrious.

Wir entwickeln ein Team, das durch gegenseitige Wertschätzung und Zusammenarbeit ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld schafft. Werde Teil dieses Teams. 

 

Du passt perfekt zu dieser Rolle, wenn:

  • Für dich ist keine Anfrage eines Mitglieds zu groß oder zu klein. Du packst gerne mit an - ob beim Auffüllen des Kühlschranks oder bei der Behebung eines Druckerproblems.

  • Du lernst gerne neue Menschen kennen und arbeitest am liebsten im Team, weil du Freude daran hast, gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Situationen und denkst vorausschauend. Oft hast du bereits eine Lösung gefunden, bevor andere das Problem überhaupt bemerken.

  • Du bist belastbar und weißt, wie wertvoll eine gute Routine ist - zugleich bleibst du flexibel und souverän, wenn unvorhergesehene Herausforderungen auftreten.

  • Du scheust dich nicht vor praktischer Arbeit und weißt, dass vieles, was ein großartiges Erlebnis ermöglicht, hinter den Kulissen entsteht.

  • Du strebst kontinuierlich nach Verbesserungen und effizienteren Abläufen, denn für dich bedeutet Engagement einen erfüllten und produktiven Arbeitstag.

Anforderungen:

  • Ausführung wiederkehrender Tätigkeiten, die regelmäßiges Heben, Tragen, Schieben und Ziehen von Gegenständen (bis zu 12 kg) erfordern.

  • Fähigkeit, über längere Zeiträume hinweg zu stehen, sich zu bücken, zu knien, zu strecken sowie längere Wege zu gehen.

  • Bedienung verschiedener Geräte und Maschinen, darunter Drucker, Geschirrspüler, Mixer, Snackwagen, Messer und weitere Küchenutensilien.

  • Mitwirkung bei der Zubereitung von Lebensmitteln sowie bei Reinigungsarbeiten unter strikter Einhaltung aller geltenden Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien, einschließlich der sachgemäßen Verwendung von Reinigungsmitteln und -geräten.

  • Sicherstellung eines stets hygienisch einwandfreien Arbeitsumfeldes und konsequente Umsetzung aller Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokolle.

 

Diese Position ist eine Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden/Woche. Die tatsächliche Grundvergütung des erfolgreichen Kandidaten hängt von verschiedenen Faktoren ab, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Berufserfahrung, beruflichem Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen.

Das Grundgehalt und die Bonusvergütung sind nur zwei Bestandteile des gesamten Vergütungspakets von Industrious. Weitere großartige Mitarbeitervorteile umfassen unter anderem: großzügige Urlaubsregelungen, Wellness-Programme, Zuschüsse für berufliche Weiterentwicklung und viele weitere Vorteile, die von den geltenden Anspruchskriterien und Unternehmensrichtlinien abhängen.

Wir bitten höflich darum, keine Industrious-Standorte für Beschäftigungsanfragen anzurufen.

About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.  

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

As a Member Experience Associate at Industrious, you will be the heart of the member experience, truly aiming to create great days for all who enter your office. While your day may not look the same, here's what it could look like: 

  • Your workplace is our reception - making you the first person our members see.

  • You prepare for the workday by preparing coffee and breakfast and keeping the common areas well-stocked at all times.

  • You’re proactive and take ownership over managing inventory and ordering your location’s supplies.

  • You build magnificent events and take the extra time to design unique signage because you know the magic is in the details.

  • You add new members into multiple systems so their first day in their office is seamless and memorable. 

  • You assist a member with IT or wifi issues should they ever come up - no job is too big or too small for you to tackle.

  • You dip your toe in local marketing events - ensuring any prospective member knows the true value of our flexible solutions.

  • You take a walk in-tour while your Member Experience Manager is assisting another potential member.

Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work. Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience. Right now it’s more important than ever that our Member Experience Associates are passionate about building relationships and community. You can effortlessly connect with your members. You know that the most meaningful interactions are rooted in trust and shared values.

We are Industrious.

We’re building a team of considerate collaborators who create great days. Come join us.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

  • No member request is too big or too small for you to handle. You find yourself smiling when restocking the fridge and fixing the printer

  • You’re energised by meeting people and work well in a team because you like supporting and assisting to help a larger plan come together

  • You can create order out of chaos and are always planning ahead. You come up with solutions before anyone knows there is a problem

  • You’re resilient. You know the value of having a routine, but you’re ready for the bumps too

  • You’re willing to get your hands dirty and realise the behind the scenes work is not always glamorous

  • You always look to improve and make things more efficient because staying busy is your happy speed

Requirements:

  • Performing recurring tasks that require regular lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of objects (up to 12 kg).

  • Ability to stand, bend, kneel, stretch, and walk for extended periods.

  • Operating various devices and machines, including printers, dishwashers, blenders, snack carts, knives, and other kitchen utensils.

  • Assisting with food preparation and cleaning work, strictly adhering to all applicable health and safety guidelines, including the proper use of cleaning agents and equipment.

  • Ensuring a hygienically perfect working environment at all times and consistently implementing all safety and hygiene protocols.

This role is a full-time role with 40 hours/week performed on-site five days a week. Candidates should live in or within easy reach of the city specified for this role.

This position . The salary for this role is €39,000 + performance bonus. On top of that, you'll enjoy a range of perks, including Employee Assistance Programme, corporate events, Learning & Development Grant, regular training, transport allowance.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer.

jobs.title: Legal Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Legal Solutions Engineer

Edinburgh
London

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The Role

Legal Solutions Engineers turn the product into real outcomes for customers.

You’ll work with customers after purchase to design, configure, and implement legal workflows inside Wordsmith. This role sits close to the customer, helping them embed the platform into how their legal function actually operates.

It’s part implementation, part problem solving, and part advisory. You’ll combine legal understanding with product knowledge to help customers get meaningful value from the platform.

What you’ll do

Customer Implementation

  • Lead implementation projects for new customers

  • Design workflows and automation tailored to each organisation

  • Configure the platform to support real legal use cases

Solution Design

  • Work directly with legal teams and Legal Ops leaders to understand how they operate

  • Translate legal processes into structured workflows and AI-enabled automation

  • Advise on best practices for implementing legal technology

Customer Success & Expansion

  • Support onboarding and early adoption

  • Help customers expand into additional workflows and use cases

  • Partner with Account Management to identify growth opportunities

Product Feedback

  • Surface patterns, insights, and recurring requests to Product and Engineering

  • Help shape how the product evolves based on real usage

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in legal tech, legal operations, or process transformation

  • Strong understanding of how in-house legal teams work

  • Ability to manage customer projects and guide stakeholders through change

  • Comfortable working across legal and technical domains

  • Structured thinker — you can turn messy processes into clear systems

  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with customers

Typical backgrounds include:

  • Legal Engineers

  • Legal Operations professionals

  • Lawyers who have moved into legal tech

  • Implementation or solutions consultants in SaaS with a legal background

How we work

We’re an in-office team in Edinburgh. We work together because it helps us collaborate closely across product, engineering, and customer teams. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

This is a high ownership role. You’ll be trusted to run projects, work directly with customers, and drive outcomes without heavy oversight.

The problems are often not fully defined. Part of the role is bringing structure and clarity to how legal work gets done.

Why this role matters

The value of legal technology comes from how it’s implemented.

Legal Solutions Engineers ensure customers successfully embed Wordsmith into their workflows and see real impact.

This role sits at the centre of that.

What you can expect

  • Direct impact on customer outcomes and product adoption

  • Close collaboration with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams

  • A chance to shape how legal teams use AI in practice

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity

jobs.title: SFO Assistant - supply/ringevikar
jobs.description:

Qualifications and experience

  • An ability to take initiative and contribute to the development of SFO

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At BISS Gausel and BISS Sentrum, the development of the whole child is at the heart of our education programme. Learning in the Primary and Middle School Departments is about developing personal, emotional, and social skills alongside an exciting academic programme.

BISS Gausel and BISS Sentrum are private schools with state funding and are authorised to teach the International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary and Middle Years Programmes. Together they have over 600 students from over 50 nationalities, aged 6 to 16 years of age.

jobs.title: Sykepleier 14,3 % Helg
jobs.description:
Ved Avgiftningsenhet 1 på Aker søker vi nå engasjerte medarbeidere til to faste helgestillinger (14,3 %) og ett vikariat (14,3 %) med arbeid hver tredje helg.Seksjon Rusakuttmottak og Avgiftning (RUA)ligger på Aker sykehusområde og består av tre sengeposter; rusakuttmottak døgn og to avgiftningsenheter. RUA er en del av Avdeling rus- og avhengighetsbehandling ved Oslo universitetssykehus. Vi tilbyr akutt rusbehandling, avgiftning og spesialisert tverrfaglig behandling til pasienter med sammensatte utfordringer innen rus, psykisk helse, samt høy grad av somatisk og akutt medisinsk behandling.

Hos oss får du en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdagAvgiftningsenheten har 12 sengeplasser og behandler pasienter som har behov for døgnbasert avgiftning. Vi tilbyr også behandling til pasienter innlagt etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §10. Arbeidet spenner fra miljøterapeutisk oppfølging til observasjon, somatisk behandling og håndtering av akutte medisinske problemstillinger.

Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig miljø bestående av sykepleiere, vernepleiere, sosionomer, leger og psykologer. Samarbeid på tvers av faggrupper er en viktig del av behandlingen, og du vil få mulighet til å bidra med din kompetanse til beste for pasientene våre.

Hvem ser vi etter?Vi søker deg som ønsker å arbeide med mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner, og som finner motivasjon i å bidra til endring, mestring og håp.Du bør være robust og kunne håndtere krevende situasjoner sammen med kollegaene dine. Samtidig er du faglig engasjert, tydelig og god til å bygge relasjoner. Du møter mennesker med respekt og omsorg, også når sykdomsbildet er komplekst og utfordrende.Et godt humør og evnen til å skape trygghet og gode relasjoner er egenskaper vi setter stor pris på.

Vikariatet er til 01.06.2027 med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi ønsker at du skal lykkes hos ossVi er opptatt av at nye medarbeidere skal føle seg trygge og ivaretatt. Derfor tilbyr vi opplæring med fadder eller dedikert opplæringsansvarlige. Du vil jobbe tett sammen med erfarne kollegaer og aldri stå alene i utfordrende situasjoner.Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse og stort engasjement for pasientgruppen. Vi har også ukentlig MAP-opplæring (Møte med aggresjonsproblematikk) og stort fokus på trygghet, kompetanseutvikling og samarbeid.Muligheten til å gjøre en reell forskjell for mennesker som trenger det mest. Hos oss får du ikke bare en jobb, men muligheten til å bidra i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag og være med på å skape livsendrende øyeblikk for pasientene våre.Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og håper du vil bli en viktig del av vårt team!

Til det beste for pasienten – Bli vår kollega!Som sykepleier har du en viktig funksjon på sykehuset vårt, og du spiller en avgjørende rolle i å sikre trygge og gode pasientopplevelser. Vi søker en engasjert sykepleier som ønsker å være med på å forme et sunt, inkluderende og positivt arbeidsmiljø. Du er en person som både kan jobbe selvstendig og som setter pris på godt samarbeid i team. Du har evnen til å bygge relasjoner, ta initiativ og bidra aktivt til arbeidsprosesser som fremmer både pasientenes og kollegenes trivsel.

Vi ønsker at du trives med å jobbe i en stor, kompleks organisasjon som er i stadig utvikling, og at du ser muligheter i endringene vi møter. Sammen kan vi skape et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø som gir både ansatte og pasienter den støtten og tryggheten de trenger.

Virker vi som en arbeidsplass du vil være en del av? Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og håper du vil bli en viktig del av vårt team!

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hvordan ser en arbeidshverdag ut? 

  • Utøve tverrfaglig spesialisert rusbehandling etter anerkjente prinsipper.
  • Kartlegging, utredning, behandling og observasjon av pasienter.
  • Koordinere behandling med andre aktuelle yrkesgrupper og avdelinger
  • Kjenne til og kunne anvende avdelingens prosedyrer, utstyr og dokumentasjonssystemer (F.eks. NEWS, CIWA, COWS o.l).
  • Delta i seksjonens kvalitets- og utviklingsarbeid, samt veiledning av studenter og hospitanter.
  • Utøve sykepleie ut fra miljøterapautiske prinsipper.
Kvalifikasjoner

For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier.
  • Gode IKT kunnskaper.
  • Kjent med å bruke miljøterapautisk tilnærming i arbeidet.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskkunnskaper (minimum B2/C1).
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra kommunal rusbehandling eller TSB.
  • Fysisk og psykisk skikket til til å håndtere krevende situasjoner og være en god teamarbeider.
Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden.Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er faglig og personlig trygg, og arbeider selvstendig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst.
  • Du har evnen til tett og forpliktende lagsamarbeid på tvers av ulike fagmiljøer.
  • Du har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner, og kan bygge relasjoner med pasienter, pårørende og kolleger.
  • Du har et ønske om faglig utvikling, og tar initiativ til din egen opplæring og utvikling.
  • Du er en aktiv bidragsyter for å skape et godt arbeidsmiljø, og bygge gode relasjoner og nettverk i sykehuset.
  • Du er initiativrik, utviklingsorientert og trives med endringer i en stor og kompleks organisasjon.
  • Du er en synlig ambassadør for pasientgruppen, og arbeider for å fremme deres interesser og behov.
Vi tilbyr

Som sykepleier er du en attraktiv og viktig medarbeider for oss! Oslo universitetssykehus har et viktig samfunnsoppdrag i det å tilby gode og likeverdige helsetjenester til befolkningen. Som sykepleier ved sykehuset vil du ha en sentral rolle i å innfri dette. Du har stor betydning for pasientsikkerhet, trivsel på arbeidsplassen og utvikling av en trygg, åpen og inkluderende kultur.

Vi er opptatt av at du skal trives og utvikle deg, les under hva vi kan tilby deg:

  • Du blir en del av en faglig sterk arbeidsplass og stolte fagpersoner. 
  • Du blir en del av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag, hvor du er tett på pasienter og pårørende.
  • Du får en utfordrende, variert og spennende hverdag i en kompleks organisasjon som er i kontinuerlig utvikling.
  • Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse, og et utstrakt samarbeid med dedikerte kolleger som er ledende innenfor sine fagområder.
  • Du blir gitt gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Du får god opplæring og det vil være mulighet for interne kurs og årlige seminarer, samt faglig påfyll underveis.
  • Vi tar vare på våre nye medarbeidere  og støtter deg gjennom oppstartsfasen med vårt sentrale nyansattprogram, les mer: https://www.oslo-universitetssykehus.no/om-oss/jobb-og-utdanning/arbeidsplassen-var/velkommen-med-pa-laget/
  • Vi har velferdstilbud for våre medarbeidere, f. eks. teaterbilletter, bedriftskor, bedriftsidrettslag m.m.

I Oslo universitetssykehus driver vi med avansert pasientbehandling, forskning, utprøvende behandling, undervisning og innovasjon på et høyt internasjonalt nivå. Vi er derfor hele Norges bakvakt! Vi trenger deg med på laget!

Høres dette ut som en stilling for deg? Vi gleder oss til å lese din søknad.

Vil du vite mer om oss? Les om dine muligheter som sykepleier ved Norges største helsefaglige arbeidsplass: https://www.oslo-universitetssykehus.no/om-oss/jobb-og-utdanning/sykepleier           

KontaktinformasjonMerethe Johansen, Enhetsleder, +4741354445 ArbeidsstedTrondheimsveien 235 0586 Oslo Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF Referansenr.: 5211770568 Stillingsprosent: 14,3% Fast, Vikariat Startdato: 01.12.2026 Søknadsfrist: 02.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. Hos oss finner du noen av landets ledende eksperter innen sine fagfelt, og her blir du en del av Norges største helsefaglige arbeidsplass. Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av åpenhet og respekt er svært viktig for oss. Uansett hva du jobber med vil du få muligheten til å utvikle deg og benytte din kompetanse på et sted hvor det virkelig teller.

jobs.title: Data Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Data Engineering Manager Remote within Sweden Some travel, under about five days a quarter Every request, quote, and booking on Avinode is a signal nobody else holds. Today it sits in pipelines that work but were built one at a time, for the needs of the moment. We're building the foundation that turns it into governed, reusable data: one identity for member, company, aircraft, and trip; contracts on every source; and quality you can see rather than assume. We're looking for a data engineering manager and tech lead: the person who builds that foundation with their hands and builds the team around it. About seven days in ten, you'll be writing code, reviewing designs, and settling architecture. The rest is people: you'll lead a small team and shape who joins it. What you'll do     You’ll hold the technical direction for our data platform on Databricks, and write a good part of it yourself.     You’ll own acquisition, modeling, and data quality: contracts for every source we depend on, tests, monitoring, lineage, access control. You’ll set the review bar, and move pipeline and test code to proposed changes that get reviewed.     You’ll keep your own work off the critical path, so the team never waits for you and the people side never gets dropped.     You’ll lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers. Hire for open roles, set clear expectations, and support each person’s performance, development, and growth.     You’ll work with the Director of Data & AI on sequencing and standards, with our product manager for data on what we promise, and with Engineering on platform, security and oncall. Who you are     You have real hands-on depth in data engineering on a modern platform: ingestion, modeling, quality, and the pipelines that stay up.     You have real hands-on experience with Databricks in production: jobs, Delta, Unity Catalog, cost control.     You have a strong interest in not only the technology, but the business outcomes it enables.     You have worked with data scientists and ML engineers and know what turns a notebook into something that serves.     You communicate clearly in writing: you document decisions, data contracts, and standards so the team can move forward without needing you in every conversation.     You have experience managing or leading a small team, or formally mentoring engineers, and an interest in continuing to build hands-on while leading others. Nice-to-haves     Having been the first lead of a data team, or built one. ML platform experience, feature pipelines, or model serving. What you’ll work with     Databricks, Python, SQL.What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.We want to support your development and dreams.Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.title: Vil du bidra til å gjennomføre et viktig samfunnsoppdrag?
jobs.description:
Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI) er en beredskapsorganisasjon. Når verden endrer seg, må vi kunne omstille oss raskt. Krig, konflikt og endringer i migrasjonen påvirker oppgavene og prioriteringene våre. I 2027 forventer vi økt aktivitet på returfeltet, og for å styrke arbeidet med gjennomføring av assisterte returer og tilbakevendinger har vi behov for to medarbeidere i midlertidige stillinger. Stillingene har som utgangspunkt varighet ut 2027, men det kan være mulighet for forlengelse.   Du blir en del av tjenesteområdet Mottak og retur. Det er vi som har ansvaret for at flyktninger og asylsøkere får et sted å bo fra ankomst til vedtak, og videre til bosetting eller assistert retur. Returfeltet står høyt på den politiske dagsordenen og har stor betydning for samfunnet.   Dette er en stilling for deg som trives med å koordinere, følge opp og få ting til å skje. Du arbeider med de praktiske og logistiske oppgavene som må være på plass for at returprosesser skal kunne gjennomføres på en trygg, effektiv og forsvarlig måte. Du vil samarbeide tett med kollegaer og eksterne samarbeidspartnere i Norge og utlandet. 

Returarbeidet er i kontinuerlig utvikling. Derfor ser vi etter deg som ikke bare liker å løse oppgaver her og nå, men som også ønsker å bidra til bedre rutiner, smartere arbeidsprosesser og økt bruk av digitale løsninger.

Du blir en del av et fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og stort engasjement for samfunnsoppdraget. Vi samarbeider, deler kunnskap og støtter hverandre i arbeidet med å finne gode løsninger på et fagområde som stadig er i endring.

Hos oss arbeider du i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker, samfunn og forvaltning. Du får innsikt i hvordan et direktorat fungerer, hvordan politiske føringer og regelverk omsettes til praksis, og hvordan vi sammen håndterer et fagområde som står høyt på den politiske dagsordenen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet:

  • saksbehandle søknader om assisterte returer og tilbakevendinger
  • koordinere og følge opp logistikk og praktisk gjennomføring av retursaker fra planlegging til gjennomført retur og fullført reintegrering i hjemlandet
  • håndtere dokumentasjon, registreringer og oppfølging av saker i ulike systemer
  • samarbeide med leverandører, samarbeidspartnere og andre aktører i Norge og utlandet
  • løse praktiske utfordringer og følge opp saker som krever særskilt koordinering
  • bidra til å utvikle og forbedre rutiner, arbeidsprosesser og digitale løsninger innen returarbeidet

Arbeidet kan innebære oppmøte på Oslo lufthavn eller andre steder i Norge i forbindelse med gjennomføring av returer.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå, fortrinns innen samfunnsvitenskap og rettsvitenskap
  • svært god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk
  • god digital kompetanse og evne til å sette deg inn i nye systemer
  • erfaring med, eller interesse for, koordinering, logistikk, drift eller operativ oppfølging

Det er ønskelig med, men ikke et krav at du har:

  • erfaring fra offentlig forvaltning eller utlendingsfeltet
  • erfaring med saksbehandling og oppfølging av enkeltsaker
  • erfaring med forbedringsarbeid eller utvikling av arbeidsprosesser
  • kjennskap til internasjonalt samarbeid og arbeid på tvers av ulike aktører 
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • identifiserer deg med UDIs verdier: menneskeverd, profesjonalitet og helhet
  • er en lagspiller som bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø og som jobber mot felles mål
  • er strukturert og holder oversikt også når mange oppgaver pågår samtidig
  • trives med koordinering og tar ansvar for å finne løsninger når utfordringer oppstår
  • er fremoverlent og tar initiativ
  • er fleksibel og håndterer endringer på en konstruktiv måte
Velkommen til oss!

I UDI er vi opptatt av mangfold. Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. Vi vil tilrettelegge for medarbeidere som har behov for det. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være tekniske hjelpemidler, tilpasning av møbler eller endring av rutiner, arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid. Har du hull i CV-en din, funksjonell nedsettelse eller innvandringsbakgrunn, vil vi oppfordre deg til å krysse av for dette når du søker stilling hos oss. Vi kaller alltid inn minst én kvalifisert kandidat fra hver av disse gruppen til intervju. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte til å søke hos oss.     

Derfor bør du velge oss:

Hos oss får du spennende og varierte oppgaver i en virksomhet med et av Norges viktigste samfunnsoppdrag. Du får arbeidssted i moderne lokaler på Helsfyr i Oslo. Vi tilbyr blant annet sommertid, trening i arbeidstiden, fleksitid og fleksibel arbeidsplass – og ikke minst landets beste kollegaer (mener vi). 

Stillingen er lønnet som rådgiver (1436) i lønnsspennet 600 000 –700 000,-brutto per år avhengig av kvalifikasjoner. For spesielt kvalifiserte søkere, kan høyere lønn vurderes. Et lønnstrekk på to prosent gir deg gode ordninger for pensjon, lån og forsikringer i Statens pensjonskasse.    

Informasjon om søknadsprosessen:   Du søker på stillingen via søknadssystemet Webcruiter. Du må legge ved vitnemål og du laster det direkte ned fra Vitnemålsportalen i Webcruiter (vitnemalsportalen.no). Dersom du har utdanning fra utlandet, må den være godkjent av NOKUT eller Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (hkdir.no) på søknadstidspunktet.     Vi ber deg om å levere en beskrivende søknad og CV som fremhever din erfaring, kompetanse, og hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen.

Vi planlegger for en effektiv rekrutteringsprosess og ønsker å gjennomføre 1.gangsintervjuer 4 og 7.desember

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli utelatt fra denne listen. I så fall må du begrunne hvorfor du ønsker det. Hvis ønsket ditt ikke kan innvilges, tar vi kontakt med deg i forkant  

I samarbeid med ekstern leverandør benytter UDI seg av bakgrunnssjekk. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI) gjennomfører regjeringens innvandrings- og flyktningpolitikk og gir faglige innspill til utvikling av politikken. Vi skal legge til rette for lovlig innvandring og hindre misbruk av regelverket. Vi tilbyr også innkvartering til asylsøkere, og bidrar til retur av personer uten lovlig opphold. Menneskeverd, profesjonalitet og helhet er grunnleggende verdier i direktoratet. UDI ligger under Justis- og beredskapsdepartementet. Se også www.udi.no

jobs.title: Fast jobb som sykepleier i Finnmark med gode økonomiske fordeler
jobs.description:
Vil du bruke sykepleierkompetansen din der den virkelig betyr noe?

Vi rekrutterer autoriserte sykepleiere til faste stillinger i en kommune i Finnmark. Behovet er særlig innen hjemmesykepleie og institusjon, hvor pasientene er avhengige av stabile og trygge fagpersoner i hverdagen.

 

Dette er en mulighet for deg som ønsker en arbeidshverdag med nær pasientkontakt og mulighet til å følge opp over tid. Du blir en viktig del av tjenesten og får bidra til gode og helhetlige pasientforløp, samtidig som du blir en del av et lokalsamfunn hvor helsepersonell spiller en sentral rolle.

 

Helse- og omsorgstjenesten har en viktig plass i kommunen, og behovet for kvalifiserte sykepleiere er stort. Som fast ansatt vil du få en sentral rolle i et fagmiljø som legger vekt på samarbeid, kvalitet og utvikling av tjenestene. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

 

I stillingen vil du primært jobbe innen:

  • Hjemmesykepleie med oppfølging av brukere i eget hjem
  • Sykehjem eller omsorgsbolig

Arbeidshverdagen omfatter kontinuerlig pasientoppfølging, medisinhåndtering, observasjon og dokumentasjon, samt tett samarbeid med pårørende, fastleger og andre faggrupper. Du vil også bidra aktivt i kvalitetsarbeid og utvikling av lokale rutiner.

 

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Behersker et skandinavisk språk godt, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Jobber strukturert og selvstendig
  • Trives i varierte oppgaver og er trygg i møte med både akutte og langvarige pasientforløp
  • Er samarbeidsorientert og viser engasjement i møte med mennesker
  • Har førerkort klasse B

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fast 100% stilling
  • Trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Forutsigbare og gode lønns- og arbeidsvilkår
  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling innen eldreomsorg, demens, kroniske forløp og hjemmetjeneste
  • Praktisk bistand ved flytting og hjelp med bolig
  • Personlig oppfølging gjennom hele rekrutteringsprosessen

Økonomiske fordeler ved å bo og jobbe i Finnmark:

  • 3,5 % lavere skatt enn i resten av landet
  • Finnmarksfradrag på 45 000 kroner
  • Inntil 60 000 kroner årlig nedskriving av studielån
  • Ingen el-avgift på strøm
  • Gratis barnehage

Interessert?

Ta kontakt for mer informasjon, eller send inn en kort søknad!

 

Du kan også registrere din CV eller melde deg på vårt nyhetsbrev for å holde deg oppdatert om fremtidige muligheter.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dignus Medical er spesialister på rekruttering og utleie av leger, spesialister og sykepleiere til helsesektoren i Skandinavia. Vi bidrar til å løse bemanningsutfordringene ved å koble rett personell med rett oppdragsgiver – til rett tid.

jobs.title: ORGANIST/KIRKEMUSIKER 70 % fast stilling i Hemsedal sokn
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og forme musikklivet i Hemsedal?

I Hemsedal er sang og musikk en viktig del av menighetens arbeid. Vi søker en engasjert og allsidig organist/kirkemusiker som vil kombinere kirkemusikalske oppgaver med muligheten til å utvikle nye musikalske tilbud.

Hemsedal kommune ligger i Hallingdal prosti, har ca 2600 innbyggere og ligger omkranset av vakker natur. Det er muligheter for friluftsliv hele året, og du kan bo nær naturen og samtidig være en sentral del av et lokalsamfunn med stort engasjement, rikt kulturliv og en aktiv menighet. Det er god forbindelse både til Oslo og Bergen.

Hemsedal kyrkje ligger sentralt i bygda, med tilhørende gravplass. I tillegg har vi Lykkja kapell og et menighetshus, der kirkekontoret er lokalisert. Staben består i tillegg til organist, av sokneprest, kirkeverge, kirketjener, menighetspedagog, diakonimedarbeider, sekretær og renholder. Vi søker for tiden også etter en ungdomsarbeider. Vi er en relativt liten menighet og stab, men det er stor aktivitet og godt oppmøte på gudstjenester og andre aktiviteter, samt gode muligheter for å påvirke eget arbeid. Vi har også et godt samarbeid med kommunen, frivillig sentralen og andre lag og organisasjoner.

Kirkeorgelet i Hemsedal kyrkje er fra 1886, bygget av August Nilsen, og kom til Hemsedal i 1930 etter å ha bidratt til å utdanne organister ved den første profesjonelle organistutdanningen i Christiania. Orgelet ble restaurert i 2020. Det er et mekanisk orgel med 8 stemmer og 2 manualer og imponerende bred klangpalett. Vi har også godt vedlikeholdte Schimmel-pianoer i både kirken og menighetshuset, samt orgel i Lykkja kapell.

Dette får du være med på
  • Delta i planlegging og gjennomføring av gudstjenester og andre kirkelige handlinger, samtinstitusjonsandakter i samarbeid med sokneprest og andre ansatte.
  • Jobbe videre med og utvikle det musikalske livet i menigheten, i tråd med soknerådets planer, lokale behov og tradisjoner. Det kan være kor, band, forsangertjeneste, konserter, kultur- og musikkarrangementer.
  • Ansvar for kirkens instrumenter.
  • Delta i musikkrettet arbeid særlig knyttet til trosopplæring, konfirmantarbeid og menighetsbyggende arbeid både med stab og frivillige.
  • Andre arbeidsoppgaver kan være aktuelle med utgangspunkt i menighetens behov og søkerens kvalifikasjoner og interesser.

Ønsker du 100 % arbeid?

Stillingen er 70 %, men det finnes gode muligheter for frilans- og vikaroppdrag i andre sokn i Hallingdal, eller for å kombinere stillingen med annet arbeid. I Hemsedal sokn er det også ledig 30 % stilling som ungdomsarbeider.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:
  • Kirkemusikalsk eller annen relevant musikkutdanning er ønskelig. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning.
  • Allsidige orgel- og pianoferdigheter. Gjerne også andre instrumenter.
  • Kompetanse og erfaring med kor og musikalsk arbeid for barn og unge.
  • Kjennskap til norsk gudstjenestetradisjon og liturgi. Erfaring fra gudstjenesteliv og menighetsarbeid er ønskelig.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Førerkort og tilgang til egen bil
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er initiativrik, kreativ og glad i å formidle musikk.
  • Du trives med musikalsk mangfold og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder.
  • Du arbeider godt både selvstendig og sammen med andre.
  • Du er inkluderende og motiveres av å skape aktivitet sammen med frivillige, barn, unge og voksne.

Andre opplysninger

  • Det kreves medlemskap i Den norske kirke.
  • Den som tilsettes må fremlegge politiattest, jfr trossamfunnsloven §20.
  • Aktuelle søkere inviteres til intervju og prøvespilling
Hvorfor jobbe i Hemsedal sokn?

Hos oss får du stor frihet til å påvirke og utvikle det kirkemusikalske arbeidet. Vi er en liten stab med kortebeslutningsveier, mye aktivitet og tett samarbeid mellom ansatte og frivillige.

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger, frivillige medarbeidere og et godt lokalt musikkmiljø
  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag.
  • Fleksibilitet og medvirkning i planlegging av egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Lønn etter KAs tariffavtale og pensjons- og forsikringsordninger i KLP.
  • Oppstart etter avtale.
  • 6 måneders prøvetid.
  • Helge- og kveldsarbeid må påregnes

For mer informasjon:

Har du spørsmål om stillingen? Ta gjerne kontakt med kirkeverge Irene Markegård, tlf. 48 20 20 20. Mer informasjon om Hemsedal sokn finner du på www.hemsedal.kyrkja.no

Søknad med CV og relevante attester og referanser sendes Hemsedal kyrkjekontor, Hemsedalsvegen 2916, 3560 Hemsedal eller på epost til im328@kyrkja.no
