- Poskytuje prijímateľom sociálnej služby každodennú opatrovateľskú starostlivosť, praktickú podporu a primeraný dohľad podľa ich individuálnych potrieb, schopností a aktuálneho zdravotného stavu, pričom podporuje čo najvyššiu možnú mieru ich samostatnosti.
- Poskytuje pomoc, podporu alebo dohľad pri sebaobslužných činnostiach, najmä pri osobnej hygiene, starostlivosti o ústnu dutinu, vlasy a nechty, obliekaní, obúvaní, stravovaní, pitnom režime, vyprázdňovaní a používaní inkontinenčných a kompenzačných pomôcok.
- Poskytuje pomoc pri mobilite, chôdzi, vstávaní, líhaní, presunoch a polohovaní a vykonáva ďalšie opatrovateľské opatrenia v rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, individuálnych potrieb prijímateľa a pokynov oprávneného odborného pracovníka.
- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.
- V rozsahu svojej odbornej spôsobilosti, zaškolenia, poverenia a interných postupov vykonáva alebo asistuje pri meraní základných fyziologických funkcií, podporuje dodržiavanie liečebného režimu a poskytuje pomoc pri užívaní liekov iba v rozsahu dovolenom právnymi predpismi a internými postupmi.
- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežných činnostiach spojených s vedením domácnosti, najmä pri plánovaní a realizácii nákupu, príprave a podávaní jedla, umývaní riadu, upratovaní, vetraní, starostlivosti o lôžko a bielizeň, triedení odpadu a bezpečnom používaní domácich spotrebičov; ak prijímateľ činnosť nezvládne, vykoná ju v potrebnom rozsahu.
- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky
- finančný príspevok na stravu

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

    Zastupovanie vedúceho prevádzky v čase jeho neprítomnosti a podpora pri riadení prevádzky.Výhody:ubytovanie, - práca v stabilnej spoločnosti s dlhoročnou tradíciou

jobs.title: Pánski a dámski krajčíri, kožušníci a klobučníci
jobs.description: Hľadáte prácu, kde sa vaša precíznosť premení na jedinečné módne kúsky? Pre úspešnú slovenskú módnu návrhárku hľadáme šikovnú a detailne orientovanú krajčírku, ktorá má vášeň pre módu a nebojí sa krajčírskeho remesla na najvyššej úrovni.Ak radi pracujete s kvalitnými materiálmi a chcete vidieť výsledky svojej práce na prehliadkových mólach či exkluzívnych klientoch, poďte pracovať do nášho ateliéru!Náplň práce: v čom budete vynikať?•    Kompletné šitie modelov (od spoločenských šiat až po limitované každodenné kolekcie) podľa návrhov a strihových predlôh.•    Práca s luxusnými a jemnými materiálmi (hodváb, čipka, vlna, satén).•    Úprava a dopasovanie modelov priamo na mieru zákazníčkam počas skúšok.•    Spolupráca s módnou návrhárkou pri realizácii nových nápadov a detailov.•    Ručné práce a precízne finálne úpravy (našívanie aplikácií, gombíkov, začisťovanie). Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Čašníci a someliéri
jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Manager Archiving and Compliance
jobs.description:
JOB FOCUS

The incumbent is responsible for the processes on archiving completeness and transport document compliance for documents related to Global Logistics shipments. The incumbent drives process automation and process outsourcing to ensure timely and correct execution of compliance and completeness checks of transport documents.

The incumbent orchestrates and coordinates activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders to recover missing documentation and/or correct any issues identified. Stakeholder forums are set up and driven by the incumbent to focus on issue resolution and Continuous Improvement in the space of archiving completeness and documentation compliance. Leveraging digital tools and new technologies are focus areas.

Partnership is fostered with key cross-functional stakeholders impacted by or contributing to the processes in scope of the role (including amongst other Indirect Tax, Digital, Quality, Transportation, outsourced services partner and external transport service providers).

Additionally, the incumbent must ensure that the proper activities are implemented and managed in accordance with the EU GDP/GMP requirements and/or local legislation requirements (e.g. FDA, Japanese, HPRA, etc).

JOB SUMMARY - MAIN AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY / ACCOUNTABILITIES

1) Archiving completeness

  • Responsible for timely archiving completeness of commercial documents, transport documents and customs documents in OpenText for GL scope of activities
  • Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality Compliance requirements
  • Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the archiving process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)
  • Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on archiving activities
  • Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders in ensuring archiving completeness
  • Maintains and reports on performance metrics
  • Establishes and runs processes ensuring correctness of archived documentation

2) Transport documentation compliance

  • Designs and orchestrates the process for conducting compliance checks of transport documents
  • Ensures alignment of archiving process scope with evolving GL scope and Quality compliance requirements
  • Monitors and manages performance of outsourced service provider on transport document compliance checks
  • Coordinates escalations and provides resolution to challenges escalated following the IMEX and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Drives the conversation with Digital on the performance and enhancements of the App supporting the transport document compliance checks process and leveraging new technologies (e.g. AI)
  • Orchestrates actions and assures accountability of internal and external stakeholders to ensure completeness and full compliance
  • Maintains and reports on performance metrics

3) Stakeholder Management

  • Sets up, participates and drives stakeholder conver...

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Level of Education: Bachelor's Degree in Administration, university degree or equivalent by experience
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years experience in transport or supply chain operations. Comprehension of financial and logistics flows inherent to the pharma industry. Knowledge on customs regulations would be a plus.
  • Languages: Proficient in English (verbal and written); other languages are a benefit
  • Computer skills: Broad PC skills are essential (MS applications Outlook, Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint). Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES – PERSONAL CAPABILITIES

  • Analytical and problem solving skills
  • Pro-active mindset on problem solving and gap assessment
  • Affinity with establishing structure, documentation management and compliance principles
  • Proven track record driving positive change in a complex environment
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills based on facts, data and understanding of the regulatory requirement in complex and evolving environments; must be able to apply sound risk management
  • Ability to prioritize, quickly synthesize information and apply regulatory requirements to a variety of scenarios
  • Must exercise excellent judgement, make decisions based on a clear understanding of the regulatory framework, deploying strategies to conduct compliant business
  • Excellent verbal and written business communication, as well as strong organizational, project management, analytical and negotiation skills
  • Good communication skills and relationship builder with internal and external stakeholders

jobs.title: Management & Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?

Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!

As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.

But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail.

You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.

The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.

No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!

Your responsibilities cover two main areas.

Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes

  • You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.
  • You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.
  • You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.
  • You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.
  • You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.
  • You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.
  • You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.
  • When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.

Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!

Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.

This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.

  • You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.
  • You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.
  • You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.
  • You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.
  • You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.
  • You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.
  • You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.

And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.

No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.

We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.

Does this sound like you?

  • Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.
  • You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.
  • You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.
  • Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.
  • You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.
  • You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.
  • You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!

What else do you bring?

  • A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.
  • Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.
  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.
  • A valid category B driving licence.

And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.

You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

jobs.title: Venture Develoment Intern (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity

At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. Now, we are looking to build our next major growth engine.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Venture Development Intern to join the Office of the COO. You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up.

Think of this as a founder’s associate role for an internal startup: you will turn an ambiguous opportunity into actionable hypotheses, run experiments and help build the business case for launch. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action.

Duration: Fixed-term, full-time internship for a minimum of 3 months and up to 6 months.

What you will do

  • Discover and validate: Research markets and competitors, speak with potential customers and design experiments to test customer needs, demand and key assumptions.

  • Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale.

  • Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams.

  • Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities.

  • Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board.

  • Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed.

Academic collaboration

If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements.

Who you are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook.

  • AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer.

  • Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning.

  • Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story.

  • Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model.

  • Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English.

  • Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.

What we offer

  • C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making.

  • Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process.

  • Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building.

  • A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors.

  • An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup.

If you are excited to combine structured thinking, AI tools and a founder’s mindset to help build what comes next at Taxfix, we would love to hear from you.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team.

Team Optimize turns decision history into better decisions. We build the systems customers use to evaluate, monitor and improve their decision flows and agents.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll build the backend systems and APIs behind them. Your work directly moves approval rates, false positive rates, and how confidently customers ship changes.

At scale, the systems you build will:

  • Process millions of decisions per day

  • Persist and query terabytes of data per day

  • Execute large-scale experiments over billions of historical decisions

  • Power agentic features such as natural-language analytics and automated optimization of flows and agents (Taktile AI)

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate backend services in Python / FastAPI on AWS serverless infrastructure.

  • Contribute to the design of high-scale subsystems operating on historical decision data, and deliver features end-to-end, from implementation and testing to deployment and monitoring

  • Write well-tested, reliable code and contribute to code reviews

  • Work with Product and senior engineers to turn business problems into well-scoped technical work

  • Operate in a high-leverage environment where AI-assisted and agentic coding are embedded into daily workflows, with access to state-of-the-art coding models (e.g., Claude Code) and the autonomy to use them deeply while maintaining strong engineering standards.

Requirements

  • 3+ years building production backend systems, with experience delivering moderately complex projects or features.

  • Comfort working with large datasets.

  • Prior industry experience with Python.

  • Experience with a major cloud provider, AWS preferred.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Location: Berlin (hybrid setup). Taktile will not cover relocation services for this role.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Experience with building AI native applications

  • Experience with large-scale data technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Athena, Spark, or similar.

  • Experience with AWS serverless architectures (Lambda, SAM, Step Functions).

  • Familiarity with system design concepts and architectural trade-offs.

  • Experience with React and TypeScript.

  • Exposure to fraud, AML, risk, or financial decisioning domains.

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About us

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

Taktile is based in Berlin, London and New York City. It was founded by machine learning and data science veterans with extensive experience building and running production ML in financial services. Our team consists of engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers with a diverse set of backgrounds. Some of us attended top universities such as Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford and some of us have no degree at all. We have accumulated extensive work experience at leading tech companies, startups, and the enterprise software sphere.

Our backers include Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and stellar angels such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog and UiPath.

jobs.title: People Operations Specialist | French Market | (Paris)
jobs.description:
Lexroom construit la plateforme d’IA sur laquelle s’effectue le travail juridique. En un peu plus de deux ans, nous sommes passés de zéro à 25 M€ d’ARR, et aujourd’hui plus de 20 000 professionnels du droit en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France et en Bulgarie s’appuient sur Lexroom.
Nous avons levé 73 M$ auprès de Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners et Eurazeo, et nous sommes une équipe d’environ 300 builders qui avancent vite, disent les choses franchement et assument chaque résultat.
Notre prochain objectif ? Devenir le produit juridique le plus utilisé en Europe.

Pourquoi Lexroom ?

  • Définir les standards : rejoignez l’équipe qui fixe la référence de l’IA juridique en Europe.

  • Travailler avec les meilleurs : collaborez avec des collègues d’exception, dans une culture qui valorise la compétence, la curiosité et l’ambition.

  • Avoir un impact concret : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les professionnels du droit exercent leur métier, plus rapidement, plus clairement et plus efficacement.

Chez Lexroom, nous laissons les buzzwords de côté. Ici, vous construirez quelque chose de durable : une plateforme de confiance, une solide réputation et un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique.

Le poste
En tant que People Operations Specialist pour la France, vous serez l’interlocuteur de référence de nos équipes parisiennes. Vous prendrez en charge l’ensemble des aspects opérationnels de l’expérience collaborateur, du premier contrat à la paie mensuelle, en veillant à ce que tout fonctionne de manière fiable, conforme et fluide au fil de notre croissance. Lexroom connaît une expansion rapide à travers l’Europe, et la France est l’un de nos marchés stratégiques. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe People à un moment clé, pour construire les fondations sur lesquelles notre équipe française pourra se développer.

Vos responsabilités

  • Être le référent People en France : devenir l’interlocuteur RH de confiance de nos équipes parisiennes, répondre aux demandes avec réactivité et clarté, tout en sachant dire non lorsque c’est nécessaire.

  • Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs : des contrats à l’onboarding en passant par les avantages sociaux, garantir que chaque étape soit fiable, conforme et fluide.

  • Assurer le bon fonctionnement des opérations : prendre en charge les éléments variables de paie et les données RH, en collaboration avec nos prestataires externes, pour une fiabilité irréprochable, mois après mois.

  • Construire un cadre de conformité évolutif : travailler avec nos conseillers juridiques pour mettre en place les standards adaptés à la France, au rythme de la croissance de nos effectifs.

  • Automatiser ce qui nous ralentit : utiliser l’IA, HiBob et les données pour réduire les tâches manuelles et construire les tableaux de bord qui aident l’équipe People à décider plus vite.

Profil recherché

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en People Operations, HR Operations ou en tant que généraliste RH, avec une pratique concrète des contrats, de l’onboarding et de la paie. Votre potentiel et votre motivation comptent davantage que le nombre d’années d’expérience.

  • De solides bases en droit du travail français : vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la législation sociale et avez déjà géré directement des contrats, des intégrations et des départs, idéalement avec une paie externalisée.

  • À l’aise avec les données et l’IA : les SIRH n’ont pas de secret pour vous, et vous repérez instinctivement les tâches répétitives qui pourraient être automatisées.

  • Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se) : vous savez gérer des échéances récurrentes, comme la paie mensuelle, sans rien laisser passer.

  • Proactif(ve) et résilient(e) : vous anticipez les besoins et agissez avant qu’un collaborateur n’ait à se plaindre.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit : français (langue maternelle) et anglais courant (C1 minimum). L’italien est un plus, sans être obligatoire.

  • Atouts supplémentaires : une connaissance de HiBob ou d’outils RH et de paie similaires, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le secteur juridique (aucune formation juridique requise).

Perspectives d’évolution
Ce poste repose sur la profondeur et la responsabilisation, pas sur une échelle hiérarchique. À mesure que notre équipe française grandit et que de nouveaux marchés s’ouvrent, votre périmètre évoluera avec elle. Vous contribuerez à définir la manière dont les People Operations fonctionnent sur un nouveau marché et travaillerez aux côtés d’un nouveau Head of People Operations. Vous développerez aussi une expertise très recherchée en paie, conformité et automatisation.

Ce qui nous distingue
Une équipe d’exception
Chez Lexroom, vous travaillerez aux côtés des meilleurs talents de la tech et de l’IA juridique. Nos équipes agissent avec sens et autonomie, pour que chaque contribution produise des résultats visibles. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes qui allient innovation et rigueur, curiosité et discipline, ambition et profondeur.

Une croissance qui compte
Nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour faire la différence, et nous leur donnons l’espace pour mener. Votre travail façonnera l’avenir de la legal tech et fixera de nouveaux standards pour le secteur. L’impact se mesure à la vision et à l’exécution, pas à l’âge ni au titre. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à prendre des responsabilités, vous trouverez de vraies opportunités de grandir et de piloter des projets à fort enjeu.

Valoriser votre contribution
Nous valorisons l’excellence et partageons le succès :

  • Rémunération : 30 000 – 45 000 € brut annuel

  • Equity : alignez votre évolution sur le succès à long terme de l’entreprise.

Des avantages qui comptent

  • Travail hybride : un équilibre entre télétravail et collaboration en présentiel dans nos bureaux à Paris (quartier du Marais)

  • Mutuelle Alan

  • Titres-restaurant

  • Accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être)

  • Team retreats & off-sites : des moments dédiés pour se retrouver, collaborer et faire naître des idées audacieuses.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien avec l’un de nos Talent Acquisition (45 min)

  2. Entretien manager avec Riccardo, notre Head of People (60 min)

  3. Mise en situation via un cas concret (45 min)

  4. Entretien final de culture fit (30 min)

  5. Offre

Chez Lexroom, l’ambition rencontre la discipline et le sens. Nous ne construisons pas seulement un produit : nous définissons un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à contribuer à quelque chose de durable et porteur de sens, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous.

Compensation: €30K – €45K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development:

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Internal and external group training

  • Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events:

  • Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

  • Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work:

  • 2-3 days in-office per week

  • Up to €500 reimbursed for remote work equipment

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day

🍴 Meal vouchers (Tickets restaurants): Swile card with about 220€ per month

👀 Social & Economic Committee (Comité d’entreprise): Enjoy several benefits with HelloCSE

👩‍⚕️Health:

  • Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children

  • Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide

🚆 Commute: Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Flexible return to work options

  • Help for parents with children up to 6 years old: Either 4 days of fully paid sick-child leave, or, up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

🌳 Sustainability engagements:

  • Certified B-Corp since 2022, which means we not only care about profit, but also about people and the planet

  • Our founders pledged to invest 10 million euros in social and environmental solutions

  • Volunteer days: A paid working day where UpSliders volunteer to a charitable cause

  • Annual veggie lunch: A catered lunch with plant-based foods to raise awareness on the environmental impact of meat consumption and highlight a sustainable alternative

More about UpSlide

  • On top of exciting business challenges in a fast-growing market, you will find a friendly, caring, and challenging culture

  • You will be met with opportunities to acquire new skills, learn from others in a multicultural environment, and grow as a person

  • UpSlide employees have committed to making a positive impact on the world. We obtained B Corp certification in 2022 with strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. UpSlide is now 30% owned by employees. More info here: upslide.net/en/from-a-to-b-corp-our-mission-for-positive-impact/

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you've joined UpSlide ✨

jobs.title: IT Architect - Business Domain
jobs.description:
Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein. 

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten. 
 
Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein: 
 
- Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes. 
- Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering. 
- Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes. 
- Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten. 
- Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen. 
- Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten. 


Wat vragen we van jou?

- Wo werk- en denkniveau. 
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen. 
- Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-, BPM- en AI en dataplatformen en maatwerkontwikkeling. 
- Ervaring met applicatie-integratie, API’s en gegevensstromen; je kunt technische ontwerpen doorgronden en hierover inhoudelijk adviseren. 
- Vermogen om businessvragen te vertalen naar uitvoerbare ontwerpen, concrete aanbevelingen en heldere afwegingen tussen oplossingsrichtingen. 
- Een praktische, verbindende werkwijze: je schakelt makkelijk tussen businessstakeholders, ontwikkelaars en leveranciers, maakt complexe keuzes begrijpelijk en wordt een teamspeler binnen het architectuurteam. 
- Ervaring met het vastleggen van architectuur en ontwerpbesluiten, bijvoorbeeld met ArchiMate en TOGAF of vergelijkbare methoden; bruikbaarheid staat voorop. 
- Ervaring met Pega BPM is een pré. 
- Ervaring binnen pensioenen, verzekeringen of andere gereguleerde sectoren is een pré. 

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een NS Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

jobs.title: Receptionist Hotel | Floreal Blankenberge | Voltijds
jobs.description:
Bij Floreal Blankenberge ontvangen we gasten die komen genieten van een weekendje aan zee, een gezinsvakantie of een seminarie. Geen dag is hetzelfde, maar een warm welkom en een aangenaam verblijf staan altijd centraal.

Als Hotelreceptionist ben jij een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten. Je ontvangt hen vriendelijk, helpt hen graag verder en zorgt ervoor dat alles aan de receptie vlot verloopt. Je combineert persoonlijk gastencontact met administratie, reservaties en commerciële ondersteuning.

Hou jij van mensen helpen, werk je graag georganiseerd en zoek je een afwisselende job in een levendige vakantieomgeving? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

Een blik achter de schermen van jouw rol

Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat onze gasten zich van aankomst tot vertrek welkom voelen.

  • Onthaal van gasten: je verwelkomt onze gasten, verzorgt de check-in en check-out en maakt hen wegwijs in ons vakantiecentrum.

  • Informatie en gastenservice: je beantwoordt vragen over onze faciliteiten en activiteiten en geeft tips over Blankenberge en omgeving. Loopt er iets niet zoals verwacht? Dan luister je en zoek je naar een passende oplossing.

  • Administratie en reservaties: je beantwoordt telefoons en e-mails, verwerkt reservaties, stelt afrekeningen op en volgt betalingen correct op.

  • Extra diensten: je helpt bij restaurantreservaties en informeert gasten over diensten die hun verblijf nog aangenamer kunnen maken.

  • Commerciële ondersteuning: je helpt bij de opmaak en opvolging van offertes voor groepen en seminaries en ondersteunt bij de administratie en facturatie.

  • Communicatie: je houdt informatie voor onze gasten actueel via onder andere sociale media, onze Floreal-app en interne informatiekanalen.

Je krijgt dus een veelzijdige functie waarin persoonlijk contact, administratie en organisatie elkaar afwisselen.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een collega die graag met mensen werkt, vriendelijk communiceert en belang hecht aan een goede service. Je houdt van afwisseling en zorgt ervoor dat gasten en collega's op je kunnen rekenen.

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Je hebt ervaring als receptionist in de hotellerie en bent vertrouwd met een gastgerichte werkomgeving.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt zowel Nederlands als Frans zeer goed, zodat je onze gasten in beide talen vlot kunt verder helpen.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en georganiseerd. Administratie, reservaties en de opvolging van dossiers zijn bij jou in goede handen.

  • Je bent vriendelijk, communicatief en denkt in oplossingen. Ook op drukke momenten blijf je rustig en behoud je het overzicht.

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's, maar kunt ook zelfstandig werken en verantwoordelijkheid opnemen.

  • Je neemt initiatief, denkt mee en staat open om nieuwe zaken bij te leren.

  • Je bent bereid om in wisselende shifts (07.00-15.00/14.00-22.00) te werken, ook tijdens weekends en op zon- en feestdagen.

Bij Floreal Holidays kom je terecht in een veelzijdige vakantieomgeving waar gastvrijheid, samenwerking en respect centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, je ervaring in te zetten en verder bij te leren.

Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur binnen een gevestigde organisatie.

  • Een marktconform loonpakket, aangevuld met ecocheques en een eindejaarspremie.

  • Een hospitalisatieverzekering na één jaar in dienst.

  • Een kilometer- en/of fietsvergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer.

  • Toegang tot Benefits@Work, een platform met personeelsvoordelen en kortingen.

  • Voordeeltarieven bij de verschillende vakantiebestemmingen van Floreal Group.

  • Interne opleidingsmogelijkheden en kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Een afwisselende job waarin je dagelijks nieuwe mensen ontmoet en ruimte krijgt om mee te denken.

jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager DevOps (GCP/Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on:

We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers.

What’s unique about management at Miaplaza:

Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice:

  1. You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important.

  2. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer.

  3. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you.

  4. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports' work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output.

  5. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students.


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which:

    • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which:

  • 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred)

  • 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations

  • Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD)

  • Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems

What makes you stand out:

Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

Experience with consumer platforms at scale

Experience building in regulated environments

Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry)

Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments

Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ)

Experience with Istio or other service meshes

Responsibilities

  • Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability

  • Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work

  • Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  • Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update.

  • Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You'll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role.

  • Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far.

  • 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work.

  • Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team's engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them.

  • Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership.

  • Reference check - We'll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports.

  • Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we'll run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams

Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces.

Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product.

Jouw impact als Product Owner

Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten.

Wat je doet

  • Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt.

  • Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang.

  • Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX.

  • Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten.

  • Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang.

  • Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden.

Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten.

Wie ben jij?

Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen


Wat je meebrengt

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS

  • Je hebt een 'AI-first' mindset en gebruikt AI (zoals Claude) handig voor het ontwikkelen van prototypes en het opzetten van features.

  • Je hebt meerdere squads tegelijk begeleid in een multidisciplinaire omgeving met development, design en business

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en durft nee te zeggen als het product daar beter van wordt

  • Je werkt vanzelfsprekend agile (Scrum of Kanban) en kent tools als Jira of Productboard

  • Je beslist op basis van data en klantinzichten, niet op onderbuikgevoel

  • Je woont in of rondom Utrecht en werkt minimaal 3 dagen per week op ons kantoor

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring)

  • Een duidelijk groeipad naar Senior Product Owner

  • Bij contractverlening de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een aandelenregeling

  • Een MacBook en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen

  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

  • Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day: 10%, waarvan wij 50% bijdragen

  • Een jaarlijks persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 (o.b.v. fulltime)

  • Een ambitieuze, internationale werkomgeving (meer dan 7 culturen!) waar we elkaar scherp houden én successen vieren

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.description:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.
