jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description:
About Proxima

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

About You:

Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality.

Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models.

Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas.

We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems and have a track record of achievement. At Proxima, we believe that success is determined by talent and hard work, and individuals are given equal opportunities to grow and advance based on their abilities and contributions.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop pilot capabilities and create large-scale data pipelines from the ground up 

  • Collaborate with other teams across Proxima and partnering organizations to achieve project goals by contributing code, analyses, benchmarks, optimizations and ideas to ongoing research-driven projects

  • Integrate biological insights into the next generation of AI/ML models for drug discovery

  • Validate and interpret computational predictions by working closely with experimentalists 

 Basic Qualifications:

  • Hold an MSc or PhD degree in computational biology, bioinformatics or a related field

  • Possess mixed academic and/or industrial experience, preferably in the biotech industry

  • Have a strong background in computational structural or systems biology

  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in Python, R and/or other languages

  • Experience building reproducible and scalable computational biology workflows

  • Experience designing and applying machine learning models

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with geometric deep learning, graph neural networks, protein language models, transformers and representation learning is a plus

  • Preferably have prior exposure to drug discovery problems

  • Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure

  • Agile project management

Full-Time Employees at Proxima enjoy these Perks*:

  • Highly competitive salaries

  • Company Equity Package, everyone is a stakeholder!

  • 401(k) + Company Match

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

  • 13 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

  • Maternity leave 18 Weeks of fully paid leave + 6 weeks for Paternity leave

  • In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

*for US based FTEs, country specific benefits apply for locations outside US

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Mission freelance de 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027, à Paris 9e.

🎯 La mission

Quand un vendeur ou un agent partenaire vend un bien hors du cadre contractuel de son mandat Zefir, la squad Protect le détecte, le prouve, puis transforme ce manquement en cash encaissé, avec l'équipe Sales Zefir et nos avocats partenaires. Tu leads cette squad.

La squad est jeune et en pleine construction : elle est passée de 0 € à plus de 100 000 € de chiffre d'affaires en 3 mois, et l'objectif est d'atteindre 500 000 € par mois d'ici la fin du S1 2027. Les premiers outils et process tournent déjà, mais l'essentiel reste à bâtir, et c'est toi qui t'en charges.

🛠️ Ce que tu feras

Ton rôle s'articule autour de quatre axes :

1. Lead la squad Protect

  • Pilotage : suivre la performance de toute la chaîne, de la détection des fraudes au cash encaissé, côté Sales comme côté avocats. Repérer ce qui décroche et porter les plans d'action.

  • Weekly : préparer et animer le weekly d'équipe : chiffres de la semaine, points bloquants, décisions à prendre.

  • OKR : définir chaque trimestre les objectifs et les résultats clés de la squad.

2. Générer du pipe de recouvrement

  • Run : chaque jour, revoir les ventes détectées par nos outils et décider s'il faut demander les documents officiels, comme l'acte de vente. Puis revoir les actes reçus et, à partir de l'analyse produite par nos outils, décider d'enclencher ou non le recouvrement par nos équipes.

  • Build : automatiser chaque étape qui peut l'être, pour que le funnel opère en totale autonomie (ex : automatiser le traitement des réponses du service de publicité foncière reçues par email).

  • Pilotage : t'assurer que le funnel tourne et qu'aucun dossier ne reste bloqué à une étape. Quand ça bloque, tu investigues, tu trouves la cause et tu la corriges.

3. Convertir le pipe avec l'équipe Sales Zefir

  • Build : donner à l'équipe Sales des dossiers prêts à travailler : analyse juridique, brief d'appel, mises en demeure, suivi des échéanciers. Automatiser des tâches qu'ils font aujourd'hui manuellement pour augmenter leur productivité (ex : automatiser la rédaction et l'envoi des mises en demeure).

  • Pilotage : suivre chaque semaine avec l'équipe la conversion des dossiers en protocoles signés et le cash encaissé. Repérer les indicateurs qui décrochent et proposer un plan d'action.

4. Convertir le pipe avec nos avocats

  • Run : être l'interlocuteur de nos deux cabinets. Chaque semaine, tu tiens un point avec chacun pour revoir le pipe dossier par dossier. Entre deux points, tu fournis les pièces demandées et tu rends les arbitrages de Zefir : plancher de négociation, assignation, classement, etc. Tu comprends aussi leurs enjeux, leurs irritants et ce qui les bloque, pour améliorer nos process avec eux.

  • Build : faire évoluer l'outil de suivi partagé avec les cabinets (ex : relances automatiques, to-do priorisée, etc.).

  • Pilotage : suivre les délais, la conversion et les coûts de chaque cabinet, et les challenger chaque semaine. Comme pour la partie Sales, tu repères les indicateurs qui décrochent et tu proposes un plan d'action.

Partout, tu construis vite, en MVP, avec Claude Code, Lovable, Pipedream et BigQuery.

🙋 Profil recherché

On cherche un profil Ops builder : quelqu'un qui aime partir d'une page blanche, mettre les mains dans le cambouis, puis construire les process et les automatiser.

  • Une expérience dans un rôle Ops où tu as construit toi-même un process ou un outil de zéro, idéalement en start-up.

  • Le goût du terrain : tu traites toi-même les premiers dossiers pour comprendre le problème avant de l'automatiser.

  • Une vraie autonomie dans l'ambiguïté : peu de cadre, des priorités qui bougent, et c'est toi qui poses la structure.

  • Une rigueur à toute épreuve et une organisation solide, pour mener plusieurs chantiers de front sans en lâcher aucun.

  • Le goût de la performance : on se fixe des objectifs ambitieux, et tu fais tout pour les atteindre.

💰 Modalités

  • Démarrage : 1er février 2027.

  • Durée : 7 mois, du 1er février au 25 août 2027.

  • Lieu : Paris 9e, bureaux du Peletier.

  • Rémunération : TJM à 450 € HT.

  • Processus : un échange avec Constance, qui occupe le poste aujourd'hui, puis avec Arthus de Torquat, Lead Operations.

jobs.title: Head of Data - BeReal
jobs.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1,000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta.

Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life.

We are now an international team of 100+ people with 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Data is becoming increasingly central to how we build the product, understand our users and make decisions. We are looking for a Head of Data to own the function end to end and build the foundations required for the next stage of BeReal's growth.

 

Role

You will lead a team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts, reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. BeReal deliberately operates with small, strong teams, and we are looking for someone who can define the direction while still going deep technically: reviewing architecture and data models, investigating quality issues, challenging pipelines, writing queries and building when necessary.

You should be the kind of leader who could design a modern data platform from scratch, scale it as the company grows, and make sure the people using it can trust what comes out of it.

 

What you'll own

  • Build and evolve the data platform. Own BeReal's data architecture end to end: ingestion, storage, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability and access. Build a platform that is simple, scalable, reliable and cost-efficient as both traffic and the number of data consumers grow.

  • Make data trustworthy. Raise the standard of data quality across the company through clear sources of truth, ownership, testing, monitoring, lineage and consistent metric definitions. Identify inconsistencies proactively and build systems that prevent them from recurring.

  • Data modeling and foundations. Define how our core entities, events and business concepts are represented across the warehouse. Build models that are reliable, understandable and maintainable as the product evolves.

  • Decisions, not dashboards. Turn large, complex user-level datasets into clear insights and recommendations that Product, Growth and leadership can act on. Help teams distinguish meaningful signals from noise and focus on the questions that matter.

  • Product analytics and experimentation. Own the methodology around instrumentation, Amplitude usage, event tracking, metric design and A/B testing. Ensure experiments are designed and interpreted rigorously and that product decisions are grounded in reliable data.

  • Make data self-service. Give Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership the tools and models they need to answer most questions independently, without creating a dependency on the Data team for every request.

  • AI-powered data access. Build or integrate practical ways for employees to interact with company data through AI (agents, bots, natural-language analytics and automated workflows) while maintaining strong standards around accuracy, permissions and governance.

  • Stakeholder management and prioritisation. Serve as the primary data partner to C-level executives and teams across Product, Growth and Engineering. Understand their needs, challenge requests when necessary, arbitrate between competing priorities and translate them into a coherent, high-impact data roadmap.

  • Technical leadership. Set strong engineering and analytics standards across the function. Review architecture, pipelines, models and queries, challenge technical choices and remain close enough to the work to intervene directly when needed.

  • Build the team. Lead, mentor and hire across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and Data Analytics. Establish clear ownership, develop the people in the team and raise the technical and analytical bar.

     

Our Data Stack

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Spanner.

  • Orchestration & transformation: Airflow, dbt.

  • Product analytics: Amplitude.

  • Visualisation & analytics: Hex, Tableau, internal tools.

This is our current stack, not a constraint. You will have significant latitude to simplify, rationalise and evolve it when there is a strong reason to do so.

 

Profile

  • 8+ years in data, with deep roots in Data or Analytics Engineering, or data architecture.

  • A hands-on builder: you’ve designed, built and run modern data platforms, ideally from scratch, and know how architecture evolves with scale.

  • Strong across the stack (warehousing, ingestion, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability), with strong SQL and enough depth to challenge production pipelines and models.

  • Deep data quality expertise: testing, monitoring, lineage, ownership and source-of-truth design.

  • Experience with high-volume, user-level data and with building self-service analytics for non-data teams.

  • Solid in experimentation and A/B testing. Mobile experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on with AI in data workflows (LLMs, agents, natural-language analytics), and a clear view of where it really adds value.

  • Strong stakeholder management and business judgment: you turn vague needs from Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership into clear metrics and a roadmap.

  • You’ve led data people or are ready to own a multidisciplinary team. This can be your first Head of Data role.

  • You ship fast, favour ownership and pragmatism over process, and explain complex topics clearly to anyone, founders included.

  • English is our working language. French is a plus.

 

Experience with Data Science or production Machine Learning is valuable but not a prerequisite for the role.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Swile lunch vouchers.

  • Gymlib, 100% covered by Voodoo.

  • Premium SideCare healthcare coverage for you and your family, 100% covered by Voodoo.

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office.

Role Outcome

We are seeking a European Events Field Marketing Lead to own the strategy, planning, and execution of events and programs that builds Point One's presence, pipeline, and aligns with our brand across the region. This is a hands-on, execution-first role combining regional market insight, program management discipline, and hustle.

You will work directly with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success to identify the highest-leverage events, conferences, and customer gatherings across Europe, then run each one end to end — from strategy and budget through booth design, booth experience, speaker placement, and post-event pipeline handoff. You will serve as the region's on-the-ground marketing owner, translating market knowledge into a calendar of events that generates qualified pipeline and reinforces Point One as the category leader in precise location.

The ultimate outcome of this role is a European field program that reliably converts marketing spend into qualified pipeline and secondarily supports brand visibility, and customer engagement — planned and executed with minimal oversight.

Success in this role is measured by volume and quality of pipeline generated from events (virtual and in person). Events, sponsorships, and field activity with prospects, customers or partners are the means to achieve these results, not the end in themselves.

Immediate Areas of Focus

Event Strategy & Calendar Ownership

  • Own the European event calendar — identify, prioritize, and select the conferences, trade shows, and customer events that best support pipeline and brand goals.

  • Build the business case for each event: audience fit, expected pipeline, cost, and ROI — and defend that case against a limited budget.

  • Continuously evaluate the regional event landscape and reallocate investment toward what's working.

End-to-End Logistics & Operational Execution

  • Run every logistical element of an event — booth and sponsorship design, shipping, staffing, collateral, signage, and on-site coordination — while in alignment with centralized dedicated events, brand, and product teams.

  • Coordinate speaking opportunities, demos, and customer meetings on-site to maximize the value of each event.

  • Manage vendors, venues, and local partners across multiple European countries and languages.

Pipeline & Follow-Through & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Bring strong operational rigor by partnering with marketing, business development and sales to ensure every event has clear pre-event outreach, on-site lead capture, and post-event follow-up.

  • Track and report pipeline generated, cost per lead, and event ROI back to the business. Align activity with central processes and reporting, working with Marketing Ops team.

  • Close the loop with Sales and Customer Success to make sure event-sourced leads convert.

Regional Brand & Field Presence

  • Align Point One's brand and reputation across Europe through field presence, local press, partner co-marketing, and customer-facing moments.

  • Identify opportunities to bring partners, customers and prospects together outside of large industry events — dinners, roundtables, and regional meetups.

  • Act as the local voice of the brand, adapting global messaging for European markets and customers.

  • Act as the bridge between European Sales and the global Marketing and Product teams.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation roles, with direct ownership of event strategy and execution in a high growth start up environment

  • Track record of running high-impact events and conferences from planning through pipeline delivery, with a scrappy DIY culture.

  • Comfortable owning budget, ROI reporting, and vendor negotiation independently.

  • Experience marketing to technical or engineering audiences.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple concurrent events across countries and time zones.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% across Europe.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing into robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, drones, industrial automation, or federal technologies.

  • Fluency in a second European language in addition to English.

  • Experience building a European field marketing

  • Experience working closely with sales in a B2B, enterprise, or deep-tech sales motion. GNSS experience appreciated but not required.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

  • Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

  • No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply below and join us in shaping the future of precise location.

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines.

What you'll do

  • You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation.

  • Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny.

  • Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data

  • You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous.

You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers.

Must have

  • PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus.

  • Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening…

  • Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers.

  • Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology.

  • Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result.

  • Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack.

  • Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English.

Nice to have

  • Strong experience working with experimentalists.

  • Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either.

  • Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs).

  • Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks.

  • Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes.

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster.

This is a role where you are expected to be in the lab, talk to scientists and lab technicians on a day-to-day basis. You will see how science is done in the lab, and then think hard about how to improve its impact. If you’re excited by complex workflows and the friction of real-life lab work, as well the power of data and AI, this position is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the lab-based data generation pipelines: to enable data transfer at scale from the lab to the cloud. This will involve building and improving production codebases that turn high-throughput experimental readouts into validated insights.

  • Facilitate lab operations : Maintain and/or build tools to accelerate the work of Orakl Oncology scientists.

  • Define and own the canonical data model: Design the unified data model that structures our data and is adopted across teams, ensuring data can be joined across modalities: experimental, clinical, omics, and clinical-trial event reporting.

  • Design and own data quality pipeline: Build QC that flags data quality at transfer time, and turn it into feedback loops so scientists can spot experimental errors early and integrate checks into their routine.

  • Support lab initiatives: such as automation initiatives, the development of experimental tooling to help lab scientists and technicians.

  • Drive operational efficiency: make sure that wet lab work is optimized to benefit the most from our resources (human and experimental) and ensure efficient contract and research delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining Python code in production

  • Strong hacker and tinkerer mindset. You like building things that have a real world effects.

  • Excellent proficiency in Python and SQL, and solid data-engineering skills: pipeline design and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent), version control (Git), testing/CI, and observability.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data-storage best practices.

  • Comfortable working with noisy, real-world experimental data and directly alongside non-technical scientists.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with experimental, assay, or high-throughput screening data.

  • Working knowledge of biology, ideally in oncology, cell biology, or drug discovery.

  • Experience with image analysis / computer vision applied to microscopy data.

  • Familiarity with lab data systems / LIMS (e.g. Benchling) and experimental workflows.

Who You Are

  • Curious and autonomous: you dig into scientists' bottlenecks, connect the dots across teams, and ship without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • A fast shipper: you get working solutions into production and iterate, rather than polishing in isolation.

  • A strong communicator: you gather needs from and explain your work to non-technical scientists, acting as the data bridge across the lab and beyond.

  • At ease in a complex and interdisciplinary environment: you thrive with messy data, evolving priorities, and external constraints that come with a science-first, non-pure-tech setting.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own the wet-lab data backbone of a techbio platform from the ground up: your work directly shapes how we discover and validate cancer therapies.

Gestione criticità: supporto ai controllori di processo in caso di problematiche alla pressa; applicazione di azioni correttive su non conformità. Passaggio consegne: supporto al responsabile reparto nel trasferimento informazioni tra turni. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza nel ruolo di capoturno (valutabile anche provenienza da settori diversi). Leadership e gestione team: autorevolezza nel far rispettare le regole, equilibrio relazionale, visione d'insieme e attenzione alle criticità. Autonomia organizzativa: capacità di gestire imprevisti e definire priorità operative. Orientamento al miglioramento continuo: collaborazione nella ricerca di soluzioni e proposta azioni correttive. Ordine e pulizia come standard di lavoro. Informatica di base: utilizzo PC e principali applicativi d'ufficio. Requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza base inglese. Esperienza nel settore stampaggio. jobs.title: addetto alla pianificazione acquisti/addetta alla pianificazione acquisti
jobs.description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. jobs.title: meccanico di precisione
jobs.description: Ti piace lavorare con precisione su impianti di automazione, interpretando schemi elettrici e intervenendo per garantirne il corretto funzionamento? Vuoi crescere mettendo in pratica le tue competenze tecniche tra collaudo e avviamento? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante realtà industriale specializzata nella progettazione e realizzazione di impianti di automazione industriale, con clienti a livello internazionale, per potenziamento organico, è alla ricerca di un/una Service Automation Engineer Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza e passione per l'automazione industriale, autonomo nelle attività di collaudo e commissioning, con spiccate capacità di problem solving e una naturale predisposizione al lavoro in squadra. Requisiti - Diploma tecnico con almeno 2-3 anni di comprovata esperienza nel settore dell'automazione industriale Attività previste (dopo periodo formativo): - Collaudo interno di impianti di automazione industriale. - Testing e validazione di software PLC e Robot. - Commissioning e avviamento presso il cliente. - Ricerca guasti e problem solving su impianti installati. - Supporto tecnico da remoto ai clienti. - Interventi di assistenza tecnica e service on-site. - Formazione e affiancamento del personale del cliente durante le attività di avviamento. - Collaborazione con i reparti Software, Elettrico e Meccanico per la risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche. - Redazione di report di intervento. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). UNIVERSITY

The Department of Biotechnology and Food Science, Institute of Computational Biology is

currently seeking a 1 Postdoctoral Research Associate (Reference code 204)

Extent of employment: 40 hours per week

Duration of employment: 1st of March 2027, limited to 30th of September 2029

Workplace: 1190 Vienna

Allocation in compliance with the Collective Agreement for University Staff to job group:

B1 lit. b

Gross monthly salary: (depending on previous eligible experience) at least: € 5.079,50

(payable 14 times per year)

Responsibilities

º Scientific research in bioinformatics, genomics, and evolution of crop plants and their

wild relatives, supporting and extending current research lines of the Institute of

Computational Biology

º Preparation of scientific publications, presentations at conferences and seminars

º Participation in grant writing

º Supporting the group's computing infrastructure, databases, and services

º Teaching activities in English and/or German

Required skills and qualifications

º Doctorate degree with scientific focus on genome bioinformatics/computational

biology

R)

º Postdoctoral experience

data sets (resequencing data, reference assemblies, genotyping data of crop plants)

and GPU servers, access to Austrian national computing infrastructure

jobs.title: BSP Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Who we are

StreamUnlimited Engineering develops software and electronics for audio streaming, voice assistant devices, wireless smart speakers and is the global leader in this field. Our solutions are used by Premium Consumer Brands, as well as manufacturers of Smart Home products. We also develop Connectivity solutions for other industries, i.e. medical technology. StreamUnlimited is a main player in the field of Google Cast, Google Voice Assistant and Amazon Alexa and is also the worldwide certification house for Google Cast. We operate offices in Bratislava, Vienna, Shenzhen and Silicon Valley.

Although being already a medium sized company and a serious, well-recognized player in industry, we prefer to keep the company attitude as a friendly group of highly skilled people who enjoy the work they do. We do not torture our employees with an insane amount of bureaucracy. On the contrary, we respect everyone's flexible working hours, we have a minimum number of meetings and we encourage our engineers to select the tools and the approach for the given task. Also, the management aren't the guys in suits whom you never meet, but they are an active part of the team effort - everyone can speak to them, present ideas and actually make a difference!

Enjoy the fun of playing hard in the high technology league, to beat Asian competition by being more creative, more innovative, faster, better. It is possible! Check out www.StreamUnlimited.com to learn more about StreamUnlimited.

We are currently seeking to fill the following position at our location in Vienna. 1 BSP Engineer (all genders) You probably have never heard of us - but we're sure you've listened through us.

StreamUnlimited is a passionate team of 120 music lovers and tech geeks across Vienna (HQ), Bratislava, Boston, Shenzhen, and Osaka, on a mission to make the global home streaming experience downright awesome. For over 20 years, we have delivered what we promise because we genuinely care about our people and our work. Following our acquisition by Bose in 2026, we are now empowered to do even more of what we love.

Tasks

* You contribute to our BSP development for both internal and customer projects as embedded Linux software developer

* Your work involves tailoring the Linux Kernel for our target platforms (NXP, AMLogic, Realtek,...) by supporting Yocto layers

* You share your knowledge with colleagues and gain yours by actively colaborating beyond projects and work packages

Requirements

* You are proficient in Linux Kernel development, ideally kernel drivers, device trees, and also the U-Boot bootloader

* You have sophisticated C language skills, C++ is of advantage, too

* You are well familiar with the Yocto or OpenEmbedded projects, or similar tools to create individual Linux distributions

* Working with embedded systems is your passion, you are not afraid of oscilloscopes and soldering irons

* You are able to read schematics and understand commonly used electrical interface busses (I2C, SPI, I2S for audio) in hardware and software

What we offer

* Truly flexible working hours: no fixed part

* A team-oriented, informal and international work environment

* Virtually no bureaucracy

* Company doctor and free German classes

* Good accessibility (underground station nearby) and free parking

* Free gym, subsidized cafeteria, various lunch options and regular company gatherings

Sounds great? We are looking forward to your application!

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

* In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

* Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

* Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

* 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

* Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

* Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

* Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

* Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

* Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
jobs.description:
About H:

Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement, both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move.

H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents, fully managed agents that take actions on computers.

What you own

Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA.

What you'd be doing

  • Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers.

  • Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument.

  • Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.

  • Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use.

  • When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law.

Who you'd work with

Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams.

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar.

  • Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience.

  • Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Have worked somewhere that was growing fast.

  • Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too.

Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company.

You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

How we hire

Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team.

Practicalities

It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package.

jobs.title: People & Workplace Manager
jobs.description:
About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration. The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen.

The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side, you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side, you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door.

What you will be working on:

Own the employee journey

Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one.

  • Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure.

  • Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs.

Build culture and community

  • Running and improving our team rituals, from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings.

  • Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events.

  • Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress, across offices and time zones.

  • Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements.

Shape our workplaces

  • Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us.

  • Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team.

  • Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and handling invoices and expense reports.

Support the founders

  • Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics, and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward.

  • Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup.

  • You are fluent in French and in English.

  • You have warmth and empathy, and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better.

  • You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through.

  • You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning.

  • You are rigorous with admin, and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding.

  • You are very comfortable using AI, and you learn fast.

Nice to have

  • Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad.

  • Experience in people operations in an international company.

  • Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows.

  • Experience working directly with a CEO or founder.

  • Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking).

  • An interest in real estate, architecture or AI.

Why Join Davis

  • Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month.

  • Open our offices abroad, and build how Davis works across countries.

  • Work directly with the founders, in a seat that sees every part of the company.

  • Grow with the company, as the role expands with Davis.

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership.

  • A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs.

More About Davis

The Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar, and we intend to keep it that way.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) + Market Interactions, Paris (Français & Anglais)
jobs.description:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL)

Lieu: Location: Paris, France — (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)

Team: Product Management

Contrat: CDI

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery.

Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre).

  • Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises.

  • Devenir le partenaire de confiance du client : travailler main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché belge pour comprendre leurs besoins, mener la discovery en ateliers afin de définir comment le produit fonctionne et de cadrer le périmètre, construire les exigences ensemble et bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vers vous en premier. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite.

  • Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

  • Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie.

Ce que vous apportez

Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes :

  • Une expérience avérée de Product Manager, de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux.

  • Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue.

  • De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués.

  • Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran.

  • Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées.

  • La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break)

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible here.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship

Please submit your profile in English. 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza reimagines energy to bring net-zero within everyone’s reach. Our intelligent platform enables energy utilities to unlock the full value of a radically changing energy system and propel us to a future where renewable energy is sustainable, affordable and accessible for all.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

At Kaluza we embrace a flexible, hybrid work model that balances autonomy with the power of in-person connection. Many of our teams find value in coming together regularly to collaborate, strengthen relationships, and accelerate progress. We’re focused on shaping thoughtful, team-driven approaches that support both business impact and individual well-being.

We also prioritise meaningful company-wide gatherings like our annual conference and end-of-year celebrations, that bring us together to align, connect, and celebrate.

What will I be doing?

You will work closely with a team of software engineers on the Belgian expansion of our Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) domain, one of the core product domains of the Kaluza platform. It holds customer, account and contract information and owns the customer journeys around them (for example, moving home or changing contract). It is a full-stack domain: a front end for customer service agents, APIs that expose the data, and back-end services that own the databases and workflow logic. You will therefore work across the whole product domain. This is not a product owner role: you will own features end to end, from dialogue with clients and users to delivery of the software, while running the team’s day-to-day and the discovery work.

Occasional trips to Belgium are possible (around two per quarter).

  • Translate Belgian market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the Belgian energy market into product requirements

  • Become the client’s trusted partner: — work hand in hand with ENGIE and future clients in the Belgian market to understand their needs, run discovery workshops to define how the product works and scope the work, shape requirements together, and build a relationship where they come to you first. That closeness helps you steer what CAL builds next.

  • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, explore API schemas, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.

  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with a full stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in software companies, with a track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.

  • A builder's mentality — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.

  • Technically comfortable — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one and can hold your own in a technical conversation. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.

  • A clear, sharp communicator — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.

  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + 1 birthday day off + bank holidays + RTT days (11), Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Read more about our values over on our careers site.

jobs.title: Coordinateur Logistique (H/F)
jobs.description: Vous aimez coordonner les flux logistiques, gérer les imprévus et être l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et partenaires ? Cette mission pourrait vous intéresser !  Fed Supply, cabinet de recrutement spécialisé dans les métiers de la Supply Chain, recherche pour son client, une entreprise basée à Lyon 9e, un Coordinateur logistique H/F dans le cadre d'un remplacement en intérim de 2 mois.Au sein d'une entreprise en développement, vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif et opérationnel des flux logistiques, principalement à destination d'une clientèle BtoB.  Vous travaillez en lien étroit avec les fournisseurs internationaux, les clients et un prestataire logistique externe basé à Dijon.  Rattaché au Responsable Administratif et Financier, vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :  1. Suivi des flux logistiques internationaux - Assurer le suivi des commandes et des expéditions, notamment depuis les fournisseurs basés en Allemagne vers les clients finaux. - Contrôler les délais de livraison et identifier les éventuels retards ou blocages. - Assurer le suivi des litiges et apporter des solutions adaptées. - Coordonner les échanges avec les fournisseurs et les transporteurs.  2. Coordination des prestataires et relation clients - Piloter au quotidien le prestataire logistique basé à Dijon. - Assurer le suivi des opérations logistiques BtoC organisées depuis la plateforme. - Coordonner et regrouper les livraisons en fonction des demandes. - Tenir les clients informés de l'avancement de leurs commandes et de leurs livraisons.  3. Gestion administrative et suivi ERP - Vérifier les commandes et s'assurer de l'absence de blocages dans l'ERP. - Créer et suivre les bons de commande et les bons de livraison. - Contrôler les stocks et les approvisionnements. - Mettre à jour les tableaux de suivi et les indicateurs logistiques. - Veiller à la bonne circulation des informations entre les différents interlocuteurs.Issu d'une formation Bac +2 en logistique ou transport, vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans la coordination logistique, idéalement dans un environnement international.  Vous maîtrisez le suivi des flux de marchandises, la gestion des expéditions et la relation avec les transporteurs ou prestataires logistiques.  Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques et les ERP. Une bonne maîtrise d'Excel est attendue.  La connaissance de la logistique internationale, des Incoterms et des procédures douanières constitue un véritable atout.  Un niveau d'anglais professionnel est souhaité pour échanger avec les fournisseurs internationaux.  Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, rigoureuse et débrouillarde, capable de prendre rapidement ses marques et de gérer les priorités dans un environnement où l'activité peut varier.  Les conditions : Contrat : Intérim de 2 mois dans le cadre d'un remplacement, jusqu'au 18 janvier. Localisation : Lyon 9e. Rémunération : 35 à 40 K€ brut annuel selon profil. Prise de poste : Dès que possible. Congés de Noël : Une semaine de congés peut être envisagée pendant la mission.  Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise logistique au service d'une entreprise et relever un challenge opérationnel nécessitant autonomie et réactivité ?  N'hésitez pas à nous transmettre votre candidature !

produire les reportings de son périmètre.Responsabilités  * Être garant de la disponibilité, de l'intégrité et de la sécurité des plateformes de virtualisation, de stockage et de sauvegarde. * Porter la responsabilité des choix techniques et des standards de son domaine. * Assurer l'escalade et la résolution des incidents majeurs, et la fiabilité des sauvegardes/restaurations. * Transmettre son expertise aux équipes infrastructures.Issu d'une formation d'ingénieur ou universitaire de niveau Bac +5 en informatique, vous justifiez de 10 ans d'expérience dans le domaine des infrastructures, dont une expérience approfondie et confirmée sur les technologies de virtualisation et de stockage, idéalement en environnement multisites et international.Compétences techniques attendues : * Maîtrise des architectures virtualisées et des solutions VMware (vSphere/ESXi, vCenter, vSAN). * Stockage d'entreprise : SAN/NAS, protocoles (FC, iSCSI, NFS), baies de stockage, snapshots et réplication. * Sauvegarde et PRA : Veeam (ou équivalent), stratégies de sauvegarde et de restauration. * Serveurs Windows et Linux, Active Directory. * Fondamentaux réseaux (switch, VLAN, LAN) appliqués aux infrastructures. * Industrialisation et automatisation (PowerShell, PowerCLI, Infrastructure as Code).La connaissance des solutions Cloud (Azure, AWS) et/ou Citrix serait un plus.Qualités attendues : * Vous avez le sens du service, aimez travailler en équipe et partager votre expérience. * Organisé, rigoureux et autonome, vous savez gérer votre temps et prioriser. * De nature dynamique, vous êtes à l'écoute et disposez d'un bon relationnel.

jobs.title: EXPERT / LEAD RESEAU (H/F)
