jobs.title: HL7 Integration Engineer
jobs.description: RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia &amp; New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.RaySearch Laboratories is looking for an HL7 Integration Engineer to join our Service department. In this role, you will work with healthcare customers to integrate RayCare with hospital information systems and other third-party systems.You will be the main point of contact between the customer and RaySearch for HL7 integration projects, combining technical integration work with customer communication and project coordination.We are flexible regarding the location of this position, as long as you are based in Europe. Priority will be given to candidates based in Sweden, France, Spain, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany. About the jobAs an HL7 Integration Engineer, you will support customers throughout the integration process, from understanding their technical environment and requirements to specifying, testing, and validating interfaces.The role involves close collaboration with customers as well as technical teams within RaySearch. You will work hands-on with HL7 messaging, troubleshoot integration issues, document solutions, and contribute to the planning and delivery of integration projects.An important part of the role is understanding what the customer needs, identifying what is technically feasible, and translating this into clear specifications, deliverables, and estimates.You will    Collaborate with customers and our technical teams to provide integration support for RayCare.    Develop integration specifications and workflows for HL7 messaging.    Test and validate HL7 interfaces with different hospital information systems.    Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues involving third-party systems.    Participate in project planning, implementation, and documentation.    Gather technical requirements from customers and translate them into clear integration specifications.    Contribute to estimates, quotations, and statements of work for integration projects.    Stay up to date with relevant standards and technologies within healthcare IT and HL7.    Share your knowledge and experience within the Service team.Your profileWe are looking for someone with practical experience of healthcare system integrations who is comfortable working directly with customers.To succeed in the role, we believe you have:    Practical experience working with HL7 v2 messaging.    Knowledge of FHIR and healthcare messaging and data exchange.    Basic programming or scripting skills, preferably in JavaScript or a similar language.    At least one year of relevant experience with healthcare integrations, either within a hospital IT/integration department or at a medical technology or healthcare software company. Relevant experience may also come from a clinical environment where you have worked with system integrations.    Professional proficiency in English.    The ability to communicate technical information clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.It is meritorious if you have:    Further experience with FHIR and an understanding of its role in modern healthcare interoperability.    Experience with integration engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect).    Knowledge of good development practices, including documentation, version control, and working in a controlled development environment.    Experience from an oncology environment, for example radiotherapy or chemotherapy.    Previous experience in customer-facing technical support or consulting.    Experience gathering customer requirements and translating them into technical scope and deliverables.    Experience preparing estimates, quotations, or statements of work, including assessing technical feasibility and estimating the effort required for an integration.    A command of other languages than EnglishOur Culture Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. Our Offer At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package. Application Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

jobs.title: Development Engineer within R&D to Olink
jobs.description: Would you like to work hands-on with laboratory development and contribute to the next generation of Life Science products? At Olink, you will have the opportunity to be part of developing innovative protein biomarker panels that help researchers worldwide better understand complex diseases and advance the field of precision medicine. As a Development Engineer, you will combine practical laboratory work with method development, experimental evaluation, and the optimization of advanced workflows. We are looking for someone with experience in laboratory work within areas such as molecular biology, biotechnology, or assay development, who enjoys working hands-on in a laboratory environment and is motivated by turning scientific concepts into products that can make a real difference to human health. We look forward to receiving your application!About the roleOlink – Part of Thermo Fisher Scientific has experienced tremendous growth in recent years and has quickly made a global impact. Its groundbreaking products are used by leading research institutes and pharmaceutical companies to drive the next major breakthroughs in medicine. With headquarters and service laboratories in both Uppsala and Boston, Olink is a truly global Life Science company. Its technology is developed and used to provide new insights into complex diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and neurological disorders – research that has the potential to genuinely change people's lives.Olink is now looking for a Development Engineer to join its R&D team, Reveal Development, which is responsible for developing a specific product line within mid-plex solutions. The team focuses on developing and evaluating new protein panels, assessing their performance, and optimizing the laboratory processes used in product development. In this role, you will contribute to hands-on development activities, conducting experiments and laboratory testing to help ensure that new panels and methods meet established requirements.The role is primarily hands-on and laboratory-based. Your responsibilities will include conducting experiments, performing pipetting, operating laboratory instruments, and working with automated processes. An important part of the role will also involve evaluating and documenting test results and identifying opportunities to improve existing methods and workflows. You will work according to project plans and maintain close communication with project leads regarding the planning, prioritization, and execution of different tests.You will join a team of approximately 10 people, consisting of Development Engineers and Scientists. The team has a relatively new structure and is still evolving, but already offers a positive working environment where colleagues support one another and share knowledge. You will work closely with your team members while also collaborating with other functions across the organization. Your onboarding will include practical training, a structured onboarding checklist, and a dedicated mentor to support you during your initial period.This is a consultant assignment, meaning you will be employed by Academic Work and work on-site at Olink. The assignment will initially run for six months, with the possibility of an extension. The planned start date is February or March 2027. The role is primarily based on-site in the laboratory in Uppsala, with some flexibility to work remotely when the tasks allow.You are offered    The opportunity to work with innovative proteomics technology at an international Life Science company    A hands-on and rewarding role where you will contribute to the development of next-generation protein biomarker panels    The opportunity to combine laboratory work with method development, optimization, and automated processes    An important role within an R&D team, where your work directly contributes to the development of new products    A collaborative team of Development Engineers and Scientists, where knowledge sharing and mutual support are part of everyday work    A structured onboarding process, including a dedicated mentor and practical training    A workplace that our current consultants describe as fantasticWork tasksIn this role, you will primarily work hands-on in the laboratory with the experimental development and evaluation of new protein biomarker panels. You will collaborate closely with project leads and other team members to plan, conduct, and follow up on experiments. Your responsibilities will include:    Planning and conducting laboratory experiments in accordance with project plans and established timelines    Performing laboratory work, including pipetting and other molecular biology techniques    Evaluating the performance of assays and new protein biomarker panels using established analytical tools and quality criteria    Analyzing, documenting, and communicating experimental results in accordance with established procedures    Working with automated laboratory processes, including operating and setting up laboratory instruments    Contributing to the optimization and further development of laboratory methods and workflows    Collaborating with project leads on the planning, prioritization, and execution of project activities    Participating in technical discussions, troubleshooting activities, and scientific reviews    Collaborating cross-functionally with other R&D teams to support product development milestonesWe are looking for someone who    Holds a university degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or another relevant scientific discipline    Has experience in laboratory work within areas such as assay development, product development, or research-based laboratory environments    Has hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS library preparation, and/or immunoassays    Has experience analyzing and interpreting experimental data and drawing scientifically sound conclusions    Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document and communicate results effectively    Has good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPointIt is considered an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have    Experience with multiplex protein detection technologies or molecular diagnostics platforms    Experience working with laboratory automation systems and high-throughput workflows    Experience with LIMS and structured experimental doc

jobs.title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a department that will comprise 55 employees. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director. You will be assisted by an Associate Facility Technical Manager,  and lead the department consisting of shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Lead and develop a department of 55 employees across day and shift teams.
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Graag stellen we onszelf eerst even voor

Wij zijn Altrad Services Benelux, een wereldwijde marktleider binnen industriële services. Met onze multidisciplinaire teams zorgen wij voor vakmanschap op het gebied van stellingbouw, access solutions, isolatie, painting, asbestverwijdering, thermografie en elektrische- en stoomtracing. Wij bieden oplossingen op maat voor de specifieke behoeften van de klant.

Met 4 vestigingen verspreid over heel België leggen we samen de focus op gegarandeerde groei en succes voor zowel de klanten als onze werknemers!

Zet jij graag mee jouw schouders onder ons bedrijf als Junior Project Manager Isolatie in onze vestiging te Terneuzen? Lees dan zéker verder!

Wat kan je van de functie verwachten?

Als Junior Project Manager word je klaargestoomd om volledig zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan als projectleider en de operationele leiding te nemen over bepaalde projecten op de werf in Terneuzen. In het begin zal de focus liggen op de dagelijkse opvolging van de administratieve en financiële flow met de nodige rapportages. Geleidelijk aan zal je ook meer operationele en commerciële taken uitvoeren. Jouw takenpakket is zeer uitgebreid en bestaat verder uit:

  • Je onderhoudt dagelijks de projectadministratie (van opdracht t.e.m. facturatie) en je zorgt voor de nodige rapportages
  • Je zorgt mee voor een efficiënte inzet van mensen en middelen op de werf
  • Je bent mede verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging van het budget
  • Je stuurt op termijn mee de medewerkers aan en je bent het aanspreekpunt bij o.a. problemen, ziekte, planningen … Je stimuleert het teamwerk hierbij en dit doe je met een coachende aanpak!
  • Veiligheid van de werknemers is de belangrijkste waarde van Altrad. Daarom zorg je ook voor en goede opvolging van de veiligheidsvoorschriften en je spreekt collega’s aan die dit niet doen
  • Je organiseert het werfoverleg en je zorgt voor de nodige opvolgingen en briefing m.b.t eisen opdrachtgever, instructies business unit manager …
  • Je werkt actief mee aan verbetertrajecten op de werf om ervoor te zorgen dat de klant de beste service krijgt!

Ben jij de nieuwe collega die we zoeken?

  • Je hebt een technische opleiding op bachelor niveau gevolgd of je bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Schoolverlaters zijn ook welkom.
  • Je hebt een analytische mindset en je haalt energie uit dagelijkse problemsolving
  • Je ben flexibel ingesteld en dit zowel naar taken als naar uren
  • Je kan vlot multitasken en je bent stressbestendig
  • Je bent administratief sterk
  • Je bent een vlotte communicator en je kan jezelf zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands, Engels en Frans
  • Je kan vlot werken met Excel
  • Je bezit een VCA certificaat of je bent bereid om dit op korte termijn te behalen

jobs.title: Rikosylikonstaapeli (08.06.02), Kouvola
jobs.description: Kaakkois-Suomen poliisilaitoksessa on haettavana rikosylikonstaapelin (08.06.02) vakituinen virka. Virka on sijoitettu rikostorjuntasektorille erityistutkintayksikköön rikosten esikäsittelytoimintoon, Kaakkois-Suomen palvelukeskukseen, virkapaikkana Kouvola.Rikosylikonstaapeli toimii esikäsittelytoimia hoitavassa ryhmässä ryhmänjohtajana.Keskeisimpänä tehtävänäsi on toimia ryhmänjohtajana rajoitetuin tutkinnanjohtajan oikeuksin. Ryhmänjohtajan tehtäviin kuuluvat muun muassa esitutkintapäätökset sekä syyttäjälle tehtävät esitutkinnan rajoittamisesitykset ja näiden valmistelu. Arjessa tehtävänäsi on toimia esiselvitystoimia hoitavan Palvelukeskus -ryhmän operatiivisena ja henkilöstöhallinnollisena esimiehenä. Ohjaat ryhmän juttuvirtaa ja tuet esiselvitystoimissa ryhmän jäseniä.Palvelukeskus -yksikössä käsitellään kaikki Kaakkois-Suomen poliisilaitokselle kirjattavat uudet rikosasiat, jotka on ilmoitettu poliisille tiedoksi sähköisten asiointikanavien kautta. Vuosittain vastaanotamme yli 11000 uutta rikosasiaa Kaakkois-Suomen eri tutkintaryhmien hoidettavaksi. Näistä iso osa jää yksikköömme tarkentavia esiselvitystoimia ja/ tai tutkinnan päätöksiä varten.Ryhmänjohtajana toimit ryhmän operatiivisena ja henkilöstöhallinnollisena esimiehenä. Vastaat ryhmän henkilöstön hyvinvoinnista ja kehittämisiestä, vastaat juttuliikenteestä, esiselvitystoimien tehokkaasta suorittamisesta ja asioiden päätöksistä tai siirroista muille tutkintaryhmille. Laaja kokemuksesi päivittäisrikosten ja erityisesti esiselvitystoimien osaajana antaa erinomaisen pohjan tehtävässä menestymiseen.Olet kokenut tutkinnanjohtaja, joka pystyy tukemaan ja kouluttamaan ryhmää. Ryhmässäsi toimii useampia siviilitaustaisia esiselvitystyön asiantuntijoita sekä yleensä uransa alkupäässä olevia poliisitaustaisia tutkijoita. Tukeminen, kehittäminen ja ohjaaminen on siksi iso osa työtäsi. Ryhmässämme työskentelee tällä hetkellä 3 siviiliasiantuntijaa, 3 poliisia, ryhmän vararyhmänjohtaja sekä toimintaa johtava päällystöesimies.Omaat laajan tietämyksen rikostutkinnasta ja pystyt tukemaan ja kehittämään ryhmäsi toimintaa, prosesseja ja tukemaan ryhmän jäsenten oppimista. Päätöksentekijänä olet tehokas asioiden käsittelijä, omaat monipuolista kokemusta rikosasioissa mikä tukee päätöksentekokykyäsi tehtävässä.Tehtävä alkaa 1.1.2027 lukien. Palvelussuhde voi alkaa myös sopimuksen mukaan. Nimityksessä voidaan soveltaa enintään kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

jobs.title: Are you Burger King’s next CEO in Sweden?
jobs.description: Be a part of Burger King´s flaming growth!Burger King is looking for a CEO Sweden who wants to set the direction, develop the team and drive growth across the Swedish market, with a focus on guest experience, operational excellence and profitability.Who are we?Burger King is one of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, known for our flame-grilled burgers and unique flavors. We operate more than 290 restaurants in Sweden, Denmark and Norway and are in strong growth, continuously expanding and upgrading our restaurant portfolio across the region.Close collaboration between our restaurants, our franchisees and our central functions is essential to delivering quality, efficiency and long-term results. Now we are looking for a CEO who wants to take the lead on that journey in Sweden.Your roleAs CEO Sweden, you carry overall responsibility for the business in the Swedish market. You drive the strategy, lead the management team, and drive sales, profitability, and guest satisfaction.You make strategic decisions across operations, people, financials, equipment, guest experience and facilities, and you turn them into clear plans and action. You lead by example and create a culture where high standards and strong results go hand in hand.You are the key link between the board, shareholders, franchisees, business partners and authorities, and you make sure the market and the company’s future are clearly understood at the highest level.Your responsibilities    Own and develop the business strategy for Sweden, including clear goals for sales, operations, guest satisfaction and profitability.    Prepare and implement business plans that combine cost-effective operations with market development and growth.    In collaboration with the COO, create action plans to close gaps in key operational metrics such as speed of service, product quality, friendliness, traffic and sales, and provide strategic and tactical guidance on restaurant operations, standards and guidelines, from service and product preparation to guest relations and Unit Manager development.    Oversee financial performance, investments, and other business initiatives, with full P&L responsibility.    Lead, delegate to and support the executive team, and provide guidance and motivation to drive maximum performance.    Develop and maintain trust-based relationships with shareholders, franchisees, business partners, and authorities.    Make sure company policies and legal guidelines are communicated throughout the organization and always followed.    Analyze challenges and situations as they arise and provide solutions that support company growth.    Give the board strategic advice and an accurate view of the market and the company’s future.Who are you?You are a strong business leader who leads by example and drives results through clear behaviors and high standards. You combine business acumen with excellent leadership and organizational skills.You make quick decisions, handle conflicting priorities, and communicate clearly, both in writing and in person. You are motivated by improving operations, strengthening the guest experience, and developing a culture that delivers ambitious targets.Qualifications and experience    You have proven experience as CEO, Country Manager, or Director.    You have experience in QSR, retail, or the food industry. This is a must.    You have demonstrable experience in developing strategic and business plans.    You have excellent leadership and organizational skills and strong business acumen.    You have knowledge of financial concepts, P&L management, and operations management, as well as a strong understanding of corporate finance and performance measures.    You have a thorough understanding of market changes and the forces that influence the business.    You have excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.    You have outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.What we offerA multicultural and international organization with many opportunities to learn and expand your experience. The work takes place across Sweden, with a base at our HQ in Stockholm. We offer a strong compensation package including a company car allowance.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner
jobs.description: Securitas Risk Intelligence (SRI)Securitas Risk Intelligence delivers actionable intelligence on the global security and threat landscape, creating decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property, and assets. As part of Securitas' intelligence-led approach to security, we combine data- and tech-driven insights with expert human analysis to deliver risk intelligence that is accurate, timely, relevant, and actionable.About the roleReporting to the CFO of Security Risk Management (SRM) and being part of SRI Leadership Team - the Finance Business Partner owns business controlling and performance management for SRI and acts as the finance business partner to VP SRI. The role will make SRI’s economics more visible and actionable, while establishing a more rigorous, forward-looking and technology-enabled approach to commercial, financial and operational performance. The role will be collaborating with dedicated financial control and financial shared service.SRI needs stronger dedicated financial ownership and deeper performance insight. The role will improve the speed and quality of decisions, strengthen adherence to the financial model, raise the quality of business cases and create systematic follow-up on expected benefits, supporting sustainable and profitable growth.Responsibilities    Business partnering and decision support: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to VP SRI and SRI leadership. Translate commercial and operational choices into financial implications, alternatives and recommendations. Challenge assumptions constructively and maintain an independent finance perspective.    Performance management: Own the SRI performance view across commercial performance, financial results, operational drivers and forward-looking indicators. Explain underlying causes, identify risks and opportunities early, and convert analysis into clear actions and follow-up. Runs the recurring business reviews.    Planning and forecasting: Own the SRI business-planning cycle, including budget, forecasts and longer-term outlook. Drive timelines, assumptions, quality and consistency with the agreed financial model. Ensure forecasts are robust, evidence-based and action-oriented.    Business cases and benefits tracking: Strengthen the quality and consistency of investment and commercial business cases. Test assumptions, quantify scenarios and risks, and establish disciplined post-decision follow-up against expected outcomes.    Reporting, data and automation: Improve data structures, definitions and controls. Use automation and AI where they materially improve speed, quality, scalability or insight.    Finance team collaboration: Work closely with the SRI Financial Controller, setting priorities for reporting, analysis and finance support. Leverage the Controller's ownership of financial control, data integrity and recurring processes to enable stronger performance management and business decision support.    Support to SRM: While the primary focus is on SRI, the role will provide targeted analytical and ad-hoc support to the CFO of SRM and contribute to broader SRM performance-management priorities and develop towards a wider remit over time.RequirementsCandidate profile    Analytical strength: analytical ability and data literacy. Able to structure ambiguous questions, reconcile conflicting information, identify root causes and form evidence-based conclusions.    Finance foundation: Grounding in business controlling, performance management, financial planning, modelling and business cases. Connecting operational drivers to P&L impact.    Commercial judgement: Understands that finance exists to improve decisions, not only to report results. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders while remaining pragmatic.    Learning agility and potential: Learns unfamiliar businesses quickly, actively seeks responsibility, forms independent views and demonstrates clear capacity to grow into a broader role.    Technology mindset: Curiosity about data, systems, automation and AI. Looks for scalable ways to improve finance processes and insight.    Communication: Able to explain conclusions clearly and focus stakeholders on what matters. Executive polish is desirable but can be developed. Fluency in English.Indicative experience    Experience in business controlling, FP&A, performance management, transaction services, consulting, revenue operations or a comparable analytical finance role.    Demonstrated ownership of complex analysis, planning or business-case work, not only production of recurring reports.    Experience working with/presenting to senior business stakeholders.    Evidence of improving a process, analysis or decision workflow through better use of data, systems, automation or AI.    University degree in finance, economics, engineering, data or a comparable discipline.Personal characteristics    Curious and willing to investigate until the underlying logic is understood.    Independent in judgement and effective in a collaborative environment.    High ownership and pace, with the discipline to finish and follow through.    Comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader commercial implications.    Ambitious to grow and motivated by building capability and improving the business.Working conditionsThe role is based in Stockholm and involves occasional travelling.Hybrid model applies (with 3 days in the office per week).If this sounds like the right next step in your career, don't hesitate and apply!

jobs.description: Dans le cadre de son activité sur Le Jardin Colonial, situé sur l'Île de Batz, Rêves de Mer recherche un(e) coordinateur(trice) de village vacances.Véritable bras droit du Directeur Exploitation sur le terrain, vous garantissez le bon fonctionnement quotidien du Jardin Colonial. Vous coordonnez les équipes, organisez l'activité de l'établissement, élaborez les plannings et participez activement à la commercialisation du centre. Présent au plus près des équipes et des clients, vous êtes le relais opérationnel de référence lorsque le Directeur Exploitation n'est pas sur site.Vos missionsCoordination et exploitation- Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement.- Superviser l'activité des équipes permanentes et saisonnières.- Garantir la qualité d'accueil et la satisfaction des clients.- Veiller au respect des procédures, des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité.- Assurer le suivi des besoins techniques et des interventions courantes.- Travailler en lien avec le directeur d'exploitation. - Faire remonter les observations et informations du terrain. Prolongation possible. - 35h / 2540 € / Brut. - Poste basé sur L'Île de Batz - Logement possible sur l'établissement. - Restauration possible sur l'établissement.

jobs.title: Ammatillinen tukihenkilö, Espoo, Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Raasepori
jobs.description: Tervetuloa ANNU sosiaalipalveluille! ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä 2023 perustettu, sote-alan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme sosiaalipalveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille ympäri Suomen. Työ on monipuolista ja palkitsevaa. Olemme pieni yritys ja huolehdimme toinen toisistamme.Tule mukaan ANNU:n tiimiin ammatilliseen tukihenkilötoimintaan! Toivomme saavamme tiimiimme innostuneen, kehittämismyönteisen ja toimeen tarttuvan ammattilaisen. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta vastuullisuutta ja kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti ja tavoitteellisesti.**Työn kuvaus**Tehtävässä toteutetaan sosiaalihuoltolain mukaista palvelua, jossa tuet nuorta kodinulkopuolisissa toiminnoissa ja toimit nuorelle luotettavana aikuisena. Tehtävään vaaditaan sosiaali, kasvatus - ja/tai terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkinto (AMK/Yliopisto). Suomenkielentaito on välttämättömyys, mutta ruotsinkielestä on etua. Mainitsethan myös ammatilliset osaamisalueesi hakemuksessasi.ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla- Yksikään työpäiväsi ei ole samanlainen, työsi on vaihtelevaa, innostavaa ja ammattitaitoa kehittävää - Tapaat asiakkaiden lisäksi myös eri verkostoja - Teet liikkuvaa työtä, tästä syystä ajokortti ja oman auton käyttö on suositeltavaa - Suunnittelet ja aikataulutat itse työpäiväsi sisältämään asiakkaiden tapaamisia. Noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Tehtävän palkkaluokka on ammatillisessa tukihenkilötyössä G25E. Työ on erikseen sovittavaa tuntityötä ja työn määrä riippuu omista mahdollisuuksistasi tehdä työtä. Työaika painottuu lasten ja nuorten koulupäivien jälkeiselle ajalle, mutta esim. aloituspalaverit ovat aina virka-aikaan ja ajoittain tapaamisia voi olla myös päivisin.Haethan pian, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja uusia asiakkaita ohjautuu palveluihimme koko ajan. Käytämme teams-etäyhteyttä osana rekrytointiprosessiamme.

jobs.title: Barcelona Varmkundsförsäljning
jobs.description: Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectseÄr du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.Vi söker nya motiverade säljare till varmkundsförsäljning till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.Vilka är vi?Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.Om tjänsten:Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.Vi söker dig som:Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!Vad erbjuder vi?    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.Vid flytt till Barcelona:    Ersättning av flygbiljett.    Stöd vid letande utav boende.    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectseVi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Join Team TechnipFMC as our new SCU Project Engineer in Kongsberg!
jobs.description:
Job Purpose: For our global SCU team within Controls & Automation we are looking for a motivated engineering professional to join our diverse team of highly competent engineers.In Controls & Automation we execute subsea control system project deliveries, including design, engineering, fabrication, and system integration.The Subsea Control Unit (SCU) is a topside located unit that provides operator control and monitoring of subsea wells and manifolds.Job Description:
  • Be the responsible engineer for the Subsea Control Unit (SCU) in delivery projects
  • Take charge of the SCU detailed engineering during project execution, including preparation of SCU software functionality specifications, SCU cabinet hardware specifications, and other technical documentation
  • Be the technical point of contact towards the SCU 3rd party supplier, ensuring delivery in accordance with our design input
  • Witness the SCU Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) at the SCU 3rd party supplier's facility to verify SCU functionality and HMI graphics
  • Support the Extended Factory Acceptance Test (EFAT) for the SCU part executed at TechnipFMC's facility
  • Collaborate closely with the global multidisciplinary project team
  • Participate in technical reviews and workshops
  • Some travel will be required
You are meant for this job if:
  • Hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree, or other relevant education, within Control Systems, Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
  • Preferably have 2-5 years of work experience within Control System Engineering
  • Can handle a 3rd party SCU supplier
  • Can support the Controls Lead Engineer in interactions with the Client
  • Have high level of autonomy in task execution
  • Are analytical and have excellent attention to details
  • Are solution oriented and structured in your approach to complex challenges
  • Are proactive and continuously learn from every situation
  • Have relation building abilities and work well in a team-oriented environment
  • Have excellent command of English, both written and spoken
Your future at TechnipFMC:
  • Your journey starts with our onboarding program
  • As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth
  • You will have the opportunity to attend development activities
  • We have benefits like company cabins, in-house gym, and sports teams  
  • You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans 
  • Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork.
Practicalities:
  • Application date: 6th December 2026, candidates will be evaluated on a continuing basis
  • Place of work: Kongsberg
  • Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in Norway, without sponsorship
  • For more information, please contact Manager Kristine Welde Ødelund, kristinewelde.odelund@technipfmc.com

jobs.title: Tømrer/rejsemontør til montage af bærende konstruktioner i CLT og limtræ
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde i en spændende vækstvirksomhed med flad struktur og deraf kort fra tanke til handling og indflydelse på egne opgaver og udførsel af disse. Vi opfører bærende konstruktioner i CLT og limtræ.

Vi oplever stor stigning i efterspørgslen på vores viden og produkter og søger derfor løbende medarbejdere til byggepladserne. Aktuelt leder vi efter 2-3 tømrere/rejsemontører i hovedstadsområdet dog skal det forventes rejsemontage i hele landet.

Vi går mere op i, hvad du kan, end hvilken uddannelse du har. Vores montørhold består af forskellige faglige baggrunde, og det er netop en styrke. Har du erfaring med træarbejde, gerne trækonstruktioner, er fagligt velfunderet og er en god kollega, så kan du sagtens være den, vi leder efter. For os er det vigtigt, at du både kan bidrage fagligt og bliver en god del af holdet.

Din daglige arbejdsplads vil være på en af vores byggepladser, og dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Montage af bærende konstruktioner af CLT- og limtræssystemer.

  • Tage fagligt ansvar for kvalitet i arbejdet og kvalitetskontrol samt egenkontrol.

  • Samarbejde på tværs af Woodconstruction A/S’ værdikæde og byde ind med løbende forbedringer og udvikling af leverancer, produktion og montageopgaver.

  • Sikre et godt arbejdsmiljø, orden og ryddelighed på byggepladserne.

Vi er en virksomhed med fokus på tillidsfulde samarbejder, og vi tager altid udgangspunkt i udviklingen af den enkelte medarbejders potentiale. Vi ønsker at være en rummelig og glad arbejdsplads, hvor vi sætter pris på at være sammen om at bygge bærende konstruktioner i CLT og limtræ.

Vi forventer derfor at du:

  • Sætter pris på virksomhedens vision og ønsker at blive en del af den grønne omstilling.

  • Elsker træhåndværk og har en stærk faglighed eller erfaring og interesse i at arbejde med træ.

  • Har en høj grad af disciplin, mødestabilitet og sætter en stor ære i at aflevere korrekt arbejde.

  • Har empati for andre mennesker og ønsker at bidrage til deres udvikling.

  • Har en personlighed der skaber god energi, tryghed og humør på arbejdspladsen.

Woodconstruction A/S tilbyder:

  • At du bliver et led i den grønne omstilling i byggeriet.

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • En kultur, hvor vi bestræber os på at tale åbent og ærligt om hverdagens udfordringer og succeser, hvor alles meninger bliver hørt, respekteret og hvor ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er helt afgørende.

  • Ordnede forhold og en lønpakke, der forhandles efter kvalifikationer.

For yderligere information kontakt daglig leder, Rolf Olsen på tlf. 40 95 51 75, eller lav en aftale med os og kom forbi vores kontor til en snak.

Ansøgning og CV kan sendes til os på ro@woodconstruction.dk – husk at skrive ”Jobansøgning” i emnefeltet.

Se mere om os på www.woodconstruction.dk

jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager
jobs.description: At Beiersdorf, home of Nivea, Eucerin, Hansaplast & Labello we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society. The Assistant Brand Manager will drive the Personal Care categories with support from the Senior Brand Manager. Develop and execute brand strategies to drive growth and enhance brand equity. This role involves handling product launches, managing marketing campaigns, and analyzing brand performance. Identify opportunities to enhance market share and drive net sales growth. This is a Fixed Term Contract for 12-18 monthsYour TasksSupport Brand Strategy Development    Assist in the formulation and execution of brand strategies and marketing plans to achieve business objectives.    Conduct competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities for brand growth.    Identify opportunities within the global assortment and collaborate with RGM/category teams to propose Nordic/Swedish launches.    Identify opportunities to enhance brand performance throughout the year.    Prepare and present core brand performance meeting presentations.    Occasionally when agreed present brand presentation to retailers.    Identify opportunities to enhance brand performance throughout the year.    Present brand plans to senior stakeholders and secure approval for marketing activities and product launches. Product Launches and Management    Collaborate with the Senior Brand Manager on L/RL initiatives, incl. market assessments and product positioning.    Coordinate the execution of product launches, ensuring all marketing materials and assets are prepared and delivered on time.    Manage brand initiatives from start to finish, executing planned activities and tracking launches. Brand Performance and Development    Proactively monitors and reports on own brand/categories and competitor performance driving interventions to improve results and find opportunities    Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders, summarizing brand performance and campaign effectiveness. Campaign Management    Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across various channels, including digital, social media, and influencer initiatives.    Adaptation of global/regional assets, in conjunction with third party agencies and in agreement with Senior Brand Manager and in alignment with Nordic and regional strategy Cross-Functional Collaboration    Collaborate with sales/supply chain/finance to ensure alignment on brand initiatives and objectives.    Assist in managing relationships with external partners, incl agencies, vendors, and retailers.    Work closely with the supply/demand planner to ensure a smooth supply of NPD and key products International collaboration    Collaborates with team across all Nordic markets    Collaboration with the EUNA (Europe and North America) team to influence assortment needs, development of strategy and communication that fits to the local market    Exchanges with NOE (Northern Europe) colleaguesYour Profile    Degree educated in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.1-3 years' experience in brand management, marketing, or a similar role.    Experience within FMCG, consumer goods, or retail is advantageous.    A self-motivated individual who thrives in a collaborative team environment and enjoys driving results.    Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions.    Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities. High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering quality work.    Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.    A strong understanding of the social media and digital marketing landscape. Fluency in English and Swedish is essential.    Knowledge of Danish, Finnish, or Norwegian would be beneficial. At Beiersdorf, we see you as a person – far beyond your title or role. Our goal is to provide the flexibility and support you need for your professional and personal success through our work environment. That is why we have a lot to offer! Private health insurance, pension, 30 days vacation per year, Wellness fee, Meal vouchers, discounted product purchases, leave entitlements and wellbeing support to include access to an excellent Employee Assistance Programme. At Beiersdorf, we believe that every individual brings unique perspectives, experiences, and strengths that deserve to be valued and celebrated. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels empowered to be themselves, thrive in their role, and work in ways that enable them to succeed. Through flexibility, understanding, accessibility, and meaningful support, we aim to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, heard, and able to reach their full potential. We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment experience and are happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process to support you.

jobs.title: Monteur 3 ploegen
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Van Geloven een Monteur 3 ploegen

Je wordt onderdeel van de technische dienst op onze productielocatie van Mora in Maastricht. In 3-ploegendienst werk je samen met collega-monteurs om te zorgen dat onze processen zo min mogelijk stilvallen. Je voert zowel gepland onderhoud als storingsonderhoud uit aan (verpakkings)machines en installatiecomponenten.

Concreet:

  • Je lost mechanische en elektrische storingen op binnen de productie, zowel direct op de lijn als in modules in de werkplaats
  • Je voert preventief onderhoud uit aan machines en installaties
  • Je helpt bij revisie van machineonderdelen en het vervangen van versleten componenten
  • Je werkt met tekeningen, elektro- en werktuigbouwkundige schema’s
  • Je registreert al je werkzaamheden nauwkeurig in het onderhoudssysteem
  • Je denkt mee over technische verbeteringen om de betrouwbaarheid te verhogen
  • Je werkt volgens veiligheidsregels, voedselveiligheidsnormen en interne kwaliteitsrichtlijnen.

Wie zoeken wij:

  • MBO-opleiding (niveau 3 of 4) in werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica, elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar
  • Ervaring als onderhoudsmonteur of analog in een industriële/foodomgeving
  • Kennis van mechanica, elektrotechniek, pneumatiek en bij voorkeur praktijks ervaring met PLC’s
  • Iemand met problemen-oplosmentaliteit, nauwkeurig en bereid tot samenwerken
  • In bezit van VCA (of bereid dit te behalen) is een pré.

jobs.title: Monteur Dagdienst
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Van Geloven (Mora) een Monteur Dagdienst

Als monteur dagdienst zorg jij ervoor dat onze technische installaties iedere dag probleemloos draaien. Jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat installaties zoals stoom, perslucht, water, koeling, verwarming en ventilatie in goede conditie blijven. Deze systemen zijn essentieel voor onze productie en jouw werk is dus van groot belang.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: • Het uitvoeren van preventief en correctief onderhoud aan technische installaties • Het signaleren en oplossen van storingen, zelfstandig of samen met collega’s • Werken volgens de geldende veiligheids- en milieunormen • Meedenken over verbeteringen aan installaties en processen • Het vastleggen van werkzaamheden in het onderhoudssysteem en afstemmen met collega’s van verschillende afdelingen.

Daarnaast draai je 1 keer per 6 weken een wachtdienst op zaterdag.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde technische MBO 4 werktuigbouwkunde of een soortgelijke opleiding
  • Je hebt een aantal jaar ervaring als monteur utiliteiten
  • Je bent flexibel en bent bereid om wachtdienst te werken (1x per 6 weken)
  • Je hebt een secure werkwijze en hebt een kritische en frisse blik op onze werkwijze
  • Je bent een fijne collega met een passie voor techniek
  • Je bent zorgvuldig en oplossingsgericht
  • Je bent gedreven, hebt overtuigingskracht om de beoogde dynamiek in de groep te laten ontstaan.

jobs.title: Logistiek Medewerker
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Van Geloven een Logistiek Medewerker

Als Logistiek Medewerker bij Mora zorg je samen met je collega’s voor een soepel en efficiënt logistiek proces. Je bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van inkomende goederen tot opslag en het verzendklaar maken van onze producten.

Je werkt in een 3-ploegendienst, waardoor de operatie 24 uur per dag doorgaat. Dat maakt het werk afwisselend, dynamisch en nooit saai. Samenwerken en schakelen met verschillende afdelingen staan centraal.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Beheren van het vrieshuis, koelcellen en het magazijn
  • Laden en lossen van vrachtwagens voor transport naar distributiecentra en andere Van Geloven-locaties
  • Aanleveren van grondstoffen en halffabricaten voor de productie in Maastricht
  • Verwerken van logistieke administratie in het ERP-systeem (SAP), zoals inboeken, verplaatsen en uitboeken
  • Ondersteunen bij interne logistieke processen, zoals het op temperatuur brengen van producten

Daarnaast houd je je bezig met

  • Afstemming met productie over de aan- en afvoer van goederen
  • Voorraadcontroles: verschil tussen fysieke en administratieve voorraad signaleren en oplossen
  • Controleren van inkomende grondstoffen, verpakkingen en emballage
  • Correct registreren en verplaatsen van pallets en goederen in het systeem
  • Zorgen voor een nette, veilige en overzichtelijke werkomgeving op het terrein en in het magazijn

Wie zoeken wij:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Ervaring in een logistieke of magazijnfunctie
  • Je bent in bezit van een heftruck certificaat
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en houdt overzicht
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler, maar kunt ook zelfstandig werken
  • Je bent flexibel en beschikbaar voor een 3-ploegendienst

jobs.title: Operator Food
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Van Geloven (Mora) een Operator Food.

Als Operator ben jij de held die onze machines laat draaien! Jij zorgt dat alles soepel loopt, houdt de kwaliteit scherp in de gaten en helpt mee om lekkere snacks te maken. Geen dag is hetzelfde, en met jouw oog voor detail en technisch gevoel maak jij het verschil. Jij:

  • Bereidt mengsels en ingrediënten volgens receptuur
  • Bedient en stelt machines af
  • Voert kwaliteitscontroles uit en bewaakt het productieproces
  • Verhelpt kleine storingen zelfstandig (eventueel met hulp van Technische dienst)
  • Zorgt voor een nette, veilige werkomgeving (5S, HACCP)
  • Registreert productiedata nauwkeurig
  • Werkt nauw samen met collega’s om productiedoelen te behalen.

Je werkt in een 3 ploegendienst. Dit betekent van maandag t/m vrijdag werken en de weekenden lekker vrij. Je werkt een week 1 dienst (vroege dienst 6:00-14:00, middagdienst 14:00-22:00, nachtdienst 22:00-06:00).

Over jouw werkplek

Bij Van Geloven werken inmiddels bijna 1500 medewerkers verspreid over 5 productielocaties in Nederland en 1 in België. In totaliteit realiseren wij een omzet van circa 300 miljoen euro. Van Geloven bouwt verder aan ambitieuze groeiplannen. Wij zijn absolute marktleider in diepvriessnacks en maaltijdcomponenten voor het retail- en foodservice kanaal. Het totale merkenfortfolio is enorm. Denk aal sterke merken zoals Mora, Van Dobben, Kwekkeboom, de Bourgondiër, Ad van Geloven, Van Lieshout Snacks en Souflesse. Wij werken graag met plezier en ondernemerschap. Zo is eigen inbreng m.b.t. nieuwe producten welkom. Er wordt graag gekeken of een nieuw product te realiseren is. Bij Mora in Maastricht werken op dit moment bijna 400 medewerkers direct in dienst en ongeveer 100 uitzendkrachten. Mora is daarmee ook de grootste productielocatie van alle locaties. Er wordt in 4 productiehallen gewerkt.

Bij Van Geloven staat veiligheid stipt op nummer 1. Het is van belang dat jij samen met jouw collega’s zorgt dat de totale werkomgeving bestaat uit een veilige omgeving. Je spreekt zodoende ook je collega’s hierop aan. Verder verwachten wij het volgende van jou:

  • Ervaring in een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in de voedingsindustrie
  • Technisch inzicht en leergierigheid
  • Nauwkeurig, hygiënisch en kwaliteitsgericht
  • Je vindt het fijn om in een 3-ploegendienst te werken
  • Je bent proactief, positief en een echte teamspeler.
