jobs.employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
jobs.description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk\-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.**Investment Management*** Generate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre\-agreed trading mandate.* Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.* Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.* Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance\-sheet\-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.* Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.* Take hands\-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.**Risk Management*** Operate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance\-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.* Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.* Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.* Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.* Improve and scale risk\-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.**Performance, Monitoring and Reporting*** Monitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P\&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.* Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.* Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.**Contribution to the Fund and the Firm*** Contribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.* Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub\-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.* Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.**Governance, Compliance and Conduct**Operate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable de projets du maître d'ouvrage (20739)---Responsable de projets du maître d'ouvrage (20739\)==================================================== **Berne, Suisse (et travail à domicile) \| 80\-100% \|**  **Ce à quoi vous pouvez contribuer*** Assumer la responsabilité générale de projets de construction pour le compte du maître d'ouvrage, de la procédure de sélection à la remise au client, en passant par l'étude de projet et la réalisation (phases SIA 22 à 53\)* Définir les objectifs et les risques du projet, établir les bases (planification du processus, modèles de réalisation et étapes de la procédure) ainsi que diriger des organisations de projet interdisciplinaires* Planifier, solliciter et piloter les ressources humaines et financières ; gérer les crédits de projet conformément aux prescriptions légales, notamment la loi sur les finances* Assurer une collaboration efficace avec les utilisateurs, les exploitants, les mandataires, les entreprises et les consultants spécialisés dans l'intérêt de la Confédération en sa qualité de maître d'ouvrage* Mener des procédures d'adjudication conformément à la loi et à l'ordonnance sur les marchés publics (LMP et OMP), et garantir une gestion efficace de la qualité et du controlling des projets  **Ce qui vous rend unique*** Diplôme reconnu en architecture, en ingénierie civile ou formation équivalente dans le secteur de la construction* Expérience de plusieurs années dans la conduite générale de projets de construction complexes ; expérience dans la représentation du maître d'ouvrage, un atout* Compétences attestées en conduite générale de projets (qualité, coûts et délais) ; connaissance des marchés publics (LMP et OMP), un atout* Excellentes compétences de conduite, approche axée sur la réalisation d'objectifs et la recherche de solutions et compréhension des principes d'économie d'entreprise* aptitude à créer des réseaux et aisance communicationnelle* Bonne connaissance active d'au moins deux langues officielles  **En quelques mots**En tant que représentant/e du maître d'ouvrage à l'OFCL, l'organe de la Confédération spécialisé dans la construction, vous assumerez la responsabilité générale de projets exigeants dans toute la Suisse. À ce poste clé, vous mettrez en place et dirigerez l'organisation interdisciplinaire de projets, et vous piloterez des processus complexes conformément à des objectifs clairement définis. Vous assumerez également la responsabilité de la qualité, des coûts et du respect des délais dans l'intérêt public. Comme nous recrutons un/e collaborateur/trice dans trois unités différentes et que nous sommes actifs dans toutes les régions linguistiques, nous exigeons une maîtrise active de deux langues officielles. Nous répartirons les candidatures entre les unités en tenant compte des compétences linguistiques et du profil professionnel. Il s'agit d'une activité variée avec des responsabilités importantes, dont les résultats influencent directement le développement du patrimoine immobilier de la Confédération.  **Ce que nous offrons***  **Travailler pour la Suisse** Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien\-être de la population.*  **La diversité au quotidien** Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents.*  **Santé au travail** Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique.  **Des tâches et des projets de construction passionnants vous attendent!**À l'OFCL, construire, acquérir, déménager, conseiller font partie de notre ADN. Chaque jour, nous donnons le meilleur de nous\-mêmes avec un maximum d'enthousiasme pour la Suisse, la politique et l'administration fédérale. Notre office veille à ce que les 43 000 employés de la Confédération puissent accomplir leurs tâches. Ce faisant, nous façonnons non seulement leur travail, mais nous établissons également de nouveaux standards en matière de durabilité.  **Informations complémentaires**Veuillez postuler via notre système de gestion des candidatures. Pour ce faire, veuillez cliquer sur « Pour postuler ».  **Questions sur le poste**    **Questions sur la postulation**  Partenaire d'affaires RH   ![Bundesverwaltung]()*** ![Bundesverwaltung]()***jidd8f2e9ejm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
jobs.description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

**Questions? We're here for you**

**Pascal Scacchi**

jobs.description: What you will doThe Director of Engineering Excellence leads a multi-disciplinary portfolio spanning substance/regulatory compliance, enterprise data governance, cybersecurity program management, and India engineering site leadership. This role acts as the central point of contact between Global Products Business Units (PBUs), IT, and corporate functions, driving standardization, compliance, and operational excellence initiatives across a global engineering organization. Cybersecurity & IT Risk Program Management· Serve as central program manager for enterprise cybersecurity initiatives (e.g., "Project Thunder," "Project Lightning"), covering endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation, cloud hardening, IAM, and secure field installations.· Coordinate CMDB migration, server intake, and lab segmentation programs across global sites in partnership with IT and managed service providers.· Build reporting frameworks providing leadership visibility into PBU compliance status and remediation progress.4. Sustainability & Cross-PBU Initiatives· Provide program management for cross-PBU sustainability efforts (e.g., Low Global Warming Potential refrigerant transition), coordinating regulatory, product management, and engineering stakeholders.· Support enterprise sustainability metrics rollout, including training on embodied carbon and weight-reduction methodologies.5. People Leadership & Talent Development· Drive diversity & inclusion hiring and leadership development goals; sponsor high-potential talent into stretch leadership roles.· Manage voluntary and critical-talent attrition through engagement and career-growth initiatives.· Oversee training needs analysis and competency development (target: 20+ training hours/employee/year) across technical, leadership, and soft-skill domains.· Drive employee engagement through recognition programs (e.g., Bravo) and voice/engagement survey action planning.6. Executive Reporting & Innovation Culture· Ensure transparent, accurate, and timely reporting of all Central Engineering initiatives to staff meetings, CoE Reviews, Global Product Leadership Reviews, and Townhalls.· Champion innovation culture through enterprise-wide innovation events (e.g., Tech Challenge), driving invention disclosures and idea submissions.What we look for Required· Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field; advanced coursework or certification in data science, program management, or compliance preferred.· 10+ years of experience in engineering operations, program management, or regulatory compliance within a global manufacturing or engineering organization.· Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional, multi-geography programs (APAC/EU/NA) involving IT, engineering, legal, and procurement stakeholders.· Experience with PLM/ERP systems (e.g., SAP MDG/ECC/S4, Windchill, NetSuite) and compliance platforms (e.g., Assent).· Strong people-leadership track record, including coaching and developing technical subject-matter experts.· Experience with data analytics/automation tools (Power BI, Power Automate, PowerApps) and AI-driven classification initiatives.· Prior experience leading cybersecurity or IT risk remediation programs.· Executive presence and experience presenting to senior leadership (Director level and above).Core Competencies· Program & Portfolio Management· Cross-Functional Stakeholder Influence· Regulatory & Compliance Acumen· Data Governance & Analytics· People Development & Coaching· Executive Communication & Reporting· Change Management & Continuous Improvement· Innovation & Culture BuildingAbout UsJohnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Du leistest einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Betrieb und zur Weiterentwicklung unserer fachlichen und technischen Lösungen.Business Applications \& Datamanagement Specialist (m/w/d)==========================================================IM JOB WIRKLICH ETWAS BEWEGEN.Gemeinsam für das echte Leben. **Das erwartet dich*** Du stellst den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die Bewirtschaftung unserer Fachanwendungen und unterstützenden Software\-Tools (primär sowie in Access \& Excel sowie Access\-VBA \& Excel\-VBA) sicher.* Du arbeitest mit unseren Systemen und führst Datenimporte und \-exporte, Datenverarbeitungen, Kalkulationen sowie fachliche und technische Kontrollen durch. Zudem führst du den technischen Monatsabschluss durch.* Du analysierst Fehler und Unregelmässigkeiten in den Software\-Tools (primär sowie Access/Excel sowie Access/Excel\-VBA), identifizierst Ursachen, nimmst Konfigurationsanpassungen vor und arbeitest eng mit dem Entwickler bei deren Behebung zusammen.* Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen und entwickelst in Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten Stakeholdern nachhaltige Lösungen in den Software\-Tools.* Du unterstützt das Team bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen sowie beim gezielten Einsatz moderner Technologien und KI\-basierter Lösungen.* Du erstellst Ad\-hoc\-Auswertungen und entwickelst kleinere Automatisierungen und Hilfsmittel, beispielsweise in Access mit VBA, Access ohne VBA, Excel mit VBA, Excel ohne VBA oder mit .* Du arbeitest in einem interdisziplinären Entwicklungsumfeld aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Kernsystems mit.* Du übernimmst Aufgaben im Support und hast die Möglichkeit, perspektivisch eine Stellvertretung für den verantwortlichen Entwickler wahrzunehmen. **Das bringst du mit*** Sehr gute Kenntnisse in (Voraussetzung)* Gute Kenntnisse in VBA\- Access / Excel (Voraussetzung), sowie Kenntnisse in der Erstellung von SQL Abfragen (z. B. SQL Editor in Access)* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Lebensversicherungsumfeld oder in der Beruflichen Vorsorge, oder in einem vergleichbaren Versicherungsbereich (sehr erwünscht)* Interesse und Bereitschaft, sich vertieft in Vertragskonstrukte, Versicherungsprodukte sowie technische Komponenten der Lebensversicherung einzuarbeiten.* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im IT\-nahen Umfeld.* Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch C2, gute Englischkenntnisse **Deine Benefits**Dein Büro ist da, wo du bist: Je nach Pensum kannst du bis zu 60% deiner Arbeitszeit remote arbeiten. jobs.description: ---base:  meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width,  title: GESTIONNAIRE DE FORTUNE - SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)--- GESTIONNAIRE DE FORTUNE \- SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)=============================================================================SENIOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGER / PRIVATE BANKER (H/F)--------------------------------------------------### Gestion de fortune privée \| Genève \| Rémunération jusqu'à 75 % de la production**ATHÉNÉE INVESTMENT SA – GENÈVE****Développez votre clientèle. Préservez votre indépendance. Bénéficiez directement de la valeur que vous créez.**### QUI SOMMES\-NOUS ?Athénée Investment SA est une maison suisse indépendante de gestion de fortune, établie à Genève et soumise à la surveillance prudentielle applicable aux gestionnaires de fortune autorisés par la FINMA.Nous accompagnons une clientèle privée exigeante, composée d'entrepreneurs, de familles fortunées, de dirigeants et d'investisseurs internationaux, dans la préservation, la gestion et le développement de leur patrimoine.Notre positionnement associe les valeurs traditionnelles d'une maison de gestion privée — proximité, confidentialité, indépendance et excellence du conseil — à l'accès à des compétences et solutions d'investissement sophistiquées, inspirées des pratiques institutionnelles.Nous privilégions une architecture ouverte, une approche patrimoniale globale et une relation durable avec nos clients, sans logique de distribution imposée de produits propriétaires.Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons plusieurs **Senior Relationship Managers / Private Bankers** souhaitant exercer leur métier dans un environnement indépendant, agile et entrepreneurial.### UNE OPPORTUNITÉ POUR LES BANQUIERS PRIVÉS ENTREPRENEURSVous êtes un professionnel expérimenté de la banque privée ou de la gestion de fortune.Vous avez développé un réseau solide, construit des relations de confiance avec une clientèle fortunée et démontré votre capacité à générer des actifs et des revenus.Vous souhaitez désormais bénéficier d'une plus grande autonomie, d'une organisation plus souple et d'une participation significative aux revenus que vous générez.**Athénée Investment vous offre la possibilité de développer votre activité au sein d'une maison indépendante, avec deux modèles de collaboration adaptés à votre profil et à vos ambitions.**### MODÈLE 1 – RELATIONSHIP MANAGER SALARIÉVous rejoignez Athénée Investment en qualité de collaborateur salarié, dans le cadre d'un contrat de travail suisse.Vous bénéficiez notamment :* D'une intégration complète à notre organisation.* D'une rémunération fixe et/ou variable structurée selon votre expérience, votre contribution et les conditions contractuelles.* D'un environnement réglementaire et opérationnel établi.* De l'appui des équipes de gestion, de conformité et d'administration.* D'une grande autonomie commerciale et d'une relation directe avec la direction.* D'un mécanisme de participation à la production pouvant être particulièrement attractif.La rémunération globale est déterminée individuellement, en tenant compte des coûts employeur, des charges sociales, des responsabilités exercées et de la rentabilité de l'activité.### MODÈLE 2 – RELATIONSHIP MANAGER INDÉPENDANT / PARTENAIREVous souhaitez conserver une véritable dimension entrepreneuriale et développer votre propre activité en vous appuyant sur une plateforme professionnelle reconnue.Athénée Investment propose, sous réserve de validation juridique et réglementaire, un modèle de partenariat permettant de bénéficier :* D'une importante autonomie dans le développement de votre clientèle.* D'un accès à notre infrastructure de gestion et à nos partenaires bancaires.* De l'appui de nos compétences en investissement et en ingénierie patrimoniale.* D'un environnement professionnel structuré et de procédures de conformité adaptées.* D'une rémunération directement liée à votre production.* De modalités de collaboration négociées individuellement.**Dans ce cadre, la participation du partenaire pourra atteindre 75 % de sa production éligible**, selon les revenus effectivement encaissés, les services fournis, les coûts supportés et les conditions de l'accord conclu.Ce modèle s'adresse particulièrement aux professionnels disposant d'une clientèle établie ou d'un fort potentiel de développement, souhaitant conjuguer autonomie entrepreneuriale et qualité d'une infrastructure de gestion de fortune.Les responsabilités réglementaires, les conditions d'exercice et le statut du partenaire seront expressément définis avant toute entrée en activité.### VOS MISSIONS**Développer une clientèle privée de qualité*** Prospecter et acquérir de nouvelles relations HNWI et UHNWI.* Développer les actifs sous gestion et les apports nets de capitaux.* Valoriser votre réseau professionnel auprès d'entrepreneurs, dirigeants, familles fortunées et investisseurs internationaux.* Accompagner les clients souhaitant établir une relation avec Athénée Investment, dans le respect des obligations contractuelles, de confidentialité et des règles applicables.* Construire des relations pérennes fondées sur la confiance, la transparence et la qualité du service.**Proposer un accompagnement patrimonial et financier de premier ordre*** Identifier les objectifs financiers, patrimoniaux et successoraux des clients.* Définir, avec les équipes compétentes, des stratégies d'investissement adaptées.* Proposer des solutions de gestion discrétionnaire et de conseil en investissement, selon le cadre applicable.* Mobiliser une large gamme d'instruments : actions, obligations, fonds, produits structurés, dette privée et investissements alternatifs, en fonction de l'adéquation et de l'éligibilité de chaque client.* Coordonner les besoins spécifiques avec nos banques dépositaires et partenaires spécialisés, notamment pour les financements lombards et hypothécaires.**Garantir l'excellence du suivi*** Assurer une relation de proximité et une grande disponibilité.* Veiller à la qualité du suivi des portefeuilles et des risques.* Respecter les exigences légales et réglementaires applicables, notamment en matière de LSFin, LEFin, LBA et de connaissance du client.* Contribuer à la réputation et au développement à long terme d'Athénée Investment.### LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONSNous privilégions des professionnels expérimentés, autonomes et reconnus pour leur capacité à développer une clientèle privée.**Expérience et compétences*** Expérience significative, idéalement supérieure à 7 ans, en banque privée, gestion de fortune indépendante ou family office.* Réseau actif auprès d'une clientèle HNWI/UHNWI.* Capacité démontrée à développer des actifs sous gestion et à générer des revenus récurrents.* Bonne connaissance des produits financiers, de l'allocation d'actifs et des besoins patrimoniaux d'une clientèle sophistiquée.* Compréhension des exigences réglementaires suisses et, le cas échéant, des marchés transfrontaliers couverts.**Qualités personnelles*** Tempérament entrepreneurial et sens du développement commercial.* Excellente capacité à établir et entretenir des relations de confiance.* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités.* Discrétion, loyauté et intégrité.* Volonté de s'inscrire dans une collaboration durable.**Formation et langues*** Formation supérieure en finance, économie ou gestion, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.* Certifications CFA, CAIA, CWMA ou similaires appréciées.* Excellente maîtrise du français et/ou de l'anglais.* Autres langues et expertise de marchés internationaux appréciées.Nous étudierons les candidatures de professionnels présentant un potentiel commercial significatif, même si leur parcours ne répond pas à l'intégralité de ces critères.### UNE RÉMUNÉRATION À LA HAUTEUR DE VOTRE CONTRIBUTION**Jusqu'à 75 % de votre production éligible.**Notre philosophie est simple : les professionnels qui contribuent directement au développement d'Athénée Investment doivent pouvoir bénéficier significativement de la valeur économique qu'ils créent.Nous proposons des conditions de rémunération compétitives et individualisées, selon :* Le modèle de collaboration retenu : salarié ou partenaire indépendant.* Les actifs sous gestion développés.* La nature, le niveau et la récurrence des revenus générés.* Les ressources et services mis à disposition.* Les charges et responsabilités supportées par chacune des parties.La production éligible, les modalités de partage, les éventuelles déductions, les frais et les conditions de versement seront définis contractuellement, de manière transparente.Le taux maximal de 75 % n'est ni automatique ni garanti et dépend du modèle de collaboration retenu.### POURQUOI ATHÉNÉE INVESTMENT ?**L'indépendance d'une maison de gestion privée**Une approche centrée sur les intérêts du client, une architecture ouverte et une grande liberté dans la recherche de solutions adaptées.**Une véritable culture entrepreneuriale**Une organisation agile, des circuits de décision courts et une relation directe avec les dirigeants.**Des solutions d'investissement différenciantes**L'accès à des expertises financières et à des stratégies d'investissement traditionnelles et sophistiquées.**Une infrastructure professionnelle**Un cadre structuré permettant de se consacrer prioritairement au développement commercial, à la relation client et à la création de valeur.**Une rémunération attractive et transparente**Une participation directe à la performance économique de votre activité, pouvant atteindre 75 % de la production éligible selon le modèle convenu.**Une ambition commune**Construire ensemble une maison de gestion de fortune privée de référence pour les entrepreneurs, les familles et les grandes fortunes.### REJOIGNEZ\-NOUSVous êtes un ba

jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Travel Assistant --- Travel Assistant ================ \*\*FIM Travel Department\*\* \*\*TRAVEL ASSISTANT\*\* \*\*Part\\-time position (60%) -- 3 working days per week\*\* \*\*Based in Mies (VD), Switzerland\*\* \*\*Start date: January 2027\*\* \*\*The FIM\*\* Founded in 1904, the Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme (FIM) is an International Federation formed by 125 National Federations throughout the world and is recognised as the sole competent body in motorcycle sport by the International Olympic Committee (IOC). The FIM is the worldwide governing body for motorcycle sport and the global advocate for motorcycling. With some 50 World Championships organised under its aegis, the FIM works for the benefit of the sport and all its stakeholders. \*\*Your mission:\*\* Reporting to the Head of Travel, you will provide administrative and operational support to the FIM Travel Department, helping to ensure the smooth organisation and coordination of business travel for FIM staff, Board members and delegates. Working closely with the Head of Travel and various internal and external partners, you will assist with travel bookings, reservations, expense reporting and administrative follow\\-up, while ensuring compliance with the FIM Travel Policy and internal procedures. We are looking for a well\\-organised, proactive and service\\-oriented person with excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail, who enjoys working in an international environment and finding practical solutions to travel\\-related requests. \*\*Key responsibilities:\*\* \*\*Travel Coordination and Bookings:\*\* Receive and process travel requests in accordance with the FIM Travel Policy, including researching and booking flights, accommodation and rental cars. \*\*Supplier Communication and Support:\*\* Liaise with travel management company (TMC), hotels, car rental companies and travellers regarding requests, modifications and specific requirements. \*\*Invoice Verification:\*\* Check flight, hotel and car rental invoices, ensuring their accuracy and compliance with agreed arrangements. \*\*Expense Reporting:\*\* Prepare and review travel expense reports and supporting documentation for submission to the Accounting Department. \*\*Travel Insurance Claims:\*\* Assist with the preparation and submission of travel insurance claims, monitor their progress and follow up with the insurance provider. \*\*Travel Management Systems:\*\* Provide day\\-to\\-day support to travellers in the use of travel management platforms (Perk), assisting with user queries and system\\-related issues. \*\*Administrative Operations:\*\* Maintain accurate travel records, contribute to the improvement of internal tracking tools and procedures and support the efficient day\\-to\\-day operation of the Travel Department. \*\*Travel Stakeholder Assistance:\*\* Collaborate with FIM staff, Board members, delegates and internal divisions/departments to respond to travel\\-related enquiries and provide timely assistance. \*\*Your profile:\*\* \* Commercial training, administrative qualification or equivalent professional background. \* Previous experience in travel coordination, business travel administration, reservations or a similar administrative role would be an asset. \* Excellent command of French and English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages would be an advantage. \* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage several tasks simultaneously. \* Proactive, reliable and service\\-oriented, with the ability to anticipate needs and find practical solutions. \* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, while managing priorities and meeting deadlines in a fast\\-paced environment. \* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a diplomatic and professional approach when dealing with internal and external stakeholders. \* Good command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook. \* Familiarity with travel booking platforms or expense management systems, such as Perk, would be an advantage. \* Interest in international sport and motorcycling would be appreciated. \* Flexibility to support the Travel Department during major FIM meetings and events, when required. \*\*Recruitment Process:\*\* Interested? Please submit your complete application (cover letter, CV, copies of diplomas, and work certificates) via the JobUp platform. \*\*The FIM promotes equal opportunities and diversity.\*\* \*\*\*Please note that applications not meeting the above criteria will not be considered and will not receive a response.\*\*\* !\[Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme\]( ) \* Fédération Internationale de Motocyclisme 11 route de Suisse 1295 Mies \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid31f7ef0jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer 100%
jobs.description: Are you passionate about pushing the boundaries of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology? Lightium, a leading-edge photonics foundry, is looking for an experienced Packaging Engineer to spearhead its RF and optical packaging activities and be the point of contact and manage the relationships with Lightium Packaging Partners. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the next generation of photonics packaging solutions for Lightium’s proprietary high-speed TFLN technology by defining novel assembly concepts, identifying external supplier and packaging houses and define the assembly flow together with internal and external stakeholders. Position Summary As an RF & Photonics Packaging Engineer, you will be responsible for developing Lightium’s Packaging technologies, chip assemblies, as well as supply chain management. You will have the opportunity to leverage your theoretical knowledge and your prior experience in the field of RF and photonics packaging by managing Lightium’s packaging activities and to interface to Lightium’s internal and external customers. You will be responsible for ensuring Lightium’s TFLN chips can be packaged according to our customer’s specification and will drive the implementation of novel packaging concepts with Lightium’s suppliers. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge packaging technologies, such as flip chip bonding, ribbon bonding, microtransfer printing, etc. Key Responsibilities Packaging concepts: You will be actively working with the different internal R&D groups including design, PDK, process development, characterization and test teams to ensure "design for packaging" and "design for testing" is followed in our whole organization. You will identify and implement different packaging concepts compatible with our TFLN technology (e.g., , laser integration, drivers and TIA integration, wire bonding, fiber attachment, etc.) while meeting our customer’s needs. You’ll actively work on ultra-high-speed RF package solutions and simulate the relevant packaging concepts in state-of-the-art electromagnetic simulation tools (such as COMSOL, HFSS, ADS, etc). You’ll also work on fiber-to-chip coupling solutions, spot size converters, and attachment of fiber array units (FAUs).  Supplier identification and management: Lightium and its customers value a multi sourcing strategy. You are responsible that all identified packaging concepts can be sourced from multiple vendors. This includes electrical attach (wire bonding, flip chip bumping and optical fiber and bumping) as well as optical fiber attach. You will drive the diversification of our supply chain including Western, European and Asian suppliers.  Assembly project management: You will drive the day-to-day project management of internal R&D projects, public funded projects and customer assembly projects with external partners, such as assembly houses and OSATs. You will be the point of contact and managing the relationship with packaging houses and OSTAs. You will drive the day-to-day meetings and provide regular updates to Lightum's management. You will define the packaging specs, budget, and timeline for the subcontractors. You will make sure that the assemblies are delivered on time, in spec and in budget to our customers while matching our demanding RF and optical requirements. You will coordinate with Lightium’s R&D team for any package-level testing, characterization, and qualification. Customer engagement: Based on customer requirements, you will identify and implement the matching assembly technologies and concepts. You will track the requirements with a keen eye to detail and make sure all specifications are met and traceable. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to work with leading transceiver manufacturers and OSATs. Reliability and Quality: You will define the qualification plans and qualification procedures for our packaging concepts. You will work with internal and external stakeholders to run the qualifications, such as environmental reliability or electrical stress tests. In the case of RMA events, you will support the team inassembly-related aspects and embrace customer satisfaction. Collaboration: Work closely with the R&D teams from design to optical testing and characterization, contributing to cross-functional projects to advance our packaging platforms. Occasional travel to Lightium’s assembly partners and OSATs. Participating in public funded projects (HorizonEurope, InnoSuisse, European Chips Act etc.) to develop new packaging concepts and hybrid integration solutions. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain thorough documentation and report findings, as well as establishing standard-operating procedures and training new colleagues. Innovation: Stay up to date on the latest advancements in photonics, incorporating new techniques and technologies into our R&D landscape. Identification of packaging IP and contributing to Lightium’s IP portfolio.  What you’ll bring Educational Background: An advanced degree in Electrical Engineer, Physics, Electro-Optical or Wireless Communications, Integrated Photonics, Chemistry, Material Science or a related field. Experience Level: At least 3 years' work experience (post-graduation) in the field of electronics, photonics, electronic packaging, PCB manufacturing, material science or RF design. Track record of moving electro-optical assemblies from concept over prototyping into production.  Technical Skills: Prior experience with photonic packaging concepts, fiber attach, electronic re-distributing layers (RDLs), under-bump metallization (UBM), bumping, copper pillars or anisotropic conductive glue (ACF) is a plus. Experience in the field of RF simulations (COMSOL, Keysight ADS, Ansys, HFSS and CST) is a clear advantage. Experience with intermetallic phases and SEM-EDX is advantageous. Organization & Documentation: Strong organizational skills with excellent project management skills and a keen eye for details. Experience handling and documenting RMA processes, in outward-facing communication with suppliers and subcontractors at international level. Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team and with international customers. Cultural awareness and tailoring of communication style to US, European and Asian partners. Experience with vendor and supplier management at an international level. Adaptability: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in the face of change. Willingness to travel internationally up to 20%. Language Skills: Fluency in English is required; knowledge of German or any Asian language is an advantage.  What We Offer A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics. Competitive compensation and benefits package, including employee stock option plan (ESOP), reflective of your experience and expertise. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and be part of a young, motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment. Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Product / System Quality & Verification Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer to help establish and drive product quality from our first rideable prototypes through development and toward production.This is a hands\-on, cross\-functional individual contributor role at the intersection of product quality, systems integration, verification and reliability.You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, connectivity and system interfaces. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every domain—that responsibility remains with the respective Engineering teams. Instead, you will provide the independent quality perspective that connects these domains and ensures that the complete product is adequately verified, integrated, and ready for release.You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, System Engineering, Embedded Software / Electronics, Product Management, suppliers and eventually Manufacturing and Service teams.**Key responsibilities**Plan, coordinate, and review verification and validation activities for components, subsystems, and complete e\-bike systems.Define and govern Minimum Test Requirements (MTRs) together with Engineering and suppliers, including appropriate test methods, conditions, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.Review Supplier validation plans and test evidence, and challenge whether the proposed verification provides sufficient evidence that product requirements are met.Drive and coordinate system integration and end\-to\-end testing to ensure hardware, software, connectivity, and mobile app functions work reliably together.Own and maintain the FRACAS process, leading investigations into complex mechanical, electrical, software, and system\-level issues through root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, verification, and continuous learning.Define and coordinate reliability, durability, environmental, and field\-testing programs to identify risks and improve product robustness before launch.Coordinate homologation and certification testing, and release readiness reviews, ensuring compliance requirements are met and product quality is maintained throughout development.**What success looks like**Success in this role means that, as we move from prototypes toward production, we can confidently answer key questions about product readiness: What are the critical requirements? How are they being verified? Are the tests sufficiently rigorous? What issues have been found, and have the fixes been proven effective?You will ensure that verification activities, test results, product configurations, and compliance evidence are well structured, traceable, and visible, enabling informed decisions on product readiness, certification status, and release milestones.Success also means establishing a robust FRACAS and problem\-solving culture where issues are identified early, investigated systematically, resolved through verified corrective actions, and used to drive continuous improvement across products and processes.Ultimately, you will help build confidence that the complete e\-bike and it’s system is reliable, compliant, and ready for launch, not just at the component level but as an integrated product.Engineering teams will see Quality as a trusted partner that helps identify risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and support successful product releases.**What you bring**5\+ years of experience in product quality, verification \& validation, reliability engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline.Experience with complex mechatronic products such as e\-bikes, automotive systems, motorcycles, robotics, or consumer electronics.Strong understanding of verification, validation, reliability engineering, and structured problem\-solving methodologies such as FRACAS, 8D, or equivalent.A systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, software, and connectivity domains, and understand how they interact in a complete product.Experience coordinating suppliers, validation activities, and complex system integration across multiple engineering disciplines.Ability to review and challenge test plans, Minimum Test Requirements, validation strategies, and technical evidence without needing to be the deepest subject matter expert in every domain.Comfortable working hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, diagnostic tools, test data, and failure investigations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, suppliers, and external test partners.Fluent English; German or Swiss German an advantage given the Switzerland base.j4id10481085jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer---Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer=========================================  The Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\-docs, post\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people.For the Decommissioning Studies Group within the Department of Radiation Safety and Security we are looking for aRadiation Protection Physicist / Engineer=========================================### Your tasks* Provide radiation protection expertise and technical guidance for projects, with a particular focus on developing the TATTOOS radioisotope\-production facility as part of the PSI's large\-scale project IMPACT* Organize, implement, and evaluate radiation protection measurement campaigns at PSI, mainly within the IMPACT project, including analysis and interpretation of the experimental data* Develop radiation protection concepts and methods for measuring ionizing radiation (e.g., for clearance measurements, decommissioning activities, and the characterization of radioactive materials) and prepare expert reports (if necessary, with the help of simulations) according to the needs of the group and section* Support the planning and implementation of decommissioning activities for former research reactors, including optimizing clearance measurements through automation and software development* Prepare license and release applications for the regulatory authorities* Translate your work into clear technical reports, quality management documents and scientific publications* Share your findings with the scientific community by presenting studies and results at national and international conferences### Your profile* PhD degree in physics or engineering, or master's degree with equivalent research experience* Solid expertise in radiation physics, protection, and measurement technology. Practical experience with measurement campaigns and experiments at particle accelerators and/or radioisotope\-production facilities is a plus. Experience with methods and technologies for the decommissioning of nuclear installations is also an asset* Excellent command of English (both spoken and written) and proficiency in . Alternatively, a strong commitment to learning quickly* Strong skills in data analysis, data visualization and programming (e.g., C\+\+, )* Knowledge of one or more major radiation transport codes (FLUKA, Geant4, MCNP)### We offerOur institution is based on an interdisciplinary, innovative and dynamic collaboration. You will profit from a systematic training on the job, in addition to personal development possibilities and our pronounced vocational training culture. If you wish to optimally combine work and family life or other personal interests, we are able to support you with our modern employment conditions and the on\-site infrastructure.This is a fixed\-term project position. The employment contract is limited to three years.For further information, please contact Dr. Bolzonella, phone .Please submit your application online by **4\. January 2027** for the position as a Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer (index no. 9624\-30258\).Institute, People \& Culture, Simen, 5232 Villigen PSI, Switzerland                ![ Institut (PSI)]()*** ![ Institut (PSI)]()***jidc92bdeejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.description: Ref 2591262 \\\| Date: 16 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Machine Learning Engineer \*\*About the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC)\*\* The Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) is a strategic focus area of the ETH domain, with EPFL and ETH Zurich as founding partners, developing into a National Research Infrastructure in 2025\\. Its mission is to support academic labs, hospitals, industry and public sector stakeholders, including cantonal and federal administrations, through their entire data science journey, from the collection and management of data to machine learning, AI, and industrialization. With a large multidisciplinary team of professionals across three locations (Lausanne, Zurich, Villigen), the SDSC provides expertise and services to various domains, such as health and biomedical sciences, energy and sustainability, climate and environment, and large\\-scale scientific infrastructures. More: \[ \](\< \> " ") \*\*Your mission\*\* You will provide machine learning engineering expertise in the context of several SDSC partnerships in the French part of Switzerland. In this role, you will meet partners (companies, public sector entities, NGOs) to understand their needs and help them define a high\\-impact project with the SDSC. Together with the SDSC data scientists, you will be responsible for the societal and/or industrial impact of your projects thanks to your machine learning engineering expertise. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities include\*\* \* Elaborate solutions that convert data science prototypes into impact in the context of an industry/public sector/NGO collaboration, with particular focus on the engineering side and in view of meeting production requirements \* Create original solutions with business partners, from solution design to industrialization \* Share expertise in machine learning engineering (and related fields) with fellow data scientists/machine learning engineers \* Presenting to a non\\-technical audience will also be part of your activities. \*\*Your profile\*\* The ideal candidate has: \* Master degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or similar field \* Good knowledge of machine learning concepts \* Demonstrated expertise in machine learning engineering, particularly in an industrial context \* Ability to present to various audiences \* Open to collaborative work and team spirit \* Highly appreciated: experience as a full\\-stack engineer, experience as a (data) architect, experience deploying LLM\\-based solutions in industrial contexts \* Fluent in English; knowledge of French highly appreciated \*\*We offer\*\* Do you see yourself helping Switzerland become more data\\-driven? Are you passionate about data science and with experience in machine learning? Are you keen to share what you know and get exposed to several projects in various domains? Are you eager to be part of a diverse and adaptable team with equal growth opportunities of its members at its core? If your answer to these questions is yes, you should consider joining us. Together, we can help move the Swiss landscape to the next level of data science. During your time at the Swiss Data Science Center, you will benefit from the following opportunities: \* Develop your soft skills and meet with key stakeholders in several industries \* Interact with and learn from fellow data scientists \* Discover new data science applications in various industries \* Exchange on advanced machine learning topics with our academic experts We actively promote a healthy work\\-life balance in the workplace. We are looking for candidates willing to contribute to an inclusive environment and eager to continuously learn. \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate : Contract Type: CDD Duration: 1 year, renewable Reference: 2604 Contact We look forward to receiving your online application including application letter, CV and diploma(s). Applications via email or postal services will not be considered. For further information about the Swiss Data Science Center please visit our website: \[ \](\< \>) Questions regarding the position should be directed to \[Write an email\](\< \>) with the job n° reference. \*\*Remark:\*\* Only candidates who applied through EPFL webstie or our partner Jobup's website will be considered. jpid3c1f7fcjm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: Regional Head, PSPV-Affiliate Management APAC, ME & CIS
jobs.description: About the role- This is a regional role. The Regional Head, PSPV-Affiliate Management APAC, ME & CIS is responsible for overseeing all pharmacovigilance activities within the Intercontinental region, excluding Latin America, including the management, direct or functional, of all PSPV-AM staff in that region.- Ensure local PV alignment with PSPV and regional alignment with Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Commercial, and provide leadership, vision and functional expertise to the PV Country Leads and local PV personnel in every Local Operating Company (LOC) within the regional scope.- In addition to the regional remit, the role is accountable for the AI, digital solutions and transformation agenda across the entire PSPV-AM organisation, covering all regions and LOCs.- The role is the accountable Global Capability Model (GCM) interface for PSPV-AM in India and holds a coordinating role for GCM transformation across PSPV-AM.How you will contribute- Provide leadership and oversight to all PSPV-AM and local personnel engaged in pharmacovigilance activities in the APAC, ME & CIS region , including the direct or functional management of all PSPV-AM staff in the region.- Set and implement the strategy for the APAC, ME & CIS region in alignment with the PSPV-AM Leadership Team and the broader PSPV strategy and establish long-term plans and goals together with applicable local and global stakeholders, including the EU QPPV.- Ensure the effective implementation of local, regional and global strategies across the Local Operating Countries (LOCs) in the region to maintain procedural and regulatory compliance.- Chair the regional pharmacovigilance forum for the APAC, ME & CIS region and set the goals, priorities, key performance metrics and long-term plans within the region.- Ensure regional strategies incorporate EU and local QPPV / PV contact person requirements, and work with the global and local qualified persons for pharmacovigilance in the region to ensure the accuracy of the pharmacovigilance system and of the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF).- Foster a culture of inclusiveness and collaboration and establish strong matrix partnerships with colleagues, including Local/Regional Medical Directors, Country General Managers and colleagues supplying sources of safety information within both R&D and the Commercial organisation.- Proactively collaborate with Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs and Quality to address the region's pharmacovigilance needs, ensuring cross-functional alignment and that LOCs maintain compliance with pharmacovigilance requirements.- Collaborate with PSPV Compliance, Training and Alliance, as well as the Takeda Quality organisation, to ensure a high level of PV and training compliance at all LOCs in the region.- Collaborate with Global PV Compliance, the EU QPPV and the Takeda Quality organisation to ensure oversight of all audit and inspection related activities and outputs applicable to the region, including follow-up and CAPA management.- Develop strategies to align and simplify relevant SOPs, processes and tools within the region to meet the operational and training needs of the PV staff at the LOCs.- Maintain proficiency in applicable local knowledge of key drug safety regulations, act upon developments in the PV landscape, and provide leadership for impact analyses of country- and region-specific regulatory changes on regional and global PV systems and vice versa.- Ensure financial accountability and oversight of the PV operating budgets within the region, and address resourcing needs and strategies so that they meet Takeda and local, regional and global PV requirements, in alignment with the Head of PSPV Affiliate Management.- Establish and oversee local and regional PV suppliers within the region, including scope, service levels, quality metrics and appropriate oversight measures.- Promote clear communication between Global PV and the local PV staff within the region, act as an advocate for the local PV staff and their LOCs within the PSPV organisation, and ensure that PV and management issues escalated in each LOC are addressed.- Influence internal and external stakeholders, both in R&D and the Commercial organisation, to build the reputation of pharmacovigilance and drive the promotion of patient safety within the region.- Embrace the Takeda cultural mind-set of “Patient, Trust, Reputation and Business” in the workplace, undertaking personal accountability to live these values as we work within our one PSPV worldwide team and represent our PSPV function inside and outside of the company, as appropriate.Digital solutions, AI and transformation and GCM interface- Lead the AI and digital solutions agenda for affiliate pharmacovigilance across the entire PSPV-AM organisation, covering all regions and LOCs, in partnership with the Head of PSPV-AM, the Regional Heads, PSPV Business Excellence and Data, Digital & Technology.- Define the PSPV-AM roadmap, priorities and success metrics for AI, digital and automation use cases, such as local data screening, translation, workflow automation and compliance analytics, and drive consistent adoption across regions.- Ensure all AI and digital use cases are assessed, validated and documented in line with Takeda's PV quality system, GxP and data privacy requirements; accountable human oversight remains with the qualified PV personnel in each country.- Act as the accountable GCM interface for PSPV-AM in India, covering scope of transitioned activities, service levels, quality metrics, escalation routes and clear role delineation so that local regulatory accountability is never at risk.- Oversee India GCM readiness, training, knowledge transfer and delivery performance against agreed metrics, and represent PSPV-AM in the India GCM governance forums.- Coordinate GCM transformation across the whole PSPV-AM organisation through jobs.title: Destinationsudvikling og Samarbejde
jobs.description:
Destinationsudvikling og samarbejde – vær med til at udvikle Sønderjylland som destination

Har du blik for udvikling, gode samarbejder og evnen til at få idéer omsat til konkrete resultater? Trives du med at drive projekter, skabe relationer og samle forskellige aktører om fælles mål? Så har vi en spændende stilling til dig i Destination Sønderjylland.

I Destination Sønderjylland arbejder vi med markedsføring, udvikling samt tiltrækning og styrkelse af turismen i Sønderjylland på tværs af de fire sønderjyske kommuner Haderslev, Sønderborg, Tønder og Aabenraa. Det gør vi i tæt samarbejde med kommuner, turismevirksomheder, lokale aktører og erhvervsorganisationer. Sekretariatet har kontor i Sønderborg, hvor vores team på 9 medarbejdere arbejder med markedsføring, salg, service og udvikling. Derudover driver Destination Sønderjylland turistbureauerne i Haderslev, Sønderborg og Aabenraa.

Vi søger en ny kollega, som kan være med til at drive og koordinere udviklingsprojekter, styrke samarbejdet på tværs af turismeerhvervet og omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete indsatser. Du får samtidig et særligt ansvar for at udvikle og styrke vores gæsteservice på tværs af destinationen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag med både projektledelse, koordinering, udvikling og relationsarbejde. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Udvikling og gennemførelse af indsatser, der understøtter Destination Sønderjyllands strategi og styrker Sønderjylland som samlet destination.

  • Udvikling og styrkelse af gæsteservice, herunder udvikling af nye tiltag, koncepter og samarbejder, der sikrer gode gæsteoplevelser på tværs af destinationen.

  • Etablering og udvikling af samarbejder med kommuner, turismevirksomheder og øvrige lokale aktører samt facilitering af netværk, møder og workshops.

  • Sparring, koordinering og opfølgning med samarbejdspartnere samt identifikation af nye muligheder for fælles udvikling.

  • Planlægning, koordinering og gennemførelse af udviklingsprojekter – fra idé og ansøgning til implementering, dokumentation og afrapportering.

Dine kompetencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og erfaring med projektledelse, udviklingsarbejde og koordinering. Du er god til at skabe overblik, holde fast i fremdriften og få forskellige mennesker og organisationer til at arbejde sammen om fælles mål.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at drive projekter og kan bevare overblikket fra de første idéer til den endelige gennemførelse.

  • Har erfaring med samarbejde med kommuner og forståelse for de kommunale organisationer og deres arbejdsprocesser.

  • Har erfaring med udvikling af service og gæsteoplevelser og kan omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete forbedringer i praksis.

  • Er god til at skabe relationer og kan navigere i samarbejdet mellem forskellige interessenter og organisationer.

  • Er struktureret og har styr på planlægning, koordinering, opfølgning og dokumentation.

  • Har gode formidlingsevner og kan facilitere møder, workshops og processer, der skaber engagement og fremdrift.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, tager initiativ og er god til at prioritere, når flere opgaver er i gang på samme tid.

  • Har blik for helheden og forståelse for, hvordan samarbejde og udvikling kan skabe værdi for både destinationen og de lokale aktører.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til turismeerhvervet, destinationsudvikling eller gæsteservice.

Vi tilbyder

Et spændende og alsidigt job, hvor du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af Sønderjylland som turistdestination og arbejde tæt sammen med en bred kreds af engagerede samarbejdspartnere.

Du bliver en del af et lille og uformelt team, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling, stor grad af frihed under ansvar og plads til at tage initiativ. Vi arbejder på tværs af fagområder og hjælper hinanden.

For at fremme det gode arbejdsmiljø afholder vi løbende sociale arrangementer. Udover løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension tilbydes en sundhedsforsikring.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen. Du må påregne varierende arbejdstider, hvor også aften- og weekendarbejde kan forekomme.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har stillingen fanget din interesse, så vent ikke med at sende din ansøgning! Opstart vil være den 1.2.2027.

Ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag sendes pr. mail til Kirsten@dssj.dk andre former for ansøgninger accepteres ikke.

Yderligere spørgsmål rettes til direktør Kirsten Oldenborg Lundvang kirsten@dssj.dk, eller på 66446701

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til Visit Haderslev
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at holde VisitHaderslevs hjemmeside skarp og opdateret?Destination Sønderjylland søger en studentermedhjælper til vedligeholdelse og optimering af hjemmesiden.

Er du i gang med en uddannelse med fokus på hjemmesider, digitale medier eller web, og har du lyst til at få praktisk erfaring med at arbejde med en større turismehjemmeside? Så søger vi en studentermedhjælper til at hjælpe med den løbende vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af VisitHaderslevs digitale indhold.

Om Destination Sønderjylland

Destination Sønderjylland arbejder med markedsføring og udvikling af turismen i de fire sønderjyske kommuner Haderslev, Sønderborg, Tønder og Aabenraa. Derudover driver Destination Sønderjylland turismeservice i Aabenraa, Sønderborg og Haderslev Kommune.

Sekretariatet har kontor i Sønderborg, og arbejdet med VisitHaderslevs digitale indhold sker i tæt samarbejde med den faste medarbejder hos VisitHaderslev.

Om stillingen

Som studentermedhjælper kommer du primært til at arbejde med VisitHaderslevs indhold på VisitSønderjyllands hjemmesider.

Destination Sønderjylland og den faste medarbejder hos VisitHaderslev vurderer og prioriterer, hvilket indhold der skal være på siderne. Din opgave bliver især at hjælpe med at få indholdet oprettet, opdateret og kvalitetssikret.

En stor del af jobbet består derfor af det løbende arbejde med at holde hjemmesiden korrekt, relevant og opdateret. Samtidig forventer vi, at du byder ind med forslag til, hvordan hjemmesiden kan optimeres og forbedres.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·       opdatere og vedligeholde VisitHaderslevs indhold på VisitSønderjyllands hjemmesider

·       oprette og redigere sider, guides, artikler og andet indhold ud fra de aftalte prioriteringer

·       kvalitetssikre tekster, billeder, links, åbningstider og øvrige oplysninger

·       finde og rette døde eller forældede links

·       arbejde med løbende SEO- og GEO-optimering af eksisterende indhold med fokus på synlighed i både søgemaskiner og AI-baserede søgetjenester

·       oprette, redigere og kvalitetssikre produkter og events i GuideDanmark-databasen i samarbejde med kolleger og turismeaktører

·       indhente og kontrollere oplysninger om blandt andet oplevelser, attraktioner og arrangementer

·       have øje for forbedringsmuligheder på hjemmesiden og komme med forslag til, hvordan indhold og brugeroplevelse kan optimeres.

Arbejdet foregår efter eksisterende retningslinjer for blandt andet opbygning og tone of voice. Indholdet findes på dansk, tysk og engelsk og på dele af hjemmesiden også på nederlandsk. Til oversættelserne arbejder vi med faste prompts og værktøjer, som du bliver introduceret til.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er i gang med en videregående uddannelse, hvor hjemmesider, digitale medier, web eller lignende indgår som en naturlig del af uddannelsen.

Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for at arbejde med hjemmesider og trives med den løbende opdatering og vedligeholdelse af indhold.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

·       har interesse for web og digitalt indhold

·       arbejder struktureret og grundigt

·       skriver sikkert på dansk

·       kan arbejde selvstændigt og tænke selv i opgaveløsningen

·       har blik for, når noget kan gøres bedre, og tør komme med forslag til forbedringer

·       er nysgerrig på SEO og GEO og har lyst til at lære mere

·       kan følge eksisterende retningslinjer og samtidig være opmærksom på muligheder for at optimere indholdet

·       har lyst til at samarbejde med kolleger og turismeaktører.

Erfaring med CMS eller webarbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

Et studiejob hvor du får praktisk erfaring med vedligeholdelse og optimering af webindhold inden for turisme. Du bliver en del af Destination Sønderjylland og får mulighed for at arbejde med en hjemmeside, som bruges af gæster til at finde inspiration og praktisk information om oplevelser i Haderslev og hele Sønderjylland.

Du får faste rammer og retningslinjer at arbejde ud fra, men samtidig mulighed for at bruge din faglighed og komme med input, når du ser noget, der kan forbedres.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted

Arbejdstiden er 8-15 timer om ugen og aftales nærmere under hensyntagen til dit studie.

Arbejdssted vil være i Haderslev og/eller på Destination Sønderjyllands sekretariat i Sønderborg, afhængigt af opgaver og aftale.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale og senest d. 1. februar 2027

Ansøgning og ansættelse

Send din ansøgning og CV til kirsten@dssj.dk senest den 10.12.2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Direktør, Kirsten Oldenborg Lundvang på mail: Kirsten@dssj.dk eller tlf. 66446701

jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe overblik og sammenhæng i en afdeling med mange spændende projekter?

Vi søger en engageret administrativ medarbejder til afdelingen Trafik, Anlæg og Ejendomme, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og udvikling af afdelingen.

I Haderslev Kommune er der gang i udviklingen. Vi arbejder med alt fra trafiksikkerhed, mobilitet og klimaprojekter til områdefornyelser, byudvikling, større anlægsprojekter og drift, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af kommunens bygninger. Derfor er vi en afdeling med mange forskellige fagligheder og opgaver, der kræver koordinering, struktur og overblik.

 

Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Du bliver den administrative nøgleperson, primært på trafikområdet, men vil også få administrative opgaver for afdelingens bygherrerådgivere. Din opgave er ikke at være faglig specialist inden for områderne, men vil med tiden løse nogle af henvendelser kommunen modtager på trafikområdet. Du vil hjælpe med at skabe struktur, følge op på opgaver og bidrage til, at afdelingens projekter og drift hænger godt sammen.

 

Du bliver ikke den ansvarlige for projekterne, men du bliver en vigtig medspiller, som hjælper med at skabe fremdrift og sammenhæng.

Dine opgaver kan blandt andet omfatte:
  • Administrativ understøttelse af trafikteamets opgaver inden for vejmyndighed, trafikprojekter og borgerhenvendelser 
  • Håndtering af standardiserede trafikopgaver og administrative sagsgange 
  • Bidrag til udarbejdelse af politiske dagsordener, notater og præsentationer 
  • Opfølgning på afdelingens opgaver, projekter og handleplaner 
  • Udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af oversigter, handlingsplaner og statusmateriale 
  • Forberedelse og koordinering af møder, workshops og arrangementer 
  • Administrativ støtte til afdelingen, herunder mødeplanlægning, opfølgning og koordinering 
  • Understøttelse af bygningskonsulenterne med opgaveoverblik, økonomiopfølgning og andre administrative opgaver i forbindelse med drift og vedligehold af kommunens bygninger 
  • Koordinering af tværgående opgaver på tværs af afdelingen 
  • Diverse administrative ad hoc-opgaver
Hvem er du?

Du er måske uddannet teknisk assistent, teknisk designer eller har anden uddannelse indenfor administration.

Du trives med at have mange bolde i luften og motiveres af at skabe struktur i komplekse sammenhænge. Du kan lide at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker og er typen, der naturligt følger op på aftaler og sikrer, at tingene kommer i mål. 

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en administrativ funktion, gerne i en kommune eller anden politisk styret organisation, men det er ikke et krav.

 

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • er struktureret og har sans for detaljer
  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • er god til at skabe overblik og holde styr på mange forskellige opgaver samtidig
  • har gode kommunikationsevner, både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • er serviceminded og hjælpsom over for kolleger og samarbejdspartnere
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i mange forskellige fagområder
  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og fællesskabet i afdelingen
Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, stor variation i opgaverne og gode muligheder for at præge din egen hverdag.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling, hvor samarbejde, tillid og sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi har et godt arbejdsmiljø med værdier som ambitioner, resultater, fællesskab og dialog. Tonen er uformel, og der er også mulighed for at deltage i sociale og kulturelle aktiviteter sammen med kollegerne.

Du får base på rådhuset ved Haderslev Havn med udsigt over fjorden og bliver en del af afdelingen Trafik, Anlæg og Ejendomme, som består af engagerede medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold 

Løn- og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne i ny løn, med en lønramme på mellem 25.000 og 45.000 kr. inkl. pension, alt efter uddannelse og erfaringsniveau.

 

Tiltrædelsestidspunkt 1. februar 2027 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Ansøgningsfrist 

Send din ansøgning med CV m.v. via kommunens hjemmeside www.haderslev.dk/job, hvor 

du under stillingsopslaget anvender knappen ”Send ansøgning”, senest onsdag den 9. december 2026. Haderslev Kommune behandler kun ansøgninger, der er modtaget elektronisk via ”Send ansøgning” knappen. 

Ansættelsessamtaler 

Gennemføres tirsdag d. 15. december 2026. 

 

Har vi vakt din nysgerrighed og har du yderligere spørgsmål, så kontakt endelig afdelingsleder Kasper Mikaelsen på telefon 2910 4607 eller mail kmik@haderslev.dk.

Om Haderslev KommuneVi er en organisation med ambitioner for både Haderslev Kommune og os selv. Vi arbejder målrettet og nytænkende, skaber resultater sammen og tør sigte højt. Hos os er dialog og fællesskab nøglen til udvikling – på tværs af fag, borgere, erhvervsliv, foreninger og politikere. Derfor er vores ambition, at vi inden 2030 har 250 flere i uddannelse, 500 flere indbyggere og 1.000 flere arbejdspladser. Alt det kan du blive en del af med et job hos os.

Grib chancen for at blive en del af en international succes, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel for miljøet og genanvendelsen af ressourcer.

Er ovenståend lige noget for dig.?
