jobs.title: Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Sønderparken - En del af Specialområde socialpsykiatri voksne- Region Midtjylland
jobs.description:
Brænder du for det social- og sundhedsfaglige arbejde, recovery og for at skabe udviklingsmuligheder sammen med mennesker i komplekse livssituationer? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Sønderparken.

Vi søger en kollega, der er nysgerrig på, hvad der skaber værdi, mening og retning i den enkeltes liv, og som sammen med borgeren ønsker at skabe de bedst mulige betingelser for trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse.For os er det afgørende spørgsmål ikke: "Hvad fejler du?" men derimod: "Hvem er du, hvad er vigtigt for dig, og hvordan kan vi sammen understøtte det liv, du ønsker at leve?"Derfor søger vi en social- og sundhedsassistent, som ser relationen som sit vigtigste faglige redskab, og som motiveres af at understøtte borgernes muligheder for at tage aktiv del i eget liv, styrke deres mestring og indgå i meningsfulde fællesskaber.Hos os er recovery, rehabilitering og borgerinddragelse grundlæggende pejlemærker, da vi ved at håb, ligeværdige relationer og oplevelsen af at høre til skaber grobund for udvikling. Med afsæt i denne forståelse arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe rammer, hvor borgerne oplever sig mødt med respekt, indflydelse og troen på egne muligheder.Om stillingenSom social- og sundhedsassistent på Sønderparken bliver du en del af et tværfagligt miljø, hvor faglige forskelligheder styrker hinanden og bidrager med nye perspektiver til den fælles opgaveløsning.Derfor forventes det, at du aktivt bringer din faglighed i spil og bidrager med dine perspektiver, refleksioner og handlemuligheder, der kvalificerer den samlede indsats omkring borgeren.Du bliver en del af et miniteam omkring en gruppe borgere og får sammen med dine kolleger ansvar for at understøtte arbejdet med borgernes mål, delmål og udviklingsprocesser i hverdagen.

Vi søger dig, der•    er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent•    er nysgerrig og har mod på at stille spørgsmål•    tør være ærlig om dine usikkerheder og ser fejl som en mulighed for læring•    kommunikerer tydeligt og har blik for betydningen af stærke relationer•    møder mennesker med respekt, nærvær og ydmyghed•    har lyst til at indgå i et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi reflekterer, udfordrer og udvikler os sammen

Hos os får du•    et stærkt fagligt og kollegialt fællesskab•    en grundig introduktion og gode muligheder for at udvikle dig i rollen•    supervision samt rum til faglig refleksion og sparring•    en arbejdsplads præget af engagement, arbejdsglæde og faglig stolthed•    mulighed for at gøre en meningsfuld forskel for mennesker hver eneste dag

Om SønderparkenSønderparken ligger i Hornsyld og tilbyder hjem og støtte til 35 borgere, som bor i egne lejligheder fordelt på tre afdelinger.Borgerne er primært yngre mennesker med komplekse psykiske problemstillinger inden for målgrupper som skizofreni, personlighedsforstyrrelser, angst og depression selvskadende adfærd mm., som midlertidigt har behov for støtte til at mestre hverdagen og skabe retning i deres liv. Vi arbejder ud fra en recoveryorienteret og rehabiliterende tilgang, hvor borgerens håb, ønsker og mål er styrende for indsatsen.

RefleksionsspørgsmålFor at lære dig bedre at kende vil vi gerne at du i din ansøgning ligger vægt på følgende spørgsmål:

Hvordan arbejder du med at understøtte borgerens håb, ønsker og drømme, også når de adskiller sig fra dine egne faglige vurderinger?

Ansøgning og ansættelseStillingen indebærer dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Ann Spoorendonk på mail Ann.Spoorendonk@social.rm.dk og evt. Aftale tid til opringning.Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Ansættelse: 1.2.2027 eller snarest derefterAnsøgningsfrist: 06.12.2026Samtaler afholdes: 14.12.2026

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position: Challenge-based Research in the Humanities
jobs.description:
The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry invites applications for a 2-year postdoc to be filled by February 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

In recent years, a set of overlapping but different concepts have been used to describe a more world-oriented direction of the research conducted at universities: applied science, mission-driven research, challenge-based inquiry etc. These concepts and methods take on specific forms when they are adopted in the humanities. From a sociology of science or history of science perspective, the postdoc is expected 1) to map recent years' transformation within the academy towards challenge-based approaches and specific initiatives in Denmark and the Nordic countries – with a focus on the humanities, 2) to map how Danish and Nordic scholars in the humanities themselves engage in and conceptualize research on societal challenges, how they cooperate with external partners, and what humanists themselves consider to be the possibilities and challenges of this type of research, 3) to conduct an individual research project within this area, and 4) to contribute to the activities and events in the center.

The Nordic Humanities Center for Challenge-Based Inquiry is an innovative and ambitious center of advanced study that fosters new ways of doing humanities research. The center has been established in a collaboration between the faculties of the Humanities at the University of Copenhagen and the University of Southern Denmark with the generous support of the A.P. Møller Foundation. Over the course of the next six years, the center will each year gather a group of scholars at the two universities to marshal insights from the humanities and develop new perspectives, nuances, frames, and narratives for one of the many local and global societal challenges such as, for example, inequality, war, health, artificial intelligence, or the climate crisis. 

A more detailed description of the center and its mission can be found here

Please read more about the position here

jobs.title: Procesoperator (locatie in Terneuzen, Nederland)
jobs.description:
Als Procesoperator bij Dow werk je bij één van de wereldwijde marktleiders in kunststoffen en chemicaliën. Je kunt aan de slag in één van onze 16 fabrieken op onze plant in Terneuzen, Nederland (20 minuten rijden vanaf de Belgische grens). Op basis van jouw voorkeuren en de beschikbare vacatures kijken we samen waar de beste match ligt.

In elke fabriek werk je met moderne productie‑installaties waarin de nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen worden toegepast. Zo draag je bij aan het maken van materialen voor uiteenlopende markten, van sneakers tot matrassen en verpakkingen to voertuigen. Je komt te werken in een 5-ploegensysteem (2:2:2).

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Respecteren van beleid en procedures: Je werkt volgens vastgestelde richtlijnen om een veilige bedrijfsvoering te garanderen en de productiedoelstellingen te behalen binnen de geldende kwaliteits‑ en veiligheidsnormen.

  • Bedienen en controleren van procesapparatuur: Je bewaakt het productieproces en grijpt in waar nodig.

  • Beoordelen van afwijkingen en analyseren van fabriekscondities: Je monitort procesvoering en apparatuur, signaleert afwijkingen en onderneemt tijdig de juiste acties met oog voor veiligheid, milieu en kwaliteit. Hierbij maak je gebruik van moderne systemen voor uitvoering en rapportage.

  • Technisch onderhoud en reparatie: Je voert zelfstandig of in teamverband onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit, waaronder kleine reparaties en preventief onderhoud, volgens de geldende procedures.

  • Procesverbetering: Je zet jouw proceskennis actief in om de prestaties van de fabriek te verbeteren, met bijzondere aandacht voor veiligheid en milieu.

Kwalificaties

  • Een afgeronde technische TSO-opleiding OF een afgeronde BSO-opleiding + drie jaar relevante werkervaring.

Jouw vaardigheden

  • Operationeel probleemoplossend vermogen: Je voert geplande werkzaamheden zorgvuldig uit en weet effectief te reageren op onverwachte situaties.
  • Teamspeler: Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen en tussen ploegendiensten, deelt kennis en zorgt voor een soepele overdracht. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en durft beslissingen te nemen.
  • Leergierig: Je bent gemotiveerd om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen en volgt met enthousiasme een gestructureerd opleidingsprogramma om onze fabriek goed te leren kennen.
  • Flexibiliteit: Je werkt in een 5‑ploegendienst en bent bereid om trainingen te volgen die nodig zijn om je rol optimaal te vervullen.

jobs.description:
Idræts-, natur/teknologi- og engelsklærer til mellemtrinet på Hedegårdsskolen

Skal du være med på et stærkt hold? Et sted, hvor børnenes læring og trivsel er en fælles opgave.Om arbejdspladsen:Hedegårdsskolen er beliggende i skoledistriktet Brønderslev Vest med i alt 6 undervisningssteder. Læs mere her: Hedegårdsskolen | Skoledistrikt Vest Hedegårdsskolen har lidt over 800 elever fordelt fra 0. til 10. klasse, samt en specialafdeling. Der er tre spor på alle årgange og fire spor på enkelte årgange i udskolingen.Skolen har ca. 65 lærere og 25 pædagoger.Med ansættelsen ønsker vi en lærer, der kan planlægge og varetage undervisning i idræt, natur-teknologi og engelsk samt andre undervisningsfag i 4. – 6. klasse. 

Ansøgningsfrist søndag d. 29. november – vedlæg eksamensbevis/prøvebeviser, da dette er et krav for at blive kaldt til samtale. Hvis ens uddannelse ikke er færdiggjort bedes eksamensbeviserne eftersendt. Yderligere info om stillingen kan erhverves ved henvendelse til afdelinfgsleder Lone Møller Mikkelsen 50 81 81 12. Send gerne sms hvis du ønsker et opkald.Vores værdier:Vi søger en lærer, som trives i fællesskaber og i et tæt teamsamarbejde baseret på årgangsteam. Det betyder, at ingen alene har de bedste løsninger for vores børn. På mellemtrinet vægter vi ligeledes et tæt samarbejde om børnenes læring og trivsel og om at styrke fællesskaber i klasserne. Vi har derfor brug for en lærer, som trives ved at arbejde i årgangsteams, som tror på, at vi sammen gør hinanden bedre, og som har mod på at udfordre andres synspunkter samt selv at blive udfordret på sine synspunkter. Vi vægter desuden et tæt og positivt samarbejde med vores forældre højt, og at der er en god kommunikation omkring børnene mellem skole og hjem.

Vi arbejder ud fra en forventningsmodel, der beskriver forventninger til medarbejdere og ledere i Brønderslev Kommune. 

Nogle af forventningerne til medarbejdere, er:-At du har fokus på kerneopgaven og leverer resultater ud fra de givne mål og rammer-At du har en faglig stolthed, og at du kan og vil samarbejde med dine kolleger/samarbejdspartnere om opgaveløsningerne

-At du selvstændigt og i samarbejde med andre kan forberede, gennemføre og evaluere din undervisning-At du er medansvarlig for god trivsel ved at være positiv og konstruktiv-At du arbejder ud fra de givne rammer og ser dig selv som en del af det store fællesskab i Brønderslev KommuneDu kan læse mere om, hvilke andre forventninger, der er til en medarbejder i vores forventningsmodel påfølgende link:

Forventningsmodellen (sharepoint.com)Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte:Lone Møller MikkelsenAfdelingsleder, Hedegårdsskolen+45, lone.m.mikkelsen@99454545.dk 

Brønderslev Kommunes medarbejdersyn bygger på følgende: 

  • Vi er "I samspil med borgerne”, hvilket vi støtter op gennem vores værdier: Fællesskabende, Modig og Nysgerrig. 
  • I Brønderslev Kommune og på den enkelte arbejdsplads, er det både naturligt, legitimt og velset, at medarbejdere viser interesse for og debatterer arbejdspladsens forhold gennem dialog og samarbejde.
  • Vi arbejder ud fra en forventningsmodel, der beskriver forventninger til medarbejdere og ledere i Brønderslev Kommune.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellowship in Political Science (3-4 years)
jobs.description:
About the position

We are offering a PhD Research Fellow (SKO 1017) in political science with a specialization in public policy and public administration. The successful applicant will be part of the research project "How Policy Growth Affects Policy Implementation and Performance" (POLIGROW) funded by the Norwegian Research Council. The PhD fellowship period is three years and devoted to carrying out research and pursuing a PhD in the context of the POLIGROW project. The position may also include other career-enhancing activities: depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period may be extended to a maximum of four years to accommodate qualifying activities, such as teaching responsibilities.

The POLIGROW project studies how policy growth affects the administrative structures, working routines and performance of the authorities in charge of implementation. The project is organized in three work packages. The first work package maps and explains how policy growth changes administrative structures, drawing on new hand-coded data on implementation tasks and the public and private organizations responsible for them in environmental/climate and social policy across 15 OECD countries from 1975 to 2025. The second work package examines how policy growth affects the working routines and coping practices of bureaucrats, such as policy triage, negative coordination, and selective oversight of private contractors, through comparative case studies, document analysis and semi-structured interviews with public officials. The third work package analyses how different patterns of burden allocation affect policy effectiveness, linking administrative structures to environmental and social performance using time-series-cross-section and difference-in-differences designs.

POLIGROW will produce the first cross-national dataset covering all implementing authorities and their tasks across multiple sectors, to be published on a publicly accessible data platform. The project also places strong emphasis on societal impact, with policy briefs, workshops and webinars organized with practitioners. 

The PhD Fellow is expected to develop an independent research project within the overarching thematic scope of POLIGROW. The individual project should align with the project's overall framework, for example by focusing on one of the three work packages, a specific policy sector, or a subset of countries. The candidate will have considerable freedom in developing their research questions, theoretical approach, and methodological design, whether quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods.

At the same time, the PhD Fellow will play an active role in the project's collective research activities, particularly in Work Package I. This includes contributing to the development of the coding manual and the coding of implementation structures. Candidates are therefore expected to design a PhD project that makes substantial use of data generated through POLIGROW: data they help collect themselves and/or other data produced within the project. The intention is that the collaborative data collection forms an integral part of the PhD project and provides a foundation for the candidate's own research. The research project proposal should include a tentative overall thematic and theoretical framework, along with at least three ideas for academic articles (see details below).

The successful candidate will be part of the Faculty’s PhD programme. The work is expected to lead to a PhD in political science.

To promote a strategic career path, all PhD fellows are expected to submit a career development plan, specifying career goals and the competencies that the PhD fellow should acquire, no later than one month after commencement of the fellowship period. The department is responsible for ensuring that the plan is followed up and that the PhD fellow has access to career guidance throughout the duration of the fellowship. 

Qualification requirements

Formal qualifications

  • The applicant’s prior education must correspond to five years of university-level education in Norway in political science or a related field, of which two years (120 ECTS credits) are at the master's level.
  • The master's degree should have a conventional academic and theoretical orientation and not be an experience-based or professionally oriented master's degree.
  • The master's thesis must be equivalent to at least half a year's full-time study (30 ECTS credits).
  • The master's degree must include relevant training in research design and methods.
  • Applicants must have an excellent academic record, normally corresponding to grades in the upper range of the Norwegian A – F grading scale (i.e., A (excellent) – B (very good)), or comparable academic achievement under other grading systems.
  • Please see the admissions requirements for the PhD programme for further details on qualification requirements.

Applications from candidates who do not fulfil all formal qualification requirements will be excluded from further assessment. 

Other qualifications

  • Applicants must have a very good to excellent command of English language (written and oral).
  • Language skills relevant to the countries covered by the project (e.g. German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese or a Scandinavian language) are an advantage. 
  • Applicants are required to possess robust empirical research knowledge within political science, with proficiency in quantitative or qualitative analysis.
  • Experience with manual data coding or interview-based research is an advantage but not a requirement.
  • Possessing knowledge of public administration, policy implementation, or environmental/climate or social policy is an advantage but not a requirement.

The evaluation of applicants is primarily based on documented academic qualifications and the research project proposal. 

During the initial screening phase among eligible applicants, particular emphasis is placed on academic performance and the quality of the master's thesis. Given the highly competitive nature of the position, shortlisted candidates will normally have an excellent academic record and a highly commendable or outstanding master's thesis.

In the subsequent phase of the selection process, greater emphasis is placed on the quality and fit of the research proposal. Factors such as personal suitability, motivation, and compatibility with the project team will also be taken into consideration. 

 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues - could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We offer
  • Salary according to “SKO 1017 PhD fellow”, NOK 565 700 - 625 000 per year.
  • Personal research funds that can be used for e.g. travel and research assistance (currently NOK 35 000 per year).
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • Involvement in a large research project that provides opportunities to build a network with scholars researching political elites around the world, including an annual workshop on the topic.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Attractive UiO welfare benefits
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the University’s kindergarten).
  • Norway’s capital with its easy access to beautiful nature and rich cultural life.
  • Introduction course for PhD Fellows: Teaching as a PhD candidate
  • Annual career development conversation based on the submitted career plan. 
  • Various courses and workshops supporting career development (e.g., on dissemination and presentation skills, op-ed writing, and stress-management).
  • Practical support for international staff moving to Norway (https://www.uio.no/english/about/jobs/ismo/) (international staff may also benefit from tax cuts in their first years)
How to apply

The application with attachments must be submitted in our electronic recruiting system. Please follow the link “apply for this job”.

The online application must include the following items, which are to be submitted before the deadline (all documents should be in English or a Scandinavian language):

  • A cover letter (maximum 2 pages), including a statement of motivation
  • A research proposal (maximum 3,000 words including all references and footnotes - a word count must be provided on the front page). The proposal should clarify the research theme, main research questions, how the research contributes to existing literature and the project, theoretical approach, methodology, article ideas, and a timeline. A final research proposal must be developed in cooperation with the project leader within three months of the start date. 
  • A CV summarizing education, positions, research and pedagogical experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities. Career breaks, including parental leave, that are noted in the CV will be taken into consideration when evaluating applicants' academic record.
  • Copy of Master’s thesis (in English or in a Scandinavian language).
  • Copies of transcripts: All applicants must submit their Master’s degree diploma and transcript(s), preferably together with a class distribution of grades. The transcript must specify the grade achieved for the Master’s thesis.
  • Official explanation of the grading and credit system at your university (foreign applicants).
  • Applicants who have completed their education outside of the EU/EEA-area and who do not have English as a native language or who have not completed an English-language MA program must document English language skills: TOEFL - with a minimum result of 550 on the Paper-based Test (PBT), or 80 on the Internet-Based Test (iBT) or IELTS - International English Language Testing Service, with the result 6.0. 
  • Names and contact details for 2-3 reference persons (name, relationship to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). Reference letters are not needed.

The application deadline is December 14, 2026. The screening and evaluation of candidates will begin immediately. The most promising candidates will be invited for interviews. We expect the whole evaluation process, from the application date to an offer being made, to take 6 to 12 weeks, depending on the number of applications. The expected start date is April 1st, 2027, but is subject to negotiation. 

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Political Science is part of the Faculty of Social Sciences. It is the largest political science department in Norway and covers all subfields of the discipline: international politics, public policy and administration, comparative politics, political theory and research methods. The department offers a vibrant academic environment with a good mix of permanent staff, postdoctoral and PhD fellows. Around 1,400 students are currently enrolled at BA, MA and PhD level. The department runs two large political science programmes at BA and MA level. In addition, the department hosts interdisciplinary study programmes in International Studies, Public Administration and Leadership, and Peace and Conflict Studies. The department has several research groups, including Comparative Institutions and Regimes, Policy, Bureaucracy and Organization, and Political Data Science. The Department also hosts the interdisciplinary Center for Research on Extremism (C-REX).

jobs.title: Experienced movers wanted! Apply now

  • Providing professional and friendly customer interaction

     

We are looking for candidates who:

jobs.title: Serviceassistent søges til vores team i Midtjylland, 30-37 timer om ugen (Barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Vi mangler dig på vores rengøringshold.

Hos Jysk System Rengøring A/S søger vi en rengøringsmedarbejder til vores kunder i Viborg og omegn med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du får en fast plan for rengøring ved vores erhvervskunder mens vores medarbejder er på barsel.

 Der kan blive mulighed for faste timer.

Et job med variation og ansvar

Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores kunder møder rene og indbydende lokaler. Dagene varierer og i de fleste af timerne, går du i dagtimerne hos vores kunder. 

Vi vil gerne høre fra dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med rengøring og blik for detaljerne.

  • Møder til tiden og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og er klar på at hjælpe kollegerne.

  • Er fleksibel og trives med, at dagene ikke altid er ens.

  • Møder kunder og kolleger med et smil og en ordentlig tone.

 

Du bliver en del af JSR

Hos os lægger vi vægt på ordentlighed, samarbejde og rengøring, vi kan stå inde for. Du får altid en fast kontaktperson, så du ved, hvem du skal tage fat i om opgaver og planlægning.

 

Skal du med på holdet?

Send en kort ansøgning til Mads Stampe Poulsen på msp@jsr-as.dk. Skriv lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med rengøring, hvor mange timer du ønsker, og hvornår du har mulighed for at arbejde og starte.

 

Skriv “Rengøringsmedarbejder Midt” i emnefeltet. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du også velkommen til at skrive til Mads.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Loimaalle
jobs.description: **Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Loimaalla. Käynnit noin kolme kertaa viikossa klo 8-14.30.Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää avustajia tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa.""Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."**Helpperinä saat:**Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.Lähetä hakemus helpperiksi täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksiLue lisää Hembystä täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja, ILTAVUOROJA, Raisio/keskusta
jobs.description: Vuonna -76 syntyneelle liikuntarajoitteiselle pariskunnalle haetaan lisää avustajia iltavuorolaisten rinkiin. Työaika iltavuorossa on klo 16-23, työpäivien määrä vaihtelee. Tähän vaikuttaa ensisijaisesti työnantajan tarve, mutta myös avustajan oma toive. Avustajalta ei vaadita erityisosaamisia, työnantaja perehdyttää työhön ja työtehtäviin. Haetaan luotettavaa ja työhönsä sitoutuvaa, rehellistä naishenkilöä.Toinen käyttää liikkumisen apuvälineenä pyörätuolia sekä sähköpyörätuolia, turneri on tarvittaessa käytössä siirroissa. Toinen on pienikokoinen ja hän siirtyy itse, mutta nostaa pitää tarvittaessa. Avustajan valinnasta päättää työnantaja itse.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja & avustaja Luumäelle
jobs.description: Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Etsimme avustajaa ja kotisiivoojaa asiakkaallemme Luumäelle. Käynnit noin 1-2 kertaa viikossa.Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa." - "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." - "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen." Helpperinä saat:- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan. - Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accountant - Private Equity (m/f)
jobs.description: Senior Fund Accountant - Private Equity The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for servicing a portfolio of funds and other structures and will ensure the smooth operation of the structure and that deadlines are met on time.  Responsibilities Operational activities • Prepare annual IFRS financial statements, cash flows and associated notes for funds.• Conduct periodic investor reporting, including net asset value (NAV) calculation.• Review the fund accounting prepared by junior team members.• Review statutory annual accounts of Luxembourg companies/funds in accordance with Luxembourg GAAP.• Calculate management fees/equalisation charges, performance fees and loan interest.• Coordinate year-end audits.• Review Luxembourg statutory reporting. • Review bank payments in various banking platforms and ensure necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process.• Review drawdowns, distributions, calculations, and notices.• Review Limited Partners registers.• Calculate carried interest.• Assist in the billing and debt collection process of assigned clients.Client Relationship Management • Manage client relationships, including ongoing multi-channel communication such as face-to-face, telephone and email.• Pro-actively build strong relationships with clients and other third party service providers (tax advisors and auditors) and act as their first point of contact.• Persevere with non-responsive clients to find alternative ways of working and solutions to aid the timely delivery of information. We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. Relevant initiatives include Destination Earth (DestinE), ESA Digital Twin Earth and EO Digital Twin Components, as well as EU-funded ecosystem and biodiversity digital-twin projects such as TerraTwin and BioDT. Complementary initiatives, including the European Green Deal Data Space and the Common European Agricultural Data Space, provide a framework for interoperable and trusted data sharing across stakeholders. The selected researcher will be mainly in charge of:• Designing and evaluating LLM-based, tool-using and multi-agent systems to orchestrate EO data access, geospatial processing, environmental models, simulations and digital-twin services.• Translating natural-language questions into traceable model configurations and executable workflows, with robust planning, verification, spatial/temporal reasoning, uncertainty handling and explainable outputs.• Contributing to ongoing interdisciplinary RDI projects and co-developing scalable, reproducible solutions with EO scientists, environmental modellers and infrastructure specialists.• Connecting AI workflows with cloud/HPC environments, research infrastructures and, where relevant, distributed sensing and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication systems, working with infrastructure specialists to support interoperable access to IoT sensor streams, satellite observations, weather data and model services across stakeholders, with appropriate data governance and traceability.• Initiating and leading new interdisciplinary research projects, partnerships and competitive proposals; supervising researchers; and disseminating and valorising results. You'll set the standards and standard operating procedures that make impact consistent and compliant everywhere, drive execution to ambitious donation targets (including $10M in procurement donations in 2027), and make Community Impact visible all the way up to senior leadership.Drive excellence - raise execution quality and consistency of CI programs across 26 countriesOwn regulations & compliance - ensure CI activity is compliant, regulation-aligned, and auditableLead donations execution - including the Waste to Worth standard operating procedure and the $10M 2027 procurement-donations targetGovern & report - embed CI performance into Monthly Business Review and Quarterly Business Review forums and leadership communicationsSet the strategy - shape the multi-year strategy for Community Impact excellence and standardsKey job responsibilitiesStrategy - Own and drive the multi-year strategy for Community Impact excellence and standards: define the vision, the roadmap to scale consistency and quality across all five pillars and 26 countries, and the long-term path to a world-class CI operating model.Standards, Policy & Process - Define and own the GPO CI standards, policy, and process across all five pillars; embed CI requirements into GPO's procurement processes so impact activity is a defined, consistent step across every country rather than ad-hoc and local.Regulations & Compliance - Own CI regulatory alignment and compliance across all 26 countries; maintain vetting and eligibility standards for NGOs, charities, suppliers, and partners with documented, auditable approval gates so CI activity routes through a compliant, risk-screened pathway.Execution Excellence (incl. Waste to Worth & Donations) - Ensure quality and consistency of CI program execution across pillars and countries. Within this, lead GPO CI procurement donations (not supplier donations) end-to-end to a $10M 2027 target, and execute the Waste to Worth standard operating procedure (surplus and non-inventory product donations) globally.Governance & Communication - Own the CI governance cadence: embed CI performance, standards, and compliance into Monthly Business Review and Quarterly Business Review forums, and run the communication plan that keeps Global Procurement Sustainability leadership, GPO leadership, and country stakeholders aligned on CI strategy and targets.A day in the lifeThe Community Impact Excellence & Standards role is the owner of excellence, standards, and governance for the full GPO Community Impact (CI) team. The role brings strategy, policy, standards, regulatory, compliance, execution, and governance discipline across all five CI pillars: Supplier for Good, Procurement for Good, Waste to Worth, Space for Good / GPO Donation Hubs, and IDonate - globally across 26 countries.This role makes CI consistent, compliant, measurable, and world-class: setting the standards and standard operating procedures that define how CI is executed everywhere, ensuring regulatory and recipient/partner compliance, raising execution quality, and building the governance and reporting that make CI impact visible to leadership.Within this remit, the role also leads and owns GPO CI procurement donations end-to-end - not supplier donations - globally across 26 countries, including the Waste to Worth standard operating procedure and its execution, with a target of $10M in donations for 2027. Donations and Waste to Worth are a flagship execution stream inside the broader excellence-and-standards mandate.The outcome is a Community Impact function that is standardized, compliant by design, regulation-aligned, executed to target, and measurable - and able to demonstrate the link between procurement activity and community sentiment toward Amazon, and ultimately the Profit & LossBasic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree- Experience in cross functional project delivery- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams- Experience in program or project management- Experience in supply chain- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvementsPreferred Qualifications- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadershipAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. You will lead complex legal and regulatory projects, advise international clients and act as a key point of contact for the CSSF, service providers and internal stakeholders.The position combines technical fund law expertise, client-facing advisory work and hands-on project management. Role:UCITS Product Development & Fund Documentation:• Lead the drafting, review and coordination of UCITS prospectuses and related fund documentation.• Take responsibility for legal and regulatory and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds and assess their impact on existing structures and documentation.Legal Review & Contractual Matters:• Review, negotiate and coordinate fund-related agreements.• Support the onboarding and oversight of service providers and distribution networks.• Provide practical and commercially focused legal advice to clients and internal stakeholders.Client & Project Management:• Act as a trusted legal advisor for a portfolio of international clients.• Lead complex legal and regulatory projects from inception through implementation.• Coordinate effectively with regulators, clients, service providers and internal teams across multiple jurisdictions.• Ensure high-quality delivery under demanding regulatory and commercial deadlines.Candidate Profile:Education & Experience:• Master's Degree in Law or an equivalent legal qualification.• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience gained within: • A Luxembourg Management Company;• An AIFM;• A law firm; or• A specialised investment fund services provider.• Proven experience in UCITS prospectus drafting, CSSF approval processes and Luxembourg fund lifecycle events is essential.• Experience managing fund lifecycle events and regulatory projects is highly desirable.Technical Expertise:Strong knowledge of:• UCITS regulation and Luxembourg investment fund law;• Fund governance and lifecycle events;• CSSF regulatory requirements and approval processes; and• Alternative investment fund structures, including RAIFs, SIFs and SICARs.Knowledge of French and/or Belgian investment fund regulation would be considered an asset.Skills & Competencies:• Excellent legal drafting and analytical skills.• Strong project management and organisational abilities.• Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously.• Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach.• Client-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness.• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.• Ability to work autonomously whilst collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.Languages:• Fluent English (written and spoken).• Fluent French (written and spoken).• Ability to draft and review legal documentation in both languages.Why Join Fundsight?• Take ownership of sophisticated UCITS legal and regulatory projects from structuring to launch.• Draft and manage prospectuses and key fund documentation for international asset managers and fund sponsors.• Work at the heart of CSSF approval processes, regulatory filings and fund lifecycle events.• Join a growing, entrepreneurial and independent Luxembourg Management Company and AIFM.• Benefit from direct client exposure, visible responsibility and close interaction with senior decision-makers.• Collaborate with experienced professionals across legal, compliance, risk, oversight and business development functions.• Work from modern offices in Cloche d'Or, Luxembourg, in the heart of a dynamic business district.• Enjoy flexible working arrangements, a teleworking policy, lunch vouchers and additional private health insurance.• Gain international exposure through leading asset managers, investment funds and institutional clients.• Develop your career in a role combining technical excellence, business proximity and long-term growth opportunities.Who We Are Looking For:We are looking for a commercially minded investment funds lawyer with strong technical expertise in Luxembourg UCITS, proven experience in prospectus drafting and a solid understanding of CSSF approval processes. jobs.title: POSTDOC IN SILICON CARBIDE NANOPHOTONIC QUANTUM DEVICES (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: Fixed term contract | Belval | up to 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? Join us for building the next generation of semiconductor quantum chips!You will be part of the LIST's Quantum Materials group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.Within our FNR PEARL project “AQuaTSiC”, you will help us to develop and use the next-generation silicon carbide quantum nanophotonic devices for on-chip entanglement experiments-You will get access to our nanofabrication lab, and further develop our wafer-scale nanophotonic device engineering toolset. You will create nanophotonic devices, such as inverted nanocones, free-standing waveguides and cavities, and explore the potential of SiC-on-insulator materials.Based on these advances, you will support experiments targeting spin-photon entanglement for quantum networks, as well as photonic interference between distant colour centres for distributed quantum computing.With this project, you will initiate disruptive breakthroughs towards scalable quantum technologies based on industrial semiconductors.Optional follow-up funding until mid-2030 is available, as well as the principal possibility to develop additional projects. jobs.title: Instructeur de natation“ (m/w/d) mit CATP / DAP und Meisterbrief
jobs.description: Die Stadtverwaltung Grevenmacher stellt für das städtische Freibad einen Arbeitsnehmer (m/w/d) mit manueller Tätigkeit im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ mit CATP / DAP ein.Arbeitsvertrag: unbefristet.Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%.Einstellung: ab März 2027Einstellungsbedingungen:–      Staatsangehöriger eines Mitgliedstaates der EU;–      Sprachkenntnisse in Luxemburgisch, Deutsch und Französisch;–      Besitz der zivilen und politischen Rechte;–      Führerschein der Klasse B;–      CATP / DAP im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ (oder ein vom Ministerium für Erziehung und Berufsausbildung als gleichwertig anerkanntes ausländisches Diplom)Der Kandidat muss im Besitz eines Meisterbriefes als geprüfter Meister für Bäderbetriebe sein. Aufgaben:–      Überwachung der Schwimmbecken;–      Kontrolle und Wartung aller sich im Freibad befindlichen technischen Anlagen;–      Außerhalb der Freibadsaison hat der Arbeitnehmer jede ihm übertragene aufgetragene Arbeit zu verrichten, seinen Kräften und Fähigkeiten entsprechende andere Aufgaben anzunehmen und diese gewissenhaft und ordnungsgemäß auszuführen, auch wenn diese nicht in seinen direkten Arbeitsbereich fallen.Der Schöffenrat hat das Recht, den Arbeitsnehmer je nach den Erfordernissen der Verwaltung in jeder Abteilung der Stadt Grevenmacher einzusetzen.Während der Freibadsaison sind die täglichen und wöchentlichen Arbeitszeiten mittels eines vom Schöffenkollegium aufgestellten Dienstplans geregelt. Des Weiteren wird Urlaubsanträgen während der Freibadsaison nur in Ausnahmefällen stattgegeben.Außerhalb der Freibadsaison sind die Arbeitszeiten von 7.00 Uhr bis 12.00 Uhr und von 13.00 Uhr bis 16.00 Uhr.Beizufügende Unterlagen:–      Bewerbungsschreiben;–      Ausführlicher Lebenslauf mit Foto;–      Kopie des CATP / DAP- Diploms / des Meisterbriefes;–      Geburtsurkunde (nicht älter als 2 Monate);–      Auszug aus dem Strafregister (nicht älter als 2 Monate)–      Passfoto–      Kopie eines Ausweisdokumentes;–      Kopie des Führerscheins.Unvollständige Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt Beschäftigungsbedingungen und Vergütung:Spätestens bei Dienstantritt muss der Kandidat die für die Ausübung seines Amtes erforderliche körperliche Eignung nachweisen. Die körperliche Eignung wird vom Arbeitsarzt auf Antrag der Gemeindeverwaltung festgestellt.Die Feststellung der körperlichen Untauglichkeit durch den Arbeitsarzt, auch nachdem der betreffende Arbeitnehmer seine Arbeit aufgenommen hat, führt zur Auflösung des Arbeitsvertrags.Die Einstellung erfolgt durch Unterzeichnung eines unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrages nach den Bestimmungen des Kollektivvertrages der Stadt Grevenmacher.Die ersten drei Monate ab dem Datum des Dienstantritts gelten als Probezeit.Der Arbeitnehmer wird in die ME-Laufbahn (Gehaltsgruppen 6, 7 und 8) des Kollektivvertrags für die Angestellten der Stadt Grevenmacher eingestuft.Die ersten zwei Jahre ab dem Datum der Einstellung sind grundsätzlich eine Einarbeitungszeit und werden auf der Grundlage der ersten Stufe der ME-Laufbahn (147 Indexpunkte – 3.684,87.-€, bezahlt).Nach einer positiven Beurteilung am Ende der Einarbeitungszeit wird die endgültige Laufbahn des Beschäftigten unter Berücksichtigung der Vordienstzeit festgelegt.Je nach Berufserfahrung kann der Schöffenrat beschließen, die Einarbeitungszeit zu verkürzen oder ganz darauf zu verzichten.Der Arbeitnehmer hat Anspruch auf eine Kompensationsprämie (13 Indexpunkte – 325,87.-€), eine Essenszulage (11 Indexpunkte – 275,74.-€) und Kleidergeld (2 Indexpunkte – 50,13.-€). Gegebenenfalls erhält der Arbeitnehmer eine Familienzulage von 29 Indexpunkten – 726,95.-€.Das Gehalt wird zu Beginn des Folgemonats gezahlt, für den das Gehalt fällig ist, spätestens jedoch am 5. des Monats.Eine Jahresendzulage wird zusammen mit dem Dezembergehalt gezahlt.Verschiedenes:Der Arbeitnehmer wird bei der Caisse Nationale de Santé und der Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Pension angemeldet.Die Kandidaten werden gebeten Ihre Bewerbung bis spätestens Dienstag, den 1. Dezember 2026 über die Plattform „Skeeled“ (www.grevenmacher.lu – Veröffentlichungen – Jobs) einzureichen. Die Personalabteilung steht Ihnen für weitere Auskünfte gerne zur Verfügung:Tel.: 75 03 11 -2021 (Frau Steffen) oder -2031 (Herr Lanser)E-Mail: personnel@grevenmacher.lu

jobs.description: Directeur Général Adjoint (H/F/D) CDI - Temps plein - Luxembourg (Strassen) Réf. : AeS/DGA Rejoignez l'Agence eSanté L'Agence eSanté, agence nationale des informations partagées dans le domaine de la santé, joue un rôle central dans la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois. Elle développe et opère les services qui permettent aux patients et aux professionnels de santé d'échanger et de partager les données de santé en toute sécurité : dossier de soins partagé, réseau sécurisé HealthNet, annuaires nationaux des patients et des professionnels, carnet de vaccination électronique, messagerie sécurisée, échanges transfrontaliers de données de santé, entre autres. Les années à venir sont décisives : la mise en oeuvre du règlement européen sur l'Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS) et le développement de la nouvelle génération du dossier de soins partagé s'accompagnent d'une forte croissance de l'Agence et de ses effectifs. L'Agence eSanté recrute un(e) Directeur Général Adjoint. Directement rattaché(e) au Directeur Général et membre du Comité de Direction, vous contribuez au pilotage et au développement de l'Agence. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de la Direction, les différentes fonctions de l'Agence et ses instances de gouvernance, notamment le Président du Conseil de gérance. Votre mission En tant que Directeur Général Adjoint, vous accompagnez le Directeur Général dans la direction, le pilotage et le développement de l'Agence et contribuez à la mise en oeuvre de ses orientations stratégiques. Membre du Comité de Direction, vous participez à la gouvernance de l'Agence, préparez les décisions et arbitrages et accompagnez les transformations organisationnelles nécessaires à son développement. Vous pilotez les fonctions support de l'Agence (ressources humaines, finances, secrétariat, qualité et organisation, juridique, conformité, marchés publics, formation et formation continue, contrats ainsi que communication), veillez à la performance et à la cohérence des dispositifs transverses et représentez l'Agence dans le cadre des délégations qui vous sont confiées. Vos principales responsabilités • Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des orientations stratégiques et au développement de l'Agence, en accompagnant le Directeur Général dans la définition des priorités et leur déclinaison opérationnelle, • Participer à la gouvernance de l'Agence, conseiller le Directeur Général, préparer les décisions et arbitrages soumis aux instances compétentes et veiller au suivi de leur mise en oeuvre, • Assurer le secrétariat du Conseil de gérance et de l'Assemblée générale : préparation des séances et des dossiers, rédaction des procès-verbaux et relevés de décisions, suivi de l'exécution des décisions, • Superviser les programmes et projets de transformation organisationnelle conduits pour le compte du Comité de Direction, en veillant à leur avancement, à leurs moyens et à la préparation des décisions nécessaires, • Piloter les fonctions placées sous votre responsabilité, garantir la cohérence de leurs activités et veiller à la disponibilité et à l'utilisation optimale des ressources de l'Agence, • Contribuer aux orientations budgétaires et financières et piloter la préparation, l'exécution et le suivi budgétaire annuel et pluriannuel dans le cadre des responsabilités déléguées, • Veiller à la cohérence des politiques, processus et dispositifs de gouvernance interne et superviser les dispositifs de contrôle et de conformité relevant de votre périmètre, dans le respect des responsabilités et de l'indépendance des fonctions compétentes, • Piloter la performance et la maîtrise des risques relevant de votre périmètre, en coordonnant les démarches d'audit, de certification et d'amélioration continue avec les fonctions compétentes, • Favoriser la coopération entre les fonctions et contribuer, aux côtés du Directeur Général, à la préparation et à la conduite du dialogue social, • Manager et développer les responsables placés sous votre autorité, renforcer leurs compétences managériales et promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de coopération et de remontée précoce des difficultés, • Représenter l'Agence auprès des autorités et partenaires institutionnels dans le cadre de vos délégations et assurer la suppléance du Directeur Général conformément aux dispositions applicables. jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at tage nogle vagter på Læsø – når du kan og har tid – så er det nu, at du skal læse videre.

Portfolio & Commercial Management • Own portfolio planning, utilisation, time recording, recoverability, work in progress and invoicing discipline, taking timely action where performance falls outside expectations. • Provide relevant forecasting and portfolio information to the Jurisdiction Lead. • Contribute technical and delivery input to proposals, DDQs, client pitches, pricing reviews and scope discussions. • Identify and actively pursue opportunities to deepen client relationships and broaden appropriate services. • Manage the portfolio with appropriate attention to scope, efficiency, recoverability and sustainable service delivery, identifying and addressing scope creep, under-pricing and other issues affecting client economics. 7. Profile & Experience • Degree educated with a strong academic background in law, corporate governance, business administration, corporate services or a related discipline. • Professional qualification in Corporate Governance, Company Secretarial Practice, Law, Compliance or similar highly desirable. • +7 years' relevant experience within company secretarial, governance, fund administration, fiduciary services or a related governance environment. • Demonstrable experience managing complex Luxembourg fund, corporate or regulated financial services structures. • Strong understanding of Luxembourg corporate law, governance requirements and regulated environments. • Experience across a broad range of financial services clients or structures, which may include UCITS, alternative investment funds, management companies, banks, investment managers and related corporate entities. • Demonstrable experience leading, supervising and developing governance professionals. • Experience owning a portfolio of clients and managing relationships with boards and senior stakeholders. • Experience improving delivery quality, standardising processes and implementing operational change. • Excellent communication skills and fluent written and spoken English. Additional European languages advantageous.
