jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Experimental Cancer Biophysics and Quantitative Bioimaging
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

The Department of Physics and Technology is thrilled to announce a vacant position of Postdoctoral Research Fellow in the area of Experimental Cancer Biophysics and Quantitative Bioimaging at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Faculty of Science and Technology. The position is connected to the project Cymoplive funded by UiT. The position is a fixed term position for a duration of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The position's field of research

The project focuses on the development and validation of Cymoplive, a tumor-on-chip functional assay platform that uses longitudinal, label-free microscopy to investigate cancer cell responses and adaptation to therapeutic interventions.The central research objective is to identify and establish novel imaging-based functional markers of therapeutic response by investigating changes in cancer cell behaviour at both single-cell and population levels. The research will integrate advanced live-cell label-free microscopy, quantitative image analysis, and experimentally controlled therapeutic perturbations to characterize cellular motility, morphological dynamics, phenotypic heterogeneity, and adaptive responses. Using established and patient-derived cancer models, the project will investigate how these behaviours evolve under different therapeutic agents, dosing strategies, and treatment schedules.The identified markers will be quantitatively characterized and validated for their sensitivity, reproducibility, and biological relevance. Their performance will be benchmarked against conventional drug-response and complementary imaging-based assays, while their relationships with molecular markers of cancer cell plasticity will be investigated. The overarching goal is to establish robust imaging-based measures that provide additional insight into therapeutic responses beyond conventional assay endpoints, supporting their application in preclinical drug development. The position offers opportunities to develop independent research questions and methodological approaches within the project’s broader scientific objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Development and optimization of quantitative microscopy and longitudinal live-cell imaging methods. 
  • Design and execution of drug-response experiments using cancer cell models and tumor-on-chip platforms, including clinically relevant treatment regimens. 
  • Development and application of conventional and AI-based image-processing and quantitative analysis methods.• Development and validation of quantitative metrics to characterize cancer cell adaptation, functional heterogeneity, and drug responses.• Correlation of functional responses with molecular markers of cancer cell plasticity using ICC, IF, and related techniques.• Comparative evaluation of therapeutic responses across different cancer models and treatments.• Benchmarking against conventional viability assays and complementary imaging-based and functional assays.• Statistical analysis, assessment of measurement reproducibility, and contribution to scientific publications and collaborative research.
Qualifications

This position requires:

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree within a field relevant for the research theme of the position (i.e., biophysics, biomedical engineering, cancer biology, cell biology, biotechnology, quantitative bioimaging, physics, or computational biology), or a corresponding foreign doctoral degree recognised as equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree. If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. 
  • Fluency in English and good communication skills.  
  • At least two years of hands-on research experience in at least one of the following areas:- Quantitative live-cell imaging and analysis: Development or optimization of microscopy methods, image-processing workflows, and quantitative characterization of cellular behaviour.- Experimental in vitro drug-response studies: Independent design and execution of therapeutic perturbation experiments, drug-dosing regimens, and functional response assessments. 
  • Evidence of independent scientific contributions through publications, developed methods, analytical workflows, or research projects. 
  • Ability to conduct research independently and collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary environment. 

Desirable Qualifications

  • Demonstrated practical expertise in both quantitative live-cell imaging and experimental drug-response studies. 
  • Experience with tumor-on-chip platforms, patient-derived organoids, advanced 3D cancer models, or isolation and culture of challenging primary tumor samples. 
  • Experience with label-free microscopy, quantitative phase imaging, advanced image analysis or AI-based image analysis. 
  • Experience with molecular characterization techniques, including ICC, IF, or related methods. 
  • Research experience in cancer cell plasticity, migration, mechanobiology, or therapeutic resistance. 

During the assessment emphasis will be put on the candidate’s motivation, potential for research, and personal suitability for the position. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).

Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 

We offer
  • We offer the chance to work in a leading cancer biophysics area which provides an academic and innovation environment. We provide an opportunity to work in close collaboration with clinicians at UNN Hospital.
  • Involvement in an interesting research project with an international, interdisciplinary research environment, and good career opportunities including industry transition.
  • Access to state-of-the-art laboratories and imaging facilities.
  • Fantastic work environment and good remuneration within the stunning landscape of Tromsø.
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance, and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 

Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter (max 1 page): Explain your motivation for applying and your interest in the advertised position.
  • Project Plan (max. 2 pages): Outline how you would contribute to the project's research objectives, including relevant scientific questions, proposed experimental and analytical approaches, and a realistic timeline with key milestones.
  • Research Experience (max. 2 pages): Narratively describe how your skills and experience gained through published and unpublished research make you a strong fit for the project, highlighting your specific contributions, technical competencies, research independence, and areas for further development.
  • CV (must include a clear description of relevant research skills relevant and corresponding experience levels, max 4 pages)
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position.
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • List of publications (up to 10), stating which works you consider most important and relevant to the position.
  • PhD Thesis

If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.All documentation to be considered mustbe in a Scandinavian language or English. 

Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.

General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary with a gross annual salary of minimum NOK 650 000. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilize our location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately 18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta, Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT's activities. Participation, co-determination, transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous - closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments.

Read more about UiT's strategy towards 2030.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant (Oslo)
jobs.description:
What if your next tech role didn't make you choose between people and technology? At ConnectMyApps, Solutions Consultants work with both. We build integrations for client across Europe that make their business applications work together, across HR, finance, ERP, CRM and more. We're growing our Customer Solutions team and are looking for a Solutions Consultant to join us in Oslo.

What you'll do

You'll work across the whole customer journey, from first conversations and onboarding to solution design, implementation, testing and ongoing support. That includes:

→ Working out what the customer is trying to achieve, even before the requirements are technical

→ Exploring what customer and third-party systems can (and can't) do, and how their APIs let them talk to each other

→ Turning business needs into clear technical specifications

→ Using AI to help turn those specifications into reliable integrations, then reviewing, validating and refining

→ Leading test sessions with customers and stakeholders

→ Working closely with customers, partners and our team to make it all work in the real world

This isn't a traditional developer role. We want someone who thinks first and builds second: someone who can look at a problem, understand what's going on, ask the right questions, find a solution and explain it clearly to everyone involved. You don't need to be an experienced coder, but you should be curious about how technology works and willing to find your way around solution components and code.

What we're looking for

Someone who moves comfortably between people, business and technology. You:

→ Communicate and present well, and are comfortable in front of customers

→ Can turn business conversations into technical requirements, and explain technical ideas in plain language

→ Understand APIs and how systems work together

→ Think logically and enjoy solving problems

→ Pick up unfamiliar systems quickly

→ Have used or experimented with AI agents for coding and/or document generation

→ Enjoy variety: different systems, industries and problems

→ Are comfortable with fast pace and having to switch context between projects

→ Are a real team player

New graduates are welcome. We care more about potential, curiosity and mindset than years of experience.

Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language is a must. Other languages are a bonus.

Why ConnectMyApps?

A part of The Amesto Group, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry. We're a small team that changes the way companies work. Here you'll work directly with customers and see the impact of what you build.

Many of the tools and improvements we use today came from the team's own ideas. So, when you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it, and we want you to explore it. You won't just follow an established process. You'll help shape what our way of working looks like.

We foster a strong team spirit. We have regular team events, spend time together outside work and, importantly, enjoy each other's company. You won't be one small piece of a big puzzle. You might actually leave a mark.

Benefits

We offer competitive salary, pension, health insurance, career development, travel and hotel discounts, Ruter discounts, mobile phone packages, discounted lunch at an excellent canteen, and discounts at selected Oslo shops and services.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Position type: On-site

  • Level: Junior level

  • Requirements: Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language required

  • Education: University degree or similar

  • Work permit: Must have full residency/work permit for Norway.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

An Amesto Group company, ConnectMyApps was founded in 2014 with the purpose of simplifying integration and setting business free from manual data entry and inconsistent records.

Our team is a dedicated, committed, curious, knowledgeable, and unstoppable team of integration experts, who provide our customers with valuable advice, ensuring a seamless integration experience.

jobs.title: Part-time Driver Hamar

jobs.description:
We are hiring two part-time Drivers for the weekend shift in Hamar.

At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.

What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to stay fueled and energized.

What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.

What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic

Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: 22.11.2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidates, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Starting date: As soon as possible.

  • This is a part-time weekend shift position, working every other Saturday and Sunday (even or odd weeks), with hours of 5:30-13:30 on Saturday and 13:30-21:30 on Sunday.

  • Location: Næringsparkveien 4, 2320 Furnes

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

Arbeidssted: Haugesund lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (hovedsakelig kveld og helg)

Oppstart: Etter avtale

Stillingsprosent: 40-60%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Videre er du også ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til vår standard. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg. Logistikk, klargjøring, salg og kundeservice er kjernen i hverdagen. 

  • Klargjøring av utleiebiler (vask mm)

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Presentasjon og innsalg av våre produkter til kunde på en best mulig måte

  • Håndtere telefon og epost henvendelser 

  • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig flåte

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.    

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet (også ved fysisk arbeid)

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: EXPERT KEYCLOAK - Freelance (H/F)
jobs.description: CONTEXTEDans le cadre de la construction d'une plateforme Cloud Privé multi-région, nous recherchons un intégrateur IAM senior capable de piloter la définition, le sourcing et la mise en œuvre d'un service d'authentification pour l'ensemble de l'alliance.MISSIONS * Déployer, configurer, sécuriser et maintenir les instances Keycloak dans un environnement Cloud Privé hautement automatisé. * Adopter une approche strictement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) en utilisant Terraform et Ansible pour industrialiser l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la solution et l'intégration des applications métiers.Objectifs de la mission : 1.     Gestion de projet et pilotage    * Bonne compréhension des méthodes Agile et gestion via Jira des différentes tâches.    * Coordination transverse : assurer l'interface entre les équipes (réseau, stockage, sécurité/RSSI, exploitants).    * Accompagnement au changement : rédiger la documentation d'architecture (DAT), les dossiers d'exploitation (DEX) et assurer le transfert de compétences auprès des équipes RUN.     2.     Procurement, sourcing et gestion des fournisseurs    * Sourcing et appels d'offres (RFI / RFP) : identifier les solutions logicielles ou de services et piloter les processus de consultation.    * Analyse et sélection : construire les grilles d'évaluation, analyser les réponses techniques et financières des éditeurs/intégrateurs.    * Négociation et suivi contractuel.     3.     Architecture, intégration et administration Keycloak (IAM)    * Architecture très haute disponibilité, plusieurs régions et plusieurs zones par région.    * Déploiement et maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) des clusters Keycloak en très haute disponibilité (HA).    * Intégration des applications internes et externes via les protocoles standards (OIDC / OAuth2, SAML 2.0).    * Configuration avancée des Realms, clients, rôles, groupes, flux d'authentification (MFA, OTP, WebAuthn) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, fournisseurs externes).    * Développement ou intégration d'extensions spécifiques si nécessaire (thèmes personnalisés, SPI en Java).    * Gestion des montées de version, des sauvegardes et du tuning de performance (bases de données, cache distribué Infinispan).     4.     Automatisation et Infrastructure as Code (Terraform & Ansible)    * Provisionnement de l'infrastructure sous-jacente sur un Cloud Privé (OpenStack on-premise) via Terraform.    * Configuration système et applicative automatisée (durcissement OS, installation des dépendances, déploiement de Keycloak) via des playbooks Ansible.    * Gestion de la configuration Keycloak as Code : automatisation de la création des Realms, clients et utilisateurs via le provider Terraform Keycloak ou l'outil keycloak-config-cli piloté par Ansible/CI-CD.    * Intégration des déploiements dans les pipelines CI/CD / GitLab CI.     5.     Sécurité, supervision et support    * Mise en place de SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) et des playbooks permettant de les automatiser et de déléguer le support.    * Application des bonnes pratiques de sécurité (hardening, gestion des certificats TLS/mTLS, rotation des secrets via HashiCorp Vault ou équivalent).    * Mise en place du monitoring, de la journalisation et des alertes (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).    * Rédaction de la documentation technique (DAT, procédures d'exploitation, guides d'intégration pour les développeurs).    * Support niveau 3 et accompagnement des équipes de développement dans la sécurisation de leurs API et applications.DÉFIS MAJEURS DE LA MISSIONLe principal enjeu de cette mission réside dans l'industrialisation complète d'un composant critique en mode « Configuration as Code » sans interruption de service. Keycloak étant la brique centrale de confiance du système d'information, toute erreur de déploiement ou de configuration peut paralyser l'accès à l'ensemble des applications de l'entreprise.Vous devrez relever

  • Er fyldt 18 år og kan fremvise ren straffe- og børneattest.
  • Er omsorgsfuld, nærværende og har lyst til at skabe en god relation til Theo.
  • Er tålmodig og kan bevare roen, også når situationer bliver udfordrende.
  • Har forståelse for betydningen af struktur og forudsigelighed.
  • Er opmærksom på kropssprog og nonverbal kommunikation.
  • Har interesse for at arbejde med børn med særlige behov. Erfaring med autisme er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Kan komme til og fra familiens hjem i Ikast, eventuelt i egen bil.

 

Du skal ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du møder Theo med varme, nysgerrighed og forståelse – og har lyst til at lære ham at kende.

Stillingen er på op til 47,66 timer pr. måned og timerne vil være placeret enten på hverdage i løbet af ugen fra sidst på eftermiddagen eller i weekenderne. Jobbet som timeaflaster er ofte en sidebeskæftigelse, et fritids- eller studiejob.Det kan også være et fleksjob.

At være timeaflaster er en fantastisk mulighed for at hjælpe og gøre noget godt for andre.Mød Theo 

Theo er en dejlig dreng på 4 år, som elsker at fjolle, synge, lægge puslespil, bygge forhindringsbaner og tumle. Han holder af både aktive lege og hyggelige stunder, hvor der er plads til nærvær og sjov.

Theo har autisme og oplever verden på sin egen måde. Han bruger ikke talesprog, men kommunikerer gennem sit kropssprog, sine ansigtsudtryk og sine handlinger. Som aflaster får du mulighed for at lære hans signaler at kende og opbygge en god og tryg relation til ham.

Theo trives allerbedst med faste rutiner og genkendelige rammer. Når han ved, hvad der skal ske, giver det ham tryghed og overskud til at nyde dagens aktiviteter. Derfor har han brug for en voksen, der kan skabe struktur og forudsigelighed og møde ham i hans eget tempo.

Som alle andre børn kan Theo opleve situationer, hvor følelserne bliver store. Her har han brug for en rolig og tålmodig voksen, som kan hjælpe ham med at finde tilbage til trygheden – også når noget bliver svært.

I løbet af dagen har Theo brug for små pauser, hvor han blandt andet nyder at se musikvideoer eller spille små spil på sin tablet. Det hjælper ham med at finde ro og samle ny energi.

 

Hvad indebærer opgaven?

Som timeaflaster bliver din vigtigste opgave at skabe gode og meningsfulde oplevelser sammen med Theo og samtidig give hans forældre mulighed for aflastning i hverdagen.

Opgaven vil primært foregå i familiens hjem, hvor der også kan være andre familiemedlemmer og/eller en anden aflaster til stede i forbindelse med familiens øvrige børn.

Jeres tid sammen kan eksempelvis bestå af leg, sang, puslespil, bevægelsesaktiviteter og hyggelige stunder med udgangspunkt i Theos interesser og dagsform.

Du skal desuden kunne støtte Theo i de praktiske og personlige behov, han har i løbet af dagen.

Ansættelsesproces

Du ansøger om jobbet som timeaflaster via selvbetjeningsløsning nedenfor. Hvis dine kvalifikationer er relevante, kontakter familien dig for en samtale, så i sammen finder ud af om I er et ”match”. Efter evt. ansættelse, er det dig og familien, der aftaler din arbejdstid og aktiviteter. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat af Ikast-Brande kommune, hvor du aflønnes ud fra det konkrete forbrug af timer, som du løbende indberetter.

Lønnen er på 161,94 kr. pr. time. Tillæg for arbejde efter kl. 17 på hverdage samt i weekender. Der udbetales desuden feriepenge. 

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest på dig i forbindelse med ansættelse. 

Hvis du har brug for yderligere oplysninger:

I forhold til selve arbejdet i familiens hjem, kan du kontakte forældrene på telefonnummer 23 38 84 32. I forhold til ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte fagspecialist Heidi Lilholt Holm på mail: helil@ikast-brande.dk - tlf. 99605533.

Lovgivningen

Timeaflastning til børn gives efter barnets lov § 90 stk. 1, nr. 2, jf. servicelovens § 84 stk. 1.

Ansøgningsfrist

Hurtigst muligt!Der holdes løbende ansættelsessamtaler, som vil foregå i hjemmet hos forældrene efter aftale.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen


Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

Wulff Works Etelä Oy

Meidän työntekijämme viihtyvät parhaiten asiakkaillamme! 


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

Tutustu: . Olemme osa pörssilistattua Wulff-konsernia.

jobs.title: Safety Manager
jobs.description: Are you the experienced Health & Safety professional with a strong background in industrial operations and/or construction sites that we are looking for?  We are now looking for a proactive and hands-on Safety Manager to lead the development and continuous improvement of our occupational health and safety practices.In this role, you will help ensure that safety is embedded in everything we do — from daily operations and project delivery to collaboration with employees, contractors, and other stakeholders. You will play a key role in maintaining regulatory compliance, reducing operational risks, and strengthening our safety culture.The responsibilities for this role are to:- Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of our Occupational Health & Safety management systems in line with ISO 45001.- Ensure compliance with applicable local, national, and international health and safety legislation, regulations, and industry best practices.- Conduct risk assessments, hazard analyses, safety inspections, and audits, and support the implementation of effective risk mitigation measures.- Develop, maintain, and enforce site-specific safety procedures, safe work methods, and permit-to-work systems.- Lead incident investigations and root cause analyses and ensure that corrective and preventive actions are implemented and followed up.- Plan and deliver safety training, coaching, inductions, and awareness programs for employees, supervisors, and contractors.- Work closely with project managers, engineering teams, operational personnel, and contractors to integrate safety throughout all phases of operations and project delivery.- Monitor safety performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.To succeed in this role, you have a solid understanding of occupational health and safety management in demanding industrial and/or construction environments. You are confident in engaging people at all levels of the organization and can turn safety requirements into practical, effective ways of working.As Safety Manager we expect you to have:- A bachelors degree in occupational health & safety, Engineering, or another relevant field.- At least five years of experience in Health & Safety roles within industrial plants, construction sites, or similar operational environments.- Strong knowledge of occupational health and safety legislation, regulations, and industry best practices.- Experience in safety audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, and regulatory compliance.- Familiarity with ISO 45001 management systems.- Strong communication and collaboration skills in both Finnish and English.- A proactive, structured, and solution-oriented approach to safety management.Experience of working in international project environments is considered an advantage.We offer you an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a role where safety is a core part of our operations and project success. You will work closely with skilled professionals in a collaborative environment and have the opportunity to develop safety practices across diverse operations and projects.Are you the one we are looking for? Leave your application soon, but latest on 10th of December, using the link below. Please attach your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you soon!PLEASE NOTE: Our recruitment system will be unavailable due to maintenance from 10 p.m. on Friday, 20 November until 1 a.m. on Monday, 23 November. Job applications cannot be submitted during this time, so please plan your submission accordingly. We apologise for any inconvenience caused.     ISS is one of the worlds leading providers of integrated facility services. With 300,000 colleagues globally, and more than 7,300 in Finland, we focus on delivering the best facility services and creating the workplace that our customers dream of. The key word that binds us together is service. United by a commitment to exceptional service, we aim to create inclusive and safe workplaces, foster innovation, and enhance company culture.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent (H/F)
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ?KWARTIER est une société luxembourgeoise spécialisée dans l'investissement, la gestion et le développement immobilier. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le posteDans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe basée à Luxembourg-Ville. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Les missions comprendront notamment :-   Gestion quotidien/ienne des biens : être l'interlocuteur des propriétaires, locataires et prestataires, traiter les demandes et trouver des solutions aux problèmes rencontrés.-   Suivi technique et coordination des interventions : organiser les réparations, travaux d'entretien et interventions des différents corps de métier, demander et comparer des devis, suivre leur bonne exécution.-   Gestion locative : organiser les visites, assurer le suivi des candidatures, participer à la préparation des contrats de bail, coordonner les entrées et sorties des locataires et les états des lieux.-   Optimisation et valorisation du portefeuille : identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des biens, contribuer à l'optimisation des revenus locatifs, à la maîtrise des charges et à la préservation de la valeur des actifs à long terme.-   Suivi administratif : assurer le suivi des dossiers immobiliers, des contrats, des factures et des différentes démarches administratives.-   Relation client : maintenir une communication régulier/ière et professionnelle avec les propriétaires et locataires, dans un esprit de disponibilité, de discrétion et de recherche de solutions.Nous attachons une importance particulier/ière à une gestion proactive. Il s'agit d'anticiper les problèmes plutôt que de simplement y réagir, et de gérer chaque propriété avec le même soin, le même bon sens économique et le même niveau d'exigence que si elle nous appartenait. Un poste varié et évolutifSi la gestion immobilier/ière constitue le cœur du poste, la diversité de nos activités offre également la possibilité de s'impliquer progressivement dans d'autres domaines, notamment la promotion immobilier/ière et la construction. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. Le profil recherchéNous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, débrouillarde, organisée et polyvalent(e), qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions concrètes. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) devra notamment :-   Avoir un bon sens du contact et apprécier les relations humaines, aussi bien avec les clients qu'avec les locataires et les professionnels du bâtiment.-   Être organisé, rigoureux et capable de gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.-   Faire preuve de bon sens pratique, de réactivité, d'initiative et d'un réel sens des responsabilités.-   Être à l'aise avec les tâches administratives tout en appréciant le travail...

At the same time, you will develop technical data protection controls and take ownership of the Cloudflare platform.What will you do?As Manager, Application Security and Data Protection, you will act as a trusted advisor to application teams, developers and other technical specialists on application security matters. You will help teams identify security risks, interpret common security requirements and find solutions that integrate security into application design, development and the entire application lifecycle.You will define and maintain application security requirements and secure development practices and support their practical adoption. You will advise application teams on topics such as security assessments, threat modelling and security testing. Your role will focus on consulting, guidance and coordination, while application teams, developers and service providers remain responsible for application development and the execution of technical controls and checks.You will help make security a natural part of development and release processes. You will support teams in implementing security controls related to areas such as code, dependencies and configurations, as well as in prioritising findings based on risk.In the area of technical data protection, you will define and coordinate controls related to areas such as data classification, access rights, encryption, retention and secure deletion. You will support application and development teams in interpreting and implementing requirements together with data owners and privacy and legal specialists.One of the key responsibilities of the role is ownership of the Cloudflare platform. You will be responsible for the platform roadmap, service lifecycle, governance model, access rights and vendor collaboration, as well as monitoring service performance and costs. You will guide and coordinate the use of Cloudflare's security capabilities in line with the agreed service scope.You will monitor application security and technical data protection risks, the effectiveness of controls and the progress of development initiatives. You will maintain a prioritised development roadmap and ensure that application security, data protection and the Cloudflare service are integrated with ITSM processes.In this role, you will have a broad impact without direct line management responsibility. Success will depend on your ability to bring the security perspective into discussions at the right time, make requirements understandable and help different teams find appropriate solutions.To succeed in this role, you need practical knowledge of application security and the ability to use your technical expertise to support other teams.We expect you to have: - at least three years of professional experience in roles involving application security and technical data protection - strong understanding of secure development practices, common application vulnerabilities, security testing and risk-based remediation - experience in consulting, supporting or guiding developers, application teams and other technical stakeholders on security matters - experience in platform or service ownership, as well as hands-on experience with Cloudflare or a comparable application security platform - fluency in both Finnish and English, as you will work and communicate with different stakeholders in both languages.You will also benefit from an understanding of web application protection, access management and technical data protection controls.We do not require a specific educational background. Relevant experience and expertise are what matter most.What do we offer?You will take responsibility for application security and technical data protection across K Group, as well as ownership of the Cloudflare platform. You will have the opportunity to shape how security is implemented in application development across different teams. You will build common ways of working and help application teams and developers put them into practice.The role combines technical expertise, consulting, development of operating practices, technology ownership and collaboration with a broad network of stakeholders.We work in a hybrid model, combining office and remote work in a way that suits the role and the team. On office days, you will work at K-Kampus in Kalasatama, Helsinki, with excellent transport connections. The campus offers collaboration and break-out spaces, a gym, occupational health services, a café and a staff restaurant.K Group employee benefits include a mobile phone benefit, Epassi, staff discounts at K Group stores, occupational health services and leisure-time accident insurance. You will also have access to a range of changing partner benefits covering areas such as sports, wellbeing, travel and accommodation, as well as opportunities to develop your expertise through internal training and online learning.Interested?Submit your CV and, if you wish, a free-form application by 20.11.2026.For more information about the role, please contact the hiring manager Pekka Valkearanta, VP Cybersecurity and IT Service Management, pekka.valkearanta@kesko.fi.We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow. Equality, non-discrimination, and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation, and career development.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Economics - Artificial Intelligence and Labour Markets / Postdoktoral forskare i nationalekonomi - Artificiell intelligens och arbetsmarknader
jobs.description: (Se nedan för svenska)Postdoctoral Researcher in Economics - Artificial Intelligence and Labour MarketsThe Economics Unit at the Department of Finance and Economics, Hanken School of Economics, invites applications for one fixed-term position as Postdoctoral Researcher in Economics. The position is based in Helsinki.The successful candidate will join a new research project examining the effects of artificial intelligence on firms, workers and labour markets. The project is led by assistant professor Aapo Stenhammar (co-PIs professor Topi Miettinen and assistant professor Julia Salmi) and funded by the OP Pohjola Research Foundation.The appointment is initially for two years, with an option for a one-year extension. The starting date is flexible but will be no later than 1 September 2027.The research project and responsibilitiesThe project studies how firms adopt and use artificial intelligence and how this affects productivity, work, skills, hiring, and other labour-market outcomes. The research will combine large-scale Finnish administrative registers with firm- and individual-level survey data. The project also provides opportunities to contribute to the design of new surveys on the use and effects of AI.The postdoctoral researcher will work as a coauthor with the principal investigator, and other members of the research team on papers studying the economic and labour-market effects of AI. Depending on the development of the individual papers, the researchers responsibilities may include:- developing research questions and empirical and experimental designs;- constructing and analysing linked register, survey, and experimental datasets;- contributing to data-access applications and the development of new surveys;- preparing research articles for publication in leading international journals; and- presenting the research at seminars, workshops, and conferences.The position is strongly research-focused. A teaching load equivalent to one course per year is required.QualificationsApplicants should hold a doctoral degree in economics or a closely related field, or be close to completing their doctoral studies.We are looking for a candidate with:- a strong background in applied microeconomics;- experience working with large-scale observational data;- strong econometric and quantitative research skills;- proficiency in at least one statistical software package or programming language, such as Stata, R, or Python;- the ability to conduct high-quality independent research and to collaborate effectively as a coauthor; and- an excellent command of written and spoken English.Experience with administrative register data, survey data or survey design, experimental economics (including the design, implementation or analysis of field or laboratory experiments), or research on technological change and labour markets is considered an advantage, but is not required.Candidates will be evaluated primarily on their research potential, the quality of their job-market paper and other research, their methodological fit with the project, and their ability to contribute constructively to collaborative research.The position is full-time, with an annual working time of 1,612 hours. Hanken requires academic employees to reside and work in Finland. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. The appointment is subject to a six-month probationary period.Research environmentHanken School of Economics is a research-oriented, internationally accredited business school offering education in English and Swedish. Hankens Economics Unit is committed to high-quality research and teaching, with strengths in labour economics, industrial organisation, behavioural and experimental economics, and empirical and theoretical microeconomics more broadly.Hankens Economics Unit is an active partner in the Helsinki Graduate School of Economics (Helsinki GSE), which brings together economists from Hanken, Aalto University and the University of Helsinki. Helsinki GSEs mission is to produce outstanding research with academic and societal impact, educate the next generation of world-class economists, and offer excellent training across disciplinary boundaries. It collaborates closely with the VATT Institute for Economic Research and provides a versatile and active research environment with eleven research groups, as well as a broad programme of seminars, workshops and international networks.The postdoctoral researcher will have access to the wider Helsinki GSE research community and exceptionally rich Finnish administrative register and survey data, while helping to shape a new research agenda on AI and the labour market. Hanken and Helsinki GSE are conveniently located in central Helsinki. Helsinki combines an active international research environment with a high quality of life, a safe and well-functioning society, and high-quality public services.SalaryThe salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (including occupational healthcare, pension, and holiday contributions). The expected annual gross salary is approximately EUR 48.000–55.000 depending on qualifications and performance.InterviewsThe shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online. The interviews will take place in late January and early February.How to applyApplications should be submitted in English through Hankens recruitment database LAURA. The application deadline is 24 January 2027. Applications sent by email will not be considered.The application should include:- a curriculum vitae, including a list of publications and working papers;- a job-market paper or another representative research paper; and- at least two letters of recommendation submitted through [EconJobMarket](https://econjobmarket.org/) or sent directly to Hanken at humanresources@hanken.fi.At Hanken, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and valued for their unique backgrounds.We provide reasonable accommodations and support throughout the recruitment process, including interviews and employment.Further informationFor further information about the position and the research project, please contact Assistant Pr

jobs.title: Télépilote de drone (H/F)
jobs.description: Innov'ATM et votre rôleLa société Innov'ATM a été créée en 2014 avec l'ambition de proposer des produits et des services innovants pour la gestion de trafic aérien (ATM) et de gestion du trafic aérien des drones (UTM). Aujourd'hui, Innov'ATM permet à tous les acteurs de l'écosystème de gérer en toute sécurité et en toute simplicité l'ensemble des opérations dans un espace aérien (ATM et UTM).Depuis 2024, Innov'ATM a créé DroneMed: un service de livraison médicale par drone, il permet aux établissements de santé et aux laboratoires d'acheminer des prélèvements biologiques et des médicaments par des autoroutes aériennes.Précurseur de la livraison médicale par drone en France, et premier U-space Services Provider Français, DroneMed propose une alternative au transport routier traditionnel et opère déjà plusieurs lignes dans différentes régions, en métropole comme en outre-mer, et poursuit activement son déploiement.Rejoindre DroneMed, c'est contribuer au développement d'un service innovant, utile et en forte croissance, au croisement des secteurs de la santé, du drone et de la mobilité aérienne.Le posteInnov'ATM recrute un-e télépilote pour assurer la supervision des opérations DroneMed sur les lignes en France métropolitaine comme en outre-mer.* Sur le terrain : une supervision au plus près des opérations. Pendant les phases de test, de validation et de transition vers l'exploitation, vous êtes présent-e sur les sites afin de préparer, superviser et sécuriser les vols. Cette présence terrain constitue aujourd'hui le cœur du poste.* Depuis nos bureaux : une supervision à distance, depuis le centre de contrôle DroneMed, pour les lignes déjà en phase d'exploitation.Vos missions* Vous assurerez la supervision des vols DroneMed, en tant que télépilote/superviseur de vols.À ce titre, vous serez responsable de l'opération, de sa préparation jusqu'à sa clôture, et vos missions seront les suivantes :Préparer l'opération :* Rédiger la fiche mission et analyser le contexte : météo, informations aéronautiques, zones survolées, espaces aériens voisins, mesures de Lead physical AI data capture programs that help robots learn from human movement and manipulation. You will set up capture systems, guide demonstrations, and uphold data quality across projects ranging from one week to several months.

  • Ability to design or run capture sessions with defined protocols and quality checks.

  • Fine manipulation skills and the ability to record remotely with provided equipment or travel for on-site projects; experience leading or training operators and running robot evaluations is useful.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie aktiv den schulischen Alltag von Kindern und Jugendlichen mit. Monatsgehalt), Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Rabatte über unsere Corporate-Benefits-Plattform und wenn Du möchtest, gerne auch ein JobRad.- Flexibel und fair: Deine Arbeitszeit beträgt 40 Stunden pro Woche, los geht’s zwischen 8:00 und 9:00 Uhr. Jede Stunde zählt! Mit Gleitzeit und Arbeitszeitkonto kannst Du Deine Zeit flexibel gestalten und ausgleichen, gerade auch an Brückentagen.- Schnell auf Flughöhe kommen: Zum Start begleitet Dich ein erfahrener Pate, der Dir alles zeigt und Dir den Einstieg leicht macht. jobs.title: Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) mit pädagogischer Erfahrung oder Ausbildung (Schulbegleiter/in)
jobs.description: BITTE BEWIRB DICH DIREKT ÜBER UNSERE KARRIERESEITE, NICHT PER E-MAIL:https://karriere.begleithelden.de/o/schulbegleitung-mwd-mit-padagogischer-erfahrung-oder-ausbildung-14Nur so können wir deine Bewerbung vollständig erfassen und dir schnell antworten.Die Begleithelden GmbH ist ein junger und herzlicher Kita- und Schulbegleitdienst – gegründet von Menschen, die aus Überzeugung in der Eingliederungshilfe arbeiten. Wir begleiten Kinder und Jugendliche mit besonderem Unterstützungsbedarf in der Rhein-Neckar-Region, in der Pfalz sowie in den Landkreisen Bergstraße, Darmstadt-Dieburg, Alzey-Worms und Aschaffenburg. Dabei wird jedes Kind bedürfnisorientiert und einfühlsam unterstützt und in seiner Entwicklung gefördert.Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir Menschen, denen Inklusion genauso am Herzen liegt wie uns – und die Freude daran haben, sich mit echtem Interesse auf jedes Kind einzulassen und es auf seinem eigenen Weg zu begleiten.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für ein Kind mit ADHS eine engagierte Schulbegleitung (m/w/d) in 64859 Eppertshausen an der Stephan-Gruber-Schule.Der voraussichtliche Stundenumfang beträgt 22,92 Stunden pro Woche.Die Einsatzzeiten:Montag 08:05-12:40Dienstag 08:05-12:40Mittwoch 08:05-12:40Donnerstag 08:05-12:40Freitag 08:05-12:40Ab Februar 2027 erhöht sich der Stundenumfang: An einzelnen Tagen kommt die Nachmittagsbetreuung bis 14:30 Uhr dazu.Darauf darfst du dich freuen- Bezahlung angelehnt an TVöD SuE mit Sonderzahlungen- Stundenlohn 17,14 bis zu 24,80 € plus zwei freiwillige Sonderzahlungen (Sommer und Weihnachtsgeld), angelehnt an TVöD SuE Stufe 1 bis 4; begleitest du mehrere Kinder, bekommst du für jedes weitere Kind einen Zuschlag auf den Stundenlohn, den wir für deinen Einsatz konkret berechnen- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge durch Entgeltumwandlung, mit persönlicher Beratung- Betriebsärztliche Vorsorge (Angebots- und Wunschvorsorge) und kostenlose Schutzimpfungen- Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag- Während der Ferienzeiten der Schule hast du frei (bitte Bundesland beachten)- Fundierte Einarbeitung über unsere Begleithelden-Akademie sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen- Feste Ansprechperson im Unternehmen, die dich bei fachlichen Fragen unterstützt- Regelmäßiger Austausch mit deiner Koordination- Erste-Hilfe-Trainings- Vollständig digitale Dokumentationsprozesse- Ein kollegiales Miteinander auf Augenhöhe mit offener und ehrlicher Kommunikation- Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit, bei der du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst – deine Leistung wird gesehen und wertgeschätzt- Bei uns bist du ein wichtiger Teil eines engagierten Teams. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Plant Interaction Ecology (m/f/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in Plant Interaction EcologySenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01.02.2027 :Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in Plant Interaction Ecology(Full-Time / Part-Time ** ** options available)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-Time; Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 3 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.The announced position is part of a newly established research group studying plant environment interactions. The successful candidate will contribute to shaping the group's research programme and develop an independent research project aligned with the group's broader interests.Your tasks- Conduct internationally recognized research on how plant-animal interactions shape plant regeneration- Advance a mechanistic understanding of how plant-animal interactions and regeneration processes influence plant responses to climate and land-use change, e.g., shifts in species ranges or ecological novelty- Design and conduct field experiments, e.g., testing drivers of plant establishment, intraspecific variability, or the role of animal-mediated seed dispersal in forest dynamics- Develop and apply ecological models that integrate experimental findings with long-term datasets, linking individual-level processes to population dynamics and species range shifts- Publish research findings in leading international, peer-reviewed journals- Develop competitive proposals for third-party research funding- Supervise and mentor BSc, MSc, and PhD students- Contribute to teaching at the Bachelor’s and Master’s levels- Contribute to the development of the Interaction Ecology and Climate research groupYour profile- A doctoral degree, completed or nearing completion, in ecology, botany, biology, or a closely related field- A strong background in ecology, with research experience in plant ecology and or interactions between plants and animals- Demonstrated experience in designing and conducting field experiments- Experience conducting fieldwork under challenging conditions, e.g., in alpine environments or remote forest areas- Strong quantitative skills, including experience with advanced statistical methods such as Bayesian hierarchical models and data integration (combining heterogeneous datasets) and/or demographic or process-based population models, preferably using R- A strong publication record relative to career stage- Motivation to develop independent research on plant regeneration and biotic interactions in the context of climate and land-use change- Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a willingness to contribute to teaching and student supervision- Fluency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable skills- An interest in science communication and public outreach- Proficiency in German, particularly for contributing to teaching and outreach activitiesWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV with a full publication list, copies of certificates and diplomas, along with the names of two referees) as a single PDF by 13 December 2026.Apply online via:https://short.sg/j/68770090by pressing the "Apply now" ButtonApplications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Eike Lena Neuschulz at:eike-lena.neuschulz@senckenberg.de****For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

jobs.title: Veterinary Oncology Consultant, Europe (German and English speaking) (Fachtierarzt/-ärztin)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Fachtierarzt/- ärztin für OnkologieStellenbeschreibung:Als Veterinary Oncology Consultant (w/m/d) übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Unterstützung von Tierärzt:innen in der Praxis. Du berätst zur Auswahl diagnostischer Tests, zur Interpretation von Laborergebnissen und zum Fallmanagement einschließlich Therapieoptionen.Bist du Fachtierärzt:in für Onkologie (ECVIM-CA Oncology oder ACVIM Oncology), kennst dich gut mit dem europäischen Veterinärwesen aus und sprichst fließend Deutsch? Würdest du gerne von zu Hause aus arbeiten und Kolleg:innen in der Praxis telefonisch fachlich beraten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Werde Teil unseres kollaborativen, internationalen Teams.Diese Position ist remote und kann in jedem europäischen Land besetzt werden, in dem IDEXX eine Niederlassung hat.Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist:IDEXX baut sein Global-Medical-Consulting-Team aus und sucht eine:n Veterinäronkolog:in, um unsere Kund:innen in ganz Europa zu unterstützen. Das Medical-Consulting-Team von IDEXX setzt sich dafür ein, die tiermedizinische Versorgung durch hochwertige diagnostische Unterstützung zu verbessern. Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegialen Wissensaustausch und auf den Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu unseren Kolleg:innen in der Praxis. Unser tierärztliches Team arbeitet eng mit unseren Vertriebs- und Laborteams zusammen, um präzise, praxisnahe und klinisch relevante diagnostische Lösungen bereitzustellen.In dieser Rolle:- Du berätst Tiermediziner:innen telefonisch zu onkologischen Fällen bei Hunden und Katzen, insbesondere zur Auswahl diagnostischer Tests, zur Interpretation von Ergebnissen sowie zu Behandlungs- und Managementoptionen. Die Beratungen finden überwiegend auf Deutsch und Englisch statt.- Du kennst die von IDEXX angebotenen Tests, insbesondere im Bereich onkologischer Erkrankungen, darunter Histopathologie- und Zytologie-Befunde, Cancer DX, Immunhistochemie, Durchflusszytometrie und PARR. Du berätst Kund:innen zur richtigen Probenentnahme, zum klinischen Nutzen und zur Interpretation der jeweiligen Tests.- Du bist vertraut mit den IDEXX-Diagnostiktests für die Praxis (z. B. den Analysegeräten Catalyst und ProCyte) sowie mit den Untersuchungen im Referenzlabor und deren Verfügbarkeit in den verschiedenen Märkten.- Du hältst dein medizinisches Wissen aktuell und entwickelst es weiter, durch selbstgesteuertes Lernen, die Teilnahme an wissenschaftlichen Kongressen, interne Weiterbildungen und die regelmäßige Auswertung aktueller Literatur der Veterinäronkologie.- Du bist während der regulären Arbeitszeiten für Kundenberatungen erreichbar und dokumentierst die Beratungen in unserem Customer-Relationship-Management-System.- Du verfasst oder prüfst gegebenenfalls Newsletter-Artikel, Diagnostik- und Service-Updates sowie Marketing-, Vertriebs- oder Schulungsmaterialien und nimmst an Bildungs- und Organisationsmeetings von IDEXX teil.Was du für deinen Erfolg mitbringst:- Diplomate des European College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ECVIM-CA, Oncology) oder des American College of Veterinary Internal Medicine (ACVIM, Oncology). Kreative und sportliche Aktivitäten sind für uns ein wirkungsvoller Türöffner, um Vertrauen aufzubauen und Kinder und Jugendliche dort abzuholen, wo sie stehen.Als ambulante Hilfe arbeiten wir dort, wo das Leben der Kinder und Jugendlichen stattfindet – im Zuhause der Familien, in der Schule, im Stadtteil, auf dem Sportplatz, im Park oder bei uns in unseren Räumlichkeiten im Marta-Viertel. So stärken wir junge Menschen direkt in ihrem Alltag, Familie, Freundeskreis und Schule bleiben erhalten, und Veränderungen können dort wachsen, wo sie gebraucht werden.Ihre Aufgaben- Durchführung von Erziehungsbeistandschaften nach § 30 SGB VIII als ambulante Hilfe zur Erziehung: verlässliche, längerfristige Einzelbegleitung von Kindern und Jugendlichen in ihrem Alltag- Aufsuchende Arbeit in der Lebenswelt der jungen Menschen – z. jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description: RecepcionistaDescripción de la empresaNuestro corazón es turquesa.Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.Descripción del empleoEl objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturalesBenefits:- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.RequisitosTanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!
