jobs.title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

  • Cyber security
  • Privacy engineering
  • Computer Systems
  • Edge/cloud computing
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Data Engineering
  • Big Data Infrastructure
  • Machine Learning Systems

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

  • developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
  • providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
  • participating in grant application activities
  • coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirementsAppointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-trackWhen appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

  • Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
  • A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
  • A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
  • Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.      Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Be part of an exciting new chapter in Italian hospitality! Porto Sociale, an Italian restaurant in the heart of Oslo, is preparing for an exciting relaunch. With a major renovation, a refreshed concept, and ambitious plans for the future, we aim to create one of Oslo's most exciting Italian dining destinations. jobs.title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Customer Success Architect, Australia
Treasury Analyst, Markets & Analytics
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in an international investment fund promoting economic and social progress through commercial investments?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor. We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team. The role sits at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analysis, trading and technology. You will support treasury decision-making, execute and analyse financial transactions, develop and use the tools and data infrastructure used by the Treasury function.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Negotiate, execute and support FX, money-market, interest-rate and derivative transactions, including swaps and hedging activities.

  • Perform quantitative analysis of FX, interest-rate and liquidity risk via statistics and scenario analyses.

  • Develop models for cash-flow forecasting, liquidity management, pricing and risk/position management.

  • Develop and maintain Treasury analytics and reporting using SQL, Python, Power BI and/or Excel/VBA.

  • Extract, structure and analyse data from Treasury Risk/Position Systems, Investment Management Systems, ERP systems and market-data platforms.

  • Automate Treasury processes and controls and contribute to improvements in the Treasury IT architecture.

  • Support and pursue implementation and valuation of new financial products.

  • Monitor financial markets and provide analysis supporting funding, investment and hedging decisions.

 

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar.

  • Initial relevant work experience, for example 1–3 years' experience from a student job or up to 2 years full-time experience after graduation within Treasury, trading, financial markets and quantitative finance.

  • Practical experience with FX, interest rates, derivatives and/or money-market instruments.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience with SQL and ideally Python, VBA or similar programming languages.

  • Understanding of databases, APIs, data structures and financial systems.

  • Experience with Treasury Management Systems, ERP systems, Investment Management Systems and market-data platforms is an advantage. Especially Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Microsoft Dynamics platform/data structure and Bloomberg.

  • Ability to translate complex financial requirements into robust analytical and IT solutions.

  • Proficiency in English is required, while spoken Danish is an advantage.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a service-minded approach to collaborating with colleagues and counterparties across countries and cultures. Experience working in an international organisation is considered an advantage.

 

We offer you employment in a unique organisation, where you will get experience working in an international business environment. The position is based in our headquarter Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 18 November. We conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

  • Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

  • Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

  • Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

  • Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

  • An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

  • Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

  • Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

  • An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

  • An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

  • A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

  • Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

  • The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

  • Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

jobs.title: Head of Security - Fjord Base AS
jobs.description:
Fjord Base Gruppen er et konsern med ca. 100 ansatte bestående av 3 selskaper innenfor utvikling og drift av forsyningsbasen Fjord Base i Florø. Som Norges største forsyningsbase, med hele 65 selskap etablert på området, er vi et viktig knutepunkt mellom sjø og land. Vi tilbyr effektive havneoperasjoner og totale logistikkløsninger for offshore industrien. Vi er stolt av vår historie fra etableringen i 1985, som pålitelig leverandør til internasjonale selskaper og som en hjørnesteinsbedrift i Florø-samfunnet.

Fremover skal vi videreutvikle eksisterende aktivitet, og har klare vekstambisjoner. Vi skal styrke Fjord Base som logistikknutepunkt for offshore industrien, samtidig som vi skal legge til rette for nye grønne næringer. Vi har status som «Grønn Hub» for vår kapasitet til å lykkes med det grønne skiftet. Vi satser innenfor flere nye grønne industrier, med mål om å tilrettelegge for bærekraftig virksomhet og sirkulære verdikjeder.Vår visjon: Vi kobler mennesker og teknologi for å bygge fremtidens logistikkløsninger.

Vi ser nå en Head of Security / Leder Sikring til å bli med oss på laget!

Head of Security / Leder Sikring

Sikring er et stadig viktigere fagområde for Fjord Base Gruppen, og en sentral del av fundamentet for sikker og robust drift. Som et stort logistikknutepunkt med mange aktører, kunder og samarbeidspartnere stilles det høye krav til hvordan vi arbeider med sikring og risikostyring. Samtidig er fagområdet i stadig utvikling, og økte krav gjør at vi ønsker å styrke dette arbeidet ytterligere. Vi søker derfor en leder for sikring til en nøkkelrolle i den videre utviklingen av sikringsarbeidet hos oss. Vil du være med å drive dette arbeidet fremover? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg!

Dine ansvarsområder:

Som leder for sikring får du et overordnet ansvar for å drive og videreutvikle sikringsarbeidet i Fjord Base Gruppen. Rollen er både strategisk og operativ, og innebærer både eget fagansvar, samt koordinering på tvers av fagområder, eksterne samarbeidspartnere og kunder. Du vil ha gode faglige støttespillere rundt deg, samtidig som du har en nøkkelrolle i å sikre helhet, fremdrift og systematikk i arbeidet. Sentrale oppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Ansvarlig for ISPS-sikring ved Fjord Base og ivaretakelse av rollen som PFSO (Port Facility Security Officer)

  • Overordnet ansvar for konsernets øvrige sikringsarbeid, herunder ON091, og koordinering mot relevante fagområder som cybersikkerhet, personellsikring og beredskap

  • Drive utvikling og forbedring av konsernets sikringsarbeid

  • Følge opp overordnede risikovurderinger, sikringsrisikoanalyse, krav og tiltak, og bidra til at disse omsettes til gode løsninger i konsernet

  • Sikre at styrende dokumentasjon og planer er oppdatert og relevant

  • Være en sentral kontaktperson innen sikring overfor kunder, myndigheter og samarbeidspartnere

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant kompetanse innen sikring, og som har stor interesse og innsikt i fagområdene. Du har høy grad av integritet og etisk bevissthet. Vi ser for oss at du eksempelvis har erfaring fra politi, forsvaret, eller fra andre virksomheter med tydelige krav til sikring, beredskap og risikostyring. Vi tror du har:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning og erfaring innen sikring, sikkerhet og beredskap

  • God forståelse for risiko, forebyggende sikringsarbeid og regelverksforståelse

  • Gjerne erfaring fra komplekse virksomheter eller miljøer med høye krav til sikkerhet og sikring

  • Erfaring med ISPS og rolle som PFSO vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav

For å lykkes og trives i rollen så ser vi for oss at du er initiativrik, har høy grad av struktur, og er trygg i møte med ulike mennesker og fagmiljøer. Du evner å se helheten, samtidig som du sørger for fremdrift og følger opp det som er viktig. Du bygger gode relasjoner, kommuniserer tydelig, og har høy integritet og god rolleforståelse. Vi ser ikke etter noen som kan alt fra første dag. Vi ser etter deg som har et solid faglig fundament, er lærevillig, og som motiveres av å holde deg oppdatert og drive sikringsarbeidet videre i et fagområde i kontinuerlig utvikling.

Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Vi kan tilby en nøkkelrolle med stor påvirkning på vårt arbeid med sikring fremover, og å kunne bidra til gode og helhetlige løsninger sammen med et solid fagmiljø. Du blir en del av et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger i et konsern med høyt fokus på utvikling av våre ansatte. Vi tilbyr også gode velferdsordninger, blant annet treningsrom, Florø’s beste kantine, og hytte på Stranda – for å nevne noe! Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.Stillingen har arbeidssted i våre lokaler i Florø. Det vil bli gjennomført bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater som en del av ansettelsesprosessen. Er du nysgjerrig på om dette kan være stillingen for deg? Ta gjerne kontakt med en av våre rådgivere hos Visere AS:Asbjørn Grini – 917 94 825 / Asbjorn@visere.noDaniel Klakegg Dvergsdal – 904 79 470 / Daniel@visere.no Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad og CV innen 29. november 2026.

jobs.title: Facility Manager
jobs.description:
Om rollen 🚀

Vi søker nå en Facility Manager til en tidsbegrenset stilling hos en av våre internasjonale kunder i Norge. Du vil være basert på kontoret til et globalt selskap innen teknologi og profesjonelle tjenester, i et dynamisk og internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø.

Som Facility Manager vil du ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-leveransen på lokasjonen og sørge for at arbeidsplassen fungerer effektivt, sikkert og med høy kvalitet.

Du vil være kundens primære kontaktperson innen Facility Management og samarbeide tett med leverandører, servicepartnere og resten av Four FM-organisasjonen. Lede, støtte og følge opp Facility Coordinator på samme lokasjon og sørge for tydelige prioriteringer, godt samarbeid og høy kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen.

Rollen kombinerer operativt ansvar med koordinering av medarbeidere, kundeoppfølging, oppfølging av tjenester og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid.

Du vil blant annet: ✨

• Ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-driften på lokasjonen.

• Lede, støtte og koordinere Facility Coordinator på lokasjonen.

• Være kundens primære kontaktperson og bygge gode relasjoner med relevante interessenter.

• Koordinere og følge opp leverandører og eksterne servicepartnere.

• Sikre at tjenester leveres i henhold til avtalte kvalitetsstandarder, KPI-er og SLA-er.

• Følge opp kostnader og bidra til god budsjettoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

• Sikre etterlevelse av relevante HMS-rutiner, sikkerhetskrav og lokale bestemmelser.

• Håndtere daglige operative utfordringer på en proaktiv og løsningsorientert måte.

• Sikre at avtalte prosesser, rutiner og arbeidsmetoder følges.

• Identifisere og drive kontinuerlige forbedringer for å styrke kvalitet, effektivitet og den totale arbeidsplassopplevelsen.

Kort sagt: Du sørger for at arbeidsplassen fungerer godt, at teamet på lokasjonen får støtten og retningen de trenger, og at kunden mottar profesjonelle Facility Management-tjenester av høy kvalitet.

Dette er deg! 🎯

Du er en strukturert, serviceinnstilt og løsningsorientert person som trives med å ta ansvar og sørge for at ting fungerer.

Du er komfortabel med å jobbe i et kundenært miljø og kan veksle mellom planlegging, koordinering, oppfølging og håndtering av daglige operative utfordringer. Du liker å støtte andre og kan gi tydelig retning, samtidig som du samarbeider tett med kolleger, leverandører og andre interessenter.

Du kommuniserer godt med mennesker på ulike nivåer og har et naturlig fokus på kvalitet, service og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Vi tror at du har:

  • Erfaring innen Facility Management, workplace services, eiendomsdrift eller en lignende serviceorientert virksomhet.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere, støtte eller lede medarbeidere i et operativt miljø.

  • Erfaring med å jobbe tett med kunder og håndtere ulike interessenter.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere og følge opp leverandører og servicepartnere.

  • God forståelse for HMS og trygge arbeidsmetoder.

  • Forståelse for budsjett, kostnadsoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

  • En strukturert, proaktiv og selvstendig arbeidsform.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og trygghet i bruk av ulike systemer og verktøy.

  • Gode kommunikasjons- og relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter.

  • Flytende norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Kunnskap om teknisk Facility Management og grunnleggende forståelse for tekniske bygningssystemer er en fordel.

Hvorfor du vil trives hos oss ✨

Hos Four FM blir du en del av et selskap hvor du får tillit og reelt ansvar. Vi verdsetter initiativ, kvalitet og samarbeid, og gir medarbeiderne våre mulighet til å forme sine roller og bidra til hvordan vi utvikler tjenestene våre.

Verdiene våre C.A.R.E. – Compassion, Attention, Respect & Excellence – veileder oss i alt vi gjør. Vi bryr oss om mennesker, har fokus på detaljene og er stolte av å levere tjenester av høy kvalitet til kundene våre.

Praktisk informasjon 👩‍🏫

Arbeidstid:

Heltid, hovedsakelig innenfor ordinær kontortid, med noe fleksibilitet basert på driftsmessige behov.

Ansettelsesform:

Arbeidssted:

Hos kunden på Lysaker.

Oppstart:

Så snart som mulig / etter avtale.

Søknad:

Siste søknadsfrist: 14.12.2026

Vi gjennomfører utvelgelse og intervjuer fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å sende inn søknaden din så snart som mulig.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM er et nordisk facility management-selskap som leverer skreddersydde tjenester til bedrifter og eiendomsbesittere.

Vi samarbeider med selskaper som bryr seg om merkevaren sin, menneskene sine og miljøene de opererer i. Som partner – ikke bare leverandør – leverer vi fleksible løsninger med en sterk serviceinnstilling, veiledet av vår filosofi: We Take C.A.R.E.

Beauty treatments, wellness services, experiences, everyday assistance and unforgettable moments. The possibilities are endless.**The foundation is built. I want to find someone with the marketing skills, vision and ambition that Anna aikaa needs to reach its full potential.This is an opportunity to acquire an early-stage digital business and become an independent entrepreneur. jobs.description: Meillä Varhalla pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kehittymismyönteistä työyhteisöä, jossa arvostamme osaamistasi ja tuemme ammatillista kasvuasi. Tule mukaan!TehtäväsiSuuhygienistinä työskentelet itsenäisesti suun terveyden edistämisen ja hoidon parissa. Toimit oman alasi asiantuntijana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suun terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja opiskelijoiden käytännön harjoittelun ohjaamista.Pääasiallinen työpisteesi sijaitsee Kaarinan suun terveydenhuollossa, mutta työskentelet tarvittaessa myös Varhan muilla vastaanotoilla. Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

jobs.description: Oletko kokenut korjausrakentamisen asiantuntija ja mietit uusia uramahdollisuuksia? Etsimme nyt Ouluun vakituiseen työsuhteeseen projektipäällikköä vaativiin korjausrakentamisen hankkeisiin. Mitä tehtävä sisältää? Projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa omien vahvuuksiesi ja osaamisesi mukaisessa roolissa. Taustastasi riippuen tehtäväsi painottuvat esimerkiksi rakennusteknisiin tutkimuksiin, rakennesuunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Sinun ei siis tarvitse olla kaikkien osa-alueiden asiantuntija, vaan tehtävänkuvaa rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta. Toimit asiakkaidemme asiantuntijana ja vastaat oman roolisi mukaisesti hankkeiden koordinoinnista ja ohjauksesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä yli toimialarajojemme, asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että hankkeet etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulun, kustannusten ja määräysten mukaisesti. Kulttuurimme kulmakiviä on tutkitusti ystävällinen työyhteisö ja matala hierarkia. Toimit osana monialaista korjausrakentamisen tiimiä, josta saat työkavereiksesi eri alojen asiantuntijoita. Vahva paikallinen yhteishenki ja tekeminen yhdistettynä valtakunnalliseen yhteistyöhön eri toimistojemme välillä tuo toimintaamme ketteryyttä, jota nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissakin tarvitaan. Päätökset teemme siellä, missä se on nopeinta ja kulloinkin järkevintä – tiimit on asetettu meillä päätöksenteon keskiöön. Talon sisäinen yhteistyö ja osaamisen jakaminen mahdollistavat sinulle pääsyn myös muiden alueiden hankkeisiin. Oulun toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella keskustan kupeessa, jossa meillä on modernit toimisto- ja neuvottelutilat sekä viihtyisät taukotilat. Työsi on liikkuvaa ja kohteet sijaitsevat Pohjois-Suomessa, pääosin Oulun seudulla. jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.description: HOW TO APPLY? PLEASE SEND YOUR CV TO: EURES.SELECCIO.SOC@GENCAT.CAT REFERENCE: SKI LIFT OPERATOR IF YOU ARE ATTENTIVE, RESPONSIBLE, STRONGLY CUSTOMER-SERVICE AND SAFETY-ORIENTED, AND LOOKING FOR A ROLE ENSURING SMOOTH, COMFORTABLE, AND SAFE ACCESS FOR OUR GUESTS ACROSS THE ENTIRE SKI RESORT, WE WANT TO MEET YOU! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: BOARDING AND UNLOADING ASSISTANCE: HELP SKIERS AND SNOWBOARDERS SAFELY BOARD AND UNLOAD FROM CHAIRLIFTS, GONDOLAS, OR SURFACE LIFTS, PAYING SPECIAL ATTENTION TO CHILDREN, BEGINNERS, AND INDIVIDUALS WITH REDUCED MOBILITY. ACCESS AND QUEUE CONTROL: VERIFY THAT GUESTS ACCESS LIFTS WITH A VALID SKI PASS AND MANAGE WAITING AREAS IN AN ORDERLY, SMOOTH, AND FRIENDLY MANNER. BASIC OPERATIONAL SAFETY: MONITOR THE OPERATION OF THE ASSIGNED LIFT FROM THE CONTROL BOOTH OR PLATFORM, EXECUTING EMERGENCY STOPS OR SPEED ADJUSTMENTS WHENEVER NECESSARY. SITE MAINTENANCE: CLEAR SNOW AND ICE FROM LOADING AND UNLOADING RAMPS, ENSURING THAT PLATFORMS REMAIN LEVEL, SAFE, AND OBSTACLE-FREE THROUGHOUT THE OPERATING DAY. INTERNAL COORDINATION: PROMPTLY REPORT ANY DETECTED MECHANICAL ANOMALIES TO THE TECHNICAL TEAM OR CENTRAL DISPATCH, AND COLLABORATE WITH THE SKI PATROL TEAM DURING WEATHER OR SAFETY INCIDENTS. CANDIDATE PROFILE: EDUCATION: HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA OR EQUIVALENT QUALIFICATION, BASIC KNOWLEDGE OF OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND SAFETY IS A PLUS. EXPERIENCE: PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE IN CUSTOMER SERVICE, TOURISM, OR OUTDOOR PHYSICAL WORK IS APPRECIATED (PRIOR SKI LIFT EXPERIENCE IS NOT REQUIRED, AS ROLE-SPECIFIC TRAINING WILL BE PROVIDED). LANGUAGES: FLUENT SPANISH, KNOWLEDGE OF CATALAN, FRENCH, OR ENGLISH IS A PLUS FOR INTERACTING WITH LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL GUESTS. KEY STRENGTHS: STRONG FOCUS AND SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY, A FRIENDLY AND EMPATHETIC ATTITUDE, EASE IN OPERATING BASIC CONTROL PANELS AND MANUAL TOOLS, GOOD PHYSICAL FITNESS, AND A WILLINGNESS TO WORK OUTDOORS UNDER CHANGING HIGH-MOUNTAIN WEATHER CONDITIONS. jobs.title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
jobs.description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen. 

  • Du har maskinerfaring og er vant til at side bare rattet i større maskiner. 

  • Ideelt set bor du omkring Kolding, Vejle eller Skanderborg, da det er herfra vi har flest aktiviteter. 

Vi tilbyder

  • En absolut nøglerolle i en af Danmarks mest ambitiøse landbrugsvirksomheder. 

  • Muligheden for at bygge og forme morgendagens landbrugs-infrastruktur fra bunden.

  • Et dynamisk, uformelt miljø, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og stor mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden, når vi skalerer mod 500+ hektar skovlandbrug under drift. 

Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort, mail om, hvorfor du er den rette til at drive vores marker. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Otat osaa myyntipalavereihin ja olet Lohjalla vähintään joka viikko muutaman päivän, muuten kotitoimistosi voi olla vaikka toisella paikkakunnalla.Luonteeltasi olet tiimityöskentelijä, vaikka nautit myös itsenäisistä asiakasmatkoista eli sinulla pitää olla mahdollisuus matkustamiseen sekä ajokortti ja oma auto.Sinulta ei edellytetä mitään tiettyä koulutustaustaa, mutta odotamme sinun tuntevan itsesi tarpeeksi hyvin tietääksesi, onko tämä unelmatyösi. Ja haluamme kuulla, miten ja miksi siinä menestyisit.Tarjolla on monipuolinen ja itsenäinen työtehtävä ja hyvä taustatuki kotimaisessa perheyrityksessä, joka tunnetaan hyvästä maineestaan alalla.Jos näet tässä juuri sitä, mitä olet aina halunnut, ilmianna itsesi! Laadi kunnollinen profiili ja liitä mukaan ansioluettelosi sekä palkkatoiveesi.

jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan
jobs.description:
Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan!

Haemme asiakkaallemme ajoneuvoasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasaan.

Nopeasta reagointikyvystään ja laadukkaasta kiinteistöpalvelustaan tunnettu yritys etsii nyt tiimin vahvistukseksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista ajoneuvoasentajaa.

Työtehtävät:

Asentajana vastaat yrityksen oman kaluston kuten pakettiautojen, pyöräkuormaajien ja muiden koneiden kunnossapidosta, huolloista, vianhausta ja korjaustöistä. Työ pitää sisällään monipuolisesti korjauksia, varusteluja, perushuoltoja sekä päivittäisen kaluston toimintakuntoon liittyviä tehtäviä yrityksen omalla korjaamolla. Toimit itsenäisesti ja varmistat omalla panoksellasi, että kentällä tarvittavat koneet ja autot pysyvät liikkeellä ilman turhia katkoksia.

Odotamme sinulta:

 * Soveltuvaa ammatillista koulutusta (esim. ajoneuvoasentaja, raskaskoneasentaja)
 * Käytännön kokemusta autojen ja työkoneiden huolto- ja korjaustöistä.
 * Sujuvaa suomen ja/tai ruotsinkielen taitoa.
 * Vastuullista työotetta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua pitää huolta siitä, että kalusto pysyy kunnossa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

 * Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työpaikan vakavaraisella ja arvostetulla paikallisella toimijalla.

 * Vakaat olosuhteet, hyvät työvälineet ja mukavan matalan hierarkian työyhteisön.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: SANTEHNIĶIS
jobs.description:
Sertificēts būvniecības un remontdarbu uzņēmums 

SIA  3 baloži(reģ. Nr.: 42103093609), 

sakarā ar darbības paplašināšanos aicina darbā SANTEHNIĶUS. ​

Darbs Liepājā un rajonā.

Prasības:

  • Atbilstošas zināšanas 
  • Darba pieredze.  ​

Darba pienākumi: 

  • Veikt ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas, apkures, ventilācijas un citu santehnikas sistēmu montāžu, apkopi un remontu.

  • Uzstādīt un pieslēgt santehnikas iekārtas – izlietnes, vannas, tualetes podus, dušas kabīnes, radiatorus, boilerus, sūkņus u.c.

  • Montēt cauruļvadus (metāla, plastmasas, vara u.c. materiālu), veicot nepieciešamos lodēšanas, līmēšanas vai metināšanas darbus.
  • Nodrošināt santehnikas sistēmu pārbaudi, regulēšanu un hermētiskuma testēšanu pēc uzstādīšanas vai remonta.
  • Veikt bojājumu diagnostiku un novēršanu esošajās santehnikas sistēmās.
  • Veikt profilaktiskos uzturēšanas darbus, lai novērstu noplūdes, aizsērējumus vai citas sistēmu darbības problēmas.
  • Nodrošināt darbu atbilstību būvprojekta prasībām, tehniskajām specifikācijām un normatīvajiem aktiem.
  • Strādāt droši, ievērojot darba aizsardzības, ugunsdrošības un vides aizsardzības noteikumus.
  •  Sadarboties ar citiem speciālistiem (elektriķiem, būvniekiem, apkures meistariem u.c.) kopīgu projektu īstenošanā.
  • Uzturēt kārtību un tīrību darba vietā, taupīgi izmantot materiālus un instrumentus.
  • Pildīt citus tiešā vadītāja norādījumus, kas saistīti ar santehnikas uzstādīšanu un uzturēšanu, atbilstoši darbinieka kvalifikācijai.

jobs.title: Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Talent Partner
Head of Commercial Products
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

  • Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

  • Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

  • Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

  • Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

  • Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

  • Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

  • A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

  • Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

  • Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

  • A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

  • Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

  • A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

  • Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

  • Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.
