jobs.title: Terminalmedarbejder til aftenhold i Hvidovre - try and hire
jobs.description:
På vegne af vores samarbejdspartner søger vi en engageret, kvalitetsbevidst og initiativrig terminalen i Hvidovre. Der er tale om et 3-måneders fuldtidsvikariat med henblik på fastansættelse for den rette kandidat.

Du bliver en del af et try-and-hire-forløb, hvor de første 3 måneder giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at se hinanden an med henblik på en permanent ansættelse.

Du bliver en del af en af Skandinaviens største globale transport- og logistikvirksomheder, hvor du indgår i et dynamisk team med 10-15 gode kollegaer. Her er der fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi søger ikke bare en kollega, men også en person, der har lyst til at tage ansvar, byde ind og være en aktiv del af hverdagen. Du må gerne være lidt fremme i skoene, have en udadvendt personlighed og trives med at tage initiativ – både når det gælder arbejdsopgaverne og det sociale fællesskab.

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du sammen med teamet skal være med til at sikre, at driften på terminalen fungerer optimalt. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Aflæsning og læsning af gods

  • Varemodtagelse og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Brug af kørende udstyr

  • Dokumenthåndtering

  • Registrering og håndtering af varer i lagerstyringssystemet

  • Diverse manuelle lageropgaver

Det er vigtigt, at du er indstillet på, at jobbet ikke udelukkende foregår på truck. En del af arbejdsdagen vil også bestå af manuelle og fysisk krævende opgaver, herunder løft og håndtering af gods.

Vi forestiller os, at du er en udadvendt og engageret person, der både fagligt og socialt har lyst til at være en del af et team.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Har et gyldigt truckcertifikat

  • Er indstillet på både truckkørsel og fysisk krævende, manuelle lageropgaver

  • Trives i et travlt og internationalt miljø

  • Er initiativrig og ikke bange for at tage ansvar

  • Er udadvendt og bidrager aktivt til et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø

  • Har en proaktiv tilgang til arbejdet og gerne byder ind med idéer og løsninger

  • Arbejder struktureret og systematisk og har øje for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Har flair for IT

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ejerskab for dine opgaver, bidrage til fællesskabet og være med til at få hverdagen til at fungere – også når der er travlt.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 12:00-20:00

  • Arbejdstid pr. uge: 37 timer

  • Arbejdssted: Hvidovre

  • Ansættelse: 3 måneders fuldtidsvikariat gennem StudentConsulting med henblik på fastansættelse hos kunden

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Løn: 189 kr./timen

Da du skal arbejde med sikkerhedsgodkendte områder og luftfragtgods, skal du kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes af myndighederne. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan redegøre for din beskæftigelse og/eller aktiviteter i de seneste 6 måneder i dit CV.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen?

Ønsker du at være en del af et energisk arbejdsmiljø, der samtidig har personligheden og engagementet til at tage ansvar, tage initiativ og bidrage positivt til et team, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send dit CV og din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Ledelseskonsulent tæt på topledelsen
jobs.description:
Har du blik for den strategiske retning, den gode proces og de konkrete opgaver, der får hverdagen til at hænge sammen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på en direktion med høje ambitioner for både studerende, medarbejdere og samfundet? Så er du måske vores nye ledelseskonsulent. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde helt tæt på de beslutninger, der er med til at styrke uddannelser med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Absalon står midt i en historisk reform af professionsuddannelserne og arbejder samtidig med en ambitiøs strategi frem mod 2030, som skal sikre dygtige professionelle til de professioner, vi uddanner til. Som ledelseskonsulent for de to direktører, der har ansvaret for Absalons uddannelser, efter- og videreuddannelser samt forskning, sikrer du sammen med direktionens øvrige ledelseskonsulenter sammenhæng, fremdrift og professionel ledelsesunderstøttelse på tværs af direktionens opgaver og ansvarsområder. Din profil

Du er en erfaren og struktureret generalist, der kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategisk udvikling, procesledelse og praktisk koordinering - og kan genkende dig selv i følgende: God organisationsforståelse og stærke samarbejdsevner. Du har erfaring med at agere i en kompleks organisation og er dygtig til at skabe og udvikle relationer. Dine samarbejdskompetencer er veludviklede, og du trives i samarbejdet med både topledelse, øvrig ledelse, medarbejdere i alle funktioner, studerende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Erfaring med ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgange. Du har erfaring med at understøtte en topledelse og et sikkert blik for, hvad der skaber værdi i en travl hverdag. Alternativt har du erfaring fra en politisk styret organisation og ved, hvad der skal til for at få sager sikkert gennem de relevante processer frem mod en beslutning. Du tager initiativ, når opgaver skal prioriteres, struktureres eller følges til dørs, og du skriver kort, klart og præcist. Erfaring med procesledelse. Du kan skabe fremdrift og håndtere interessenter med forskellige og til tider modsatrettede ønsker og behov. Du planlægger og driver professionelle processer med den rette balance mellem involvering, kvalitet og tempo. Selvstændig og handlekraftig. Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver, skaber selv overblik og fremdrift og følger op uden at skulle sættes i gang. Samtidig er du god til at afstemme retning og involvere andre, når der er behov for det. Nysgerrig på AI. Du ser AI som et værktøj og en sparringspartner i udviklingen af opgaver. Du tør eksperimentere med nye løsninger, deler erfaringer med kolleger og bidrager til at modne vores fælles brug af teknologien, hvor den skaber værdi. Trives med alsidighed. Du trives med at skifte mellem udviklingsopgaver, korte leverancer og de konkrete koordinerende opgaver. Vi forventer, at du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse samt erfaring fra en lignende stilling. Stillingen indplaceres som special- eller chefkonsulent afhængigt af din erfaring og kompetencer. Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver afspejler det, der fylder på de to direktørers bord. Nogle opgaver ligger allerede fast, mens andre vil blive formet med afsæt i din profil og det, du bringer med dig. Ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgrundlag. Du udarbejder oplæg og beslutningsgrundlag til blandt andet direktion og bestyrelse. Du understøtter de to direktører med procesplaner, præsentationer, mødeforberedelse, sparring, planlægning og koordinering, og du er med til at sikre, at relevante processer igangsættes og følges op. Nogle opgaver opstår med kort varsel og kræver, at du hurtigt kan gribe dem og levere. Andre kræver, at du holder fast over tid, skaber fremdrift og følger processen helt til dørs. Et stærkt og samarbejdende chefteam. Du understøtter og deltager i de faste møder i de to direktørers fælles centerchefteam, som består af seks chefer og de to direktører. Du planlægger, forbereder og følger op på møderne og bidrager både med struktur, koordinering og udvikling af chefteamets samarbejde og arbejdsform. Sektorsamarbejde. Begge direktører er involveret i sektorsamarbejde på tværs af de seks professionshøjskoler inden for deres ansvarsområde, fx inden for forsknings- eller sundhedsområdet. Du bidrager til at forberede og følge op på møder og konferencer i tæt samarbejde med direktøren og kolleger på de øvrige professionshøjskoler. Tværgående opgaver. Du får enkelte tværgående opgaver på tværs af hele organisationen. Det kan fx være de halvårlige seminarer for alle Absalons ledere, der planlægges i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og den ansvarlige direktør. Dine kolleger

Du bliver ansat i Kommunikation og Ledelsessekretariat, hvor vi arbejder for at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for, at Absalon lykkes med strategien om at uddanne dygtige professionelle og realiserer ambitionerne i uddannelsesreformen. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger fordelt på tre teams. Du bliver en del af Team Ledelsesunderstøttelse, som understøtter direktionen og Absalons fem centerchefer. Vi har hver især et tæt samarbejde med den eller de ledere, vi understøtter i hverdagen, samtidig med at vi som team løbende koordinerer og sparrer om fælles opgaver og indsatser. Vi bliver sammen opdateret på strategiske initiativer, nye processer og øvrige udviklinger, der har betydning for vores arbejde, så vi kan sikre sammenhæng og understøtte organisationen bedst muligt. Hos os møder du en organisation, der både er ambitiøs og uhøjtidelig. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet og gode rammer for balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv. Dit primære ansættelsessted vil være enten på vores campus i Roskilde eller i Slagelse. Hver fredag samles afdelingen på Campus Slagelse, hvor vi har afdelingsmøder, teammøder mv. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde 1-2 dage om ugen. Sådan ansøger du

  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og med ansættelses hurtigst muligt og senest den 1. februar 2027.
  • Stillingen indplaceres som special - eller chefkonsulent med en forventet løn på mellem 56.486 kr. og 60.800 kr. pr. måned inkl. pension.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte sekretariatschef, Nanna Ferslev, på telefon 7248 1260 eller naf@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 6. december 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 11. december og 2. samtaler den 16. december 2026.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Absalon

Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Renewals Manager - Italy/ Spain
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics
jobs.description:
Job description

The Department of Economics invites applicants for a position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO1352) in one of the following fields: Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics.

This is a full-time, four-year position, with 25% of working time devoted to teaching. The anticipated start date is between August 1 and October 1, 2027.

About the position 

The Department of Economics seeks a new colleague with the potential for outstanding research and high-quality teaching.

Candidates must provide evidence of excellence in research of the highest international caliber in macroeconomics, household finance, or family and demographic economics. This can be demonstrated by an innovative job market paper with a significant contribution to the literature, high-quality working papers, (forthcoming) publications in top-ranked and field-relevant journals, strong recommendations by referees who themselves have a record of excellence in research of the highest international caliber, the submitted research statement, presentations at significant conferences, and awards and accolades.

It is expected that the successful candidate contributes to a high standard of collegiality and the department’s working environment.

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

About the project

The postdoctoral position is financed by the research project HOWFER (Housing, Wealth, and Fertility in High-income Societies), led by Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm. The project combines macroeconomics, household finance, and family economics to analyze how rising house prices and wealth concentration have contributed to falling fertility in high-income countries. Using Norwegian administrative data linking wealth, housing, and family formation for the entire population, the work will estimate the causal effect of house prices on fertility and build structural models to evaluate which policies most effectively affect fertility. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute both to the empirical and theoretical parts of the project, in collaboration with the core research team.

Candidates should articulate how they can contribute to and strengthen the project.

Requirements
  • A PhD degree in Economics by the time of appointment, or shortly thereafter, and no later than September 30, 2027.
  • A strong research profile in Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics that complements that of the department and the research project.
  • Qualifications that are compatible with the department’s teaching obligations and study programmes.
  • Candidates must have fluent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Residence in or close to Oslo is required, and presence on campus is expected.
We offer 
  • Salary NOK 750 000 - 800 000 per annum, depending on qualifications, in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352).  From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the university’s kindergartens).
  • Norway’s capital, with its rich cultural life and easy access to beautiful nature.
  • Practical support for international staff moving to Norway (international staff may also benefit from tax cuts in their first years).
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interests, and how the candidate can contribute to and strengthen the HOWFER project).
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity).
  • Job market paper (clearly labeled).
  • Other working papers or publications.
  • Copies of PhD Diploma and educational certificates (academic transcripts only).
  • Letters of Recommendation (optional).
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

An interview will be part of the hiring process.

Contact information

  • Head of Administration (Office manager): Brita Langeid: brita.langeid@econ.uio.no

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the Spatial product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our Spatial ALD equipment, used by leading semiconductor and optics manufacturers, world-class technology companies, universities, and research institutes around the globe.This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs Spatial ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in Spatial and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Ability to design electrical systems and connections for vacuum equipment, covering both vacuum-side and atmospheric-side applications. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 13.12.2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Johannes Wesslin, Engineering Manager at johannes.wesslin@beneq.com [johannes.wesslin@beneq.com] or by phone +358404142431 on 20.11. or 27.11. 13.00-14.00 (UTC+2).Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.title: Service/rengøringsmedarbejder søges til 10-12 timer om ugen med mulighed for mere

Har du sans for rengøring, orden og detaljer – og er du samtidig en person, vi kan regne med, når der opstår noget med vores boliger? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

KMF Properties er i vækst, og vi er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i Kalundborg. Derfor søger vi en stabil og ansvarsbevidst rengørings- og servicemedarbejder, som primært skal stå for rengøring og klargøring af vores boliger.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Den største del af jobbet vil bestå af:

  • Rengøring af vores huse og boliger på alle fælles arealer, 1 gang om ugen

  • Klargøring af boliger til nye beboere

  • Rengøring ved fraflytning, inden nye beboer

  • Sørge for, at boligerne altid fremstår rene, pæne og indbydende

  • Opfyldning af forbrugsvarer

  • Tjek af boligerne og indberetning, hvis der er noget, der skal ordnes

Derudover søger vi en person, vi kan regne med

Som en del af jobbet vil du også være vores lokale kontaktperson i Kalundborg, når der opstår praktiske ting i vores boliger.

Det kan eksempelvis være, at vi har brug for dig til:

  • At køre forbi en bolig og tjekke noget

  • At hjælpe, hvis der pludselig opstår et mindre problem

  • At tage imod en håndværker eller lukke nogen ind, kun hvis der opstår et problem. Ellers burde de selv være i stand til at lukke sig ind.

  • At tjekke en bolig efter en beboer har meldt et problem

  • At hjælpe med mindre praktiske opgaver

  • At give os besked, hvis du opdager noget, der bør ordnes

Du behøver ikke være uddannet rengøringsassistent eller lign. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er fleksibel og kan træde til, når der opstår behov

  • Er serviceminded og imødekommende

  • Har en god ordenssans

  • Kan se, hvad der skal gøres, uden at vi behøver fortælle dig det hele

  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorienteret

  • Har kørekort B og egen bil

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, service eller lignende – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Vi lægger først og fremmest vægt på, at du er en person, vi kan stole på, og som tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

Vi tilbyder

  • 10-12 timer om ugen til at starte med

  • Gode muligheder for hurtigt at få flere timer, efterhånden som vores boligportefølje vokser

  • En selvstændig og varieret hverdag

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet

  • En vigtig rolle i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Mulighed for at få mere ansvar over tid

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort fra idé til handling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Arbejdssted

Arbejdet vil primært foregå i Hillerød og nærliggende områder.

Da KMF Properties er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i området, forventer vi, at der hurtigt vil blive mulighed for flere arbejdstimer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV, hvor du kort fortæller om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor jobbet passer til dig.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

KMF Properties

jobs.title: Kirketjener søges til Treenighedskirken i Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Har du hænderne skruet godt på og hjertet på rette sted? Kan du lide at møde mennesker, skabe gode rammer og få praktiske ting til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye kirketjener i Treenighedskirken. Vi søger en engageret, ansvarsbevidst og imødekommende kollega, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores kirke og fællesskab. Vi er et engageret team bestående af tre præster, to organister, en kirkesanger, en kordegn/daglig leder og en kirketjener/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder, som du vil få et tæt samarbejde med om fordelingen af vagter og praktiske opgaver. Treenighedskirken er en levende kirke med mange forskellige aktiviteter. Her mødes mennesker i alle aldre til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, koncerter, foredrag og sociale arrangementer. Som kirketjener er du en af de første, vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er et varmt og rummeligt menneske, der møder andre med venlighed, nærvær og respekt. Du skal kunne skabe en tryg og imødekommende atmosfære, uanset om du tager imod gæster til en festlig begivenhed eller møder mennesker i en svær livssituation. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er venlig, omsorgsfuld og god til at møde mennesker i alle livets situationer.
  • Har et naturligt værtskab og sætter en ære i at give kirkens besøgende en god oplevelse.
  • Er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og god til at planlægge din arbejdsdag.
  • Har praktisk sans, ordenssans og gerne hænderne skruet godt på.
  • Trives med både faste rutiner og dage, hvor planerne ændrer sig.
  • Er fleksibel, hjælpsom og god til at samarbejde med kolleger, præster, menighedsråd og frivillige.
  • Har øje for detaljerne og tager ansvar for, at kirken og dens omgivelser fremstår pæne og indbydende.
Du behøver ikke at være uddannet kirketjener på forhånd. Hvis du ikke har gennemført den obligatoriske femugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for de første to år af ansættelsen. Stillingen er primært en kirketjenerstilling, som udgør 80 % af arbejdstiden, mens de resterende 20 % er afsat til opgaver som kirke- og kulturmedarbejder. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som kirketjener er du med til at skabe gode rammer om kirkens liv og aktiviteter. Arbejdsdagene er alsidige og byder på både praktiske opgaver og kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:
  • Klargøring af kirken til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer.
  • At tage godt imod kirkegængere og besøgende og være en imødekommende vært.
  • Praktisk medvirken ved gudstjenester, dåb, vielser, bisættelser og begravelser.
  • At deltage i udvalgsarbejde.
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirken og dens øvrige lokaler.
  • Indkøb og andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med kirkens daglige drift, herunder lettere køkkenarbejde.
  • Vedligeholdelse af kirkens udendørsarealer.
  • Snerydning foran kirkens indgange samt saltning og glatførebekæmpelse efter behov.
  • Rekvirering og koordinering af håndværkere i samarbejde med kirkeværgen.
Du bliver en vigtig del af det daglige samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sammen sørger for, at kirken er et rart sted at komme – både for menigheden, besøgende og medarbejdere. Et job med variation og fællesskab Arbejdet følger kirkens rytme, og ingen uger er helt ens. Nogle dage er præget af praktiske opgaver og forberedelser, mens andre byder på gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer med mange mennesker. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med fast fridag om mandagen og fri hver anden weekend. Arbejdstiden omfatter både dag- og aftentimer samt arbejde på helligdage. De to kirketjenere afløser hinanden ved ferie og andet fravær. Vi lægger vægt på et godt kollegialt samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udviser fleksibilitet og tager fælles ansvar for kirkens daglige liv. Vi tilbyder
  • En alsidig og meningsfuld arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver.

jobs.title: Telecom & Network Engineer; Location; DK - Esbjerg, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!Your position In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.Your tasks & responsibilities As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.
  • Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.
  • Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.
  • Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems
  • Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.
  • Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.
  • Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.
  • Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.
Your profile & qualifications You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.We imagine that you hold:
  • Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.
  • Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks. 
  • A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage. 
  • Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams. 
  • Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
jobs.description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of cleanand sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and ScienceSalary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Proactively identify and engage high-quality global and regional partners to expand brand reach in priority markets.

- Negotiate pricing, contract terms and renewals with partners and suppliers, representing the company in securing stronger benefits, better rates and sustainable long-term arrangements, including annual framework agreements and long-term partnership discounts.

Maintain resource pricing databases across markets to improve ROI.

- Represent the company in partner meetings, proposal discussions, negotiations and senior-level relationship management. - Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work with senior stakeholders, local teams and external partners across cultures. Strong written and spoken English is required.

- Global exposure and the opportunity to shape partnership strategy across multiple markets, with learning and career development opportunities within a leading global trading platform.
- Competitive compensation and benefits package.
- A collaborative, international team environment where your commercial judgement directly influences how the companyâs brand investment is spent.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
jobs.description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
  • Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
  • Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
  • Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
  • Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.
Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
  • Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
  • Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.
Commercial and Customer Support
  • Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
  • Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
  • Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
  • Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.
Product Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
  • Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
  • Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
  • Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.
Your Profile

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

  • A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
  • Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
  • A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
  • Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
  • The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
  • A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.

What We Offer
  • A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
  • The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
  • Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
  • An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
  • Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
  • An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
  • Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.

The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.

Apply Now

Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down
   
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Tooling
jobs.description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

jobs.title: Field & Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Own Korea’s field marketing engine across hosted events, third-party programs, field ABM, and Korean-language webinars. At Notion, you’ll help define how an AI-native product earns trust in Korea: choosing the right rooms, accounts, partners, and follow-up motions—not just maximizing attendance. You’ll work closely with Sales, BDRs, and Solutions Consultants to turn target-account engagement into measurable pipeline and iARR.

This role is based in Seoul, Korea. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Build the Korea field marketing engine: Establish an event mix that reaches priority accounts, creates meaningful customer engagement, and contributes to pipeline and iARR—not just attendance.

 - By your 90th day, complete the handover and establish the plan: Inherit the event playbooks, vendors, and sales relationships; align the H1 calendar, budget, target-account list, and reporting baseline with Sales.

 - By your 90th day, use AI to improve the work: Apply AI across event research, account selection, Korean localization, campaign drafts, vendor briefs, follow-up, and pipeline analysis—with sound judgment around data and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, run the Korea program independently: Deliver the field events calendar, field ABM programs, third-party presence, and webinars with clear ownership from planning through follow-up.

 - By the end of your first year, raise the operating bar: Leave behind a durable Korea field playbook, a strong vendor and agency bench, reliable lead-routing and follow-up discipline, and reporting that helps the team rebalance toward what works.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL BRING

 - Demonstrated ability to design and deliver B2B field or events programs that create measurable pipeline and commercial impact; this role is accountable for more than attendance.

 - Experience owning event budgets, vendors, agencies, contracts, and on-site execution from planning through follow-up.

 - Experience creating executive-level programs—such as roundtables, VIP dinners, account workshops, or webinars—that earn engagement from senior decision-makers.

 - Deep knowledge of the Korean enterprise market, including relevant customers, event partners, vendors, and local channels; native-level Korean and business-level English.

 - Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the independence to build a playbook from scratch; comfortable with Salesforce, Marketo, or similar tools and motivated to use AI as a daily collaborator.
   
   

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Responsibilities:
- Bring the program together across the sub-streams, including the finance applications carve-out, and keep them moving in step

- Lead the planning and execution of the separation with a clear view of the whole, making sure decisions are made in the right order
- Map dependencies between systems, integrations and data, including finance applications, and turn them into a workable separation plan with timelines and phasing
- Monitor progress, manage risks and report to stakeholders

Requirements:
. Extensive, proven experience as a Program Manager in carve-outs, demergers or comparable separation programs, with clear evidence of similar programs you have delivered
- Experience in running a large program with multiple sub-streams and combining them into one whole
- Experience with financial systems and finance application carve-outs is important

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)

- Do you have experience in overall program coordination, aligning multiple workstreams and their interdependencies?*
- Do you have experience with finance systems and applications in a carve-out or separation context?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.
